adhkar.title: Recite Ayat-Al-Kursiy (Al-Baqarah :255)
adhkar.arabicText: أعوذ بالـلـه من الشيطان الـرجـيم ﴿اللهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ هُـوَ الْـحَيُّ الْـقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأخذُهُ سنَةٌ ولا نومٌ لهُ ما في السَّمَاوَاتِ وما في الأَرضِ من ذا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بإِذنهِ يعْلَمُ ما بينَ أيدِيهِمْ وما خلفَهُمْ ولا يُحيطُونَ بِشيءٍ مِّن عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسعَ كُرْسيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤودُهُ حِفظُهُمَا وهوَ العَليُّ العَظيمُ ۞ ﴾ [البقرة: ٢٥٥]
adhkar.transliteration: A'uwdhu bialllahi mina alshhaytaani alrrajiymi alllahu la iilaha iila huwa alhayyu alqayyuwmu la taakhudhuhu sinahun wala nawmun llahu maa fi alssamawaati wamaa fi alardi man dhaa alladhiy yashfa'u 'indahu iila biiidhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aydiyhim wamaa khalfahum wala yuhiytuwna bishay'in mmin 'ilmihi iila bimaa shaa' wasi'a kursiyyuhu alssamawaati waalarda wala yauuwduhu hifzuhumaa wahuwa al'aliyyu al'aziymu
adhkar.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
adhkar.sourceReference: القرآن 2:255. أخرجه الحاكم 1/562، وصححه الألباني في صحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/273، وعزاه إلى النسائي والطبراني وقال: إسناد الطبراني جيد.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح أُجير من الجن حتى يمسي، ومن قالها حين يمسي أُجير منهم حتى يصبح
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it in the morning is protected from the jinn until evening, and whoever recites it in the evening is protected from them until morning
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Qur'an 2:255. Recorded by al-Hakim, 1/562, and authenticated by al-Albani in Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib, 1/273, who attributed it to al-Nasa'i and al-Tabarani, saying: 'The chain of al-Tabarani is authentic.'

adhkar.title: Recite Soorah al-Ikhlaas
adhkar.arabicText: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُل هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ ۞ اللهُ الصَّمَدُ ۞ لم يلد ولم يولد ۞ ولم يَكُن لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ ۞﴾ [الإخلاص: ١-٤]
adhkar.translation: Say, He is Allah, [who is] One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/322 برقم 5082، والترمذي 5/567 برقم 3575. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/182.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, it will suffice him against all things
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/322, no. 5082, and al-Tirmidhi 5/567, no. 3575. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/182.

adhkar.title: Recite Soorah al-Falaq
adhkar.arabicText: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُل أَعوذُ بربِّ الفَلَقِ ۞ مِن شر ما خَلَقَ ۞ ومِن شر غاسِقٍ إِذا وَقَبَ ۞ ومِن شر النَّفّاثاتِ فِي العُقَدِ ۞ ومِن شر حاسِدٍ إِذا حَسَدَ ۞ ﴾ [الفلق: ١-٥]
adhkar.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/322 برقم 5082، والترمذي 5/567 برقم 3575. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/182.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, it will suffice him against all things
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/322, no. 5082, and al-Tirmidhi 5/567, no. 3575. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/182.

adhkar.title: Recite Soorah an-Naas
adhkar.arabicText: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُل أعوذُ بربِّ النّاسِ ۞ ملكِ النّاسِ ۞ إلهِ النّاسِ ۞ من شر الوَسواسِ الخَنّاسِ ۞ الذي يوسوِسُ في صدورِ النّاسِ ۞ منَ الجِنَّةِ والنّاسِ ۞ ﴾ [الناس: ١-٦]
adhkar.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind. From among the jinn and mankind.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/322 برقم 5082، والترمذي 5/567 برقم 3575. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/182.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, it will suffice him against all things
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/322, no. 5082, and al-Tirmidhi 5/567, no. 3575. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/182.

adhkar.title: We have reached the morning and at this...
adhkar.arabicText: أصـبَحنا وأصـبَحَ المُـلكُ لله والحَمدُ لله، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُـلكُ ولهُ الحَمـد، وهو على كل شيءٍ قدير، رَبِّ أسـألُـكَ خـيرَ ما في هـذا اليوم وخـيرَ ما بَعْـدَه، وأعـوذُ بِكَ من شـر ما في هـذا اليوم وشر ما بَعْـدَه، رَبِّ أعـوذُ بِكَ من الْكَسَـلِ وسـوءِ الكِـبَر، رَبِّ أعـوذُ بِكَ من عـذابٍ في النّـارِ وعـذابٍ في القَـبْر.
adhkar.transliteration: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah walhamdu lillah la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathihil-laylah, wakhayra ma baAAdaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathihil-laylah, washarri ma baAAdaha, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr
adhkar.translation: ‘We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allaah, belongs all sovereignty , and all praise is for Allaah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, alone, without any partner, to Him belong all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.’
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أصبح قال هذا الذكر، وإذا أمسى قال مثله
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this remembrance when morning came, and he would say the like when evening came.

adhkar.title: O Allah, by your leave we have reached...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أصبَحنا، وبِكَ أمسَينا، وبِكَ نحيا وبِكَ نموتُ وإليكَ النُّشورُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wabika amsayna, wabika nahya ,wabika namootu wa-ilaykan-nushoor
adhkar.translation: O Allah, by your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection. In the evening: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أصبح قال هذا الدعاء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi 5/466, no. 3391. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/142.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication when morning came.

adhkar.title: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أنتَ رَبيِّ لا إله إلا أنتَ، خَلَقتنَيِ وأنا عَبدُكَ، وأنا على عَهْدِكَ ووعدِكَ ما استَطَعتُ، أعوذُ بكَ من شر ما صَنَعتُ، أبوءُ لكَ بنعمَتِكَ علَيَّ، وأبوءُ بذَنْبِي فاغْفِرْ لي فَإنَّهُ لَا يَغفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إلا أنتَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant
adhkar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.
adhkar.fadl: وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ النَّهَارِ مُوقِنًا بِهَا، فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُمْسِيَ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ مُوقِنٌ بِهَا، فَمَاتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it during the day with conviction and dies that day before evening, he will be among the people of Paradise, and whoever says it during the night with conviction and dies before morning, he will be among the people of Paradise
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bukhari 7/150, no. 6306, al-Nasa'i, and al-Tirmidhi.

adhkar.title: O Allah, verily I have reached the morning...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أصبَحتُ أُشهِدُكَ، وأُشهِدُ حَمَلةَ عَرشِكَ، ومَلائِكَتَكَ، وجميعَ خَلقِكَ: أنكَ أنتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ وَحدَكَ لا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وأن مُحمَّدًا عبدُكَ ورسولُكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee asbahtu oshhiduk, wa-oshhidu hamalata AAarshik, wamala-ikatak, wajameeAAa khalqik, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluk .) instead of (asbahtu
adhkar.translation: O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angles, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger. (four times in the morning & evening)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsaytu. instead of (asbahtu).)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 4/317 برقم 5069، والبخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 1201، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 9، وابن السني برقم 70.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح، أو يمسي أربع مرات، أعتقه اللَّه من النار
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it four times in the morning or evening, Allah will free him from the Fire
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 4/317, no. 5069, al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad, no. 1201, al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 9, and Ibn al-Sunni, no. 70.

adhkar.title: O Allah, what blessing I or any of...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ ما أصبحَ بي من نعمةٍ أو بأحدٍ من خلقِكَ فمنكَ وحدَكَ لا شريكَ لكَ فلكَ الحمدُ ولكَ الشُّكرُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.) instead of (asbaha
adhkar.translation: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon, is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks. (…whoever says this in the morning has indeed offered his day’s thanks and whoever says this in the evening has indeed offered his night’s thanks.)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsa. instead of (asbaha).)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 4/318 برقم 5073، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 7، وابن السني برقم 41، وابن حبان (موارد) برقم 2361.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح فقد أدَّى شكر يومه، ومن قالها حين يمسي فقد أدَّى شكر ليلته
adhkar.titleAr: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it in the morning has offered his day's thanks, and whoever says it in the evening has offered his night's thanks
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 4/318, no. 5073, al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 7, Ibn al-Sunni, no. 41, and Ibn Hibban (Mawarid), no. 2361.

adhkar.title: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عافِني في بدَني، اللَّهُمَّ عافِني في سمعي، اللَّهُمَّ عافِني في بصري، لا إلهَ إلا أنت. اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أعوذُ بِكَ منَ الكُفْرِ، والفقرِ، وأعوذُ بكَ من عذابِ القبرِ، لا إلهَ إلا أنت.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa ant..)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufr, walfaqr, wa-aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant
adhkar.translation: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You. (three times) (O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You. (three times))
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/324 برقم 5090، وأحمد 5/42 برقم 20430، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 22، وابن السني برقم 69.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يسأل الله العافية في الدنيا والآخرة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/324, no. 5090, Ahmad 5/42, no. 20430, al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 22, and Ibn al-Sunni, no. 69.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would ask Allah for well-being in this world and the Hereafter.

adhkar.title: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the...
adhkar.arabicText: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلا هُوَ علَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وهُوَ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظيم.
adhkar.transliteration: Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem
adhkar.translation: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.’ (Recite seven times in Arabic.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه ابن السني برقم 71 مرفوعاً، وأبو داود موقوفاً 4/321 برقم 5081. وصحح إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح وحين يمسي سبع مرات كفاه اللَّه ما أهمّه من أمر الدنيا والآخرة
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will suffice him for what concerns him of worldly and hereafter matters
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ibn al-Sunni, no. 71 as marfu', and Abu Dawud as mawquf, 4/321, no. 5081. Shu'ayb and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut authenticated its chain.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ العَفْوَ والعافيَةَ في الدنيا والآخرةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ العَفْوَ والعافيَةَ: في دينِي ودُنيَايَ وأهلِي، ومالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْراتي، وآمِنْ رَوْعاتي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي من بَينِ يَدَيَّ، ومن خَلْفي، وعن يَميني، وعن شِمالي، ومن فَوْقي، وأعوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أن أُغْتالَ من تَحتي.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah, fid-dunya wal-akhirah, allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah fee deenee, wadunyaya wa-ahlee, wamalee, allahummas-tur AAawratee, wa-amin rawAAatee, allahummah-fathnee min bayni yaday, wamin khalfee, waAAan yameenee, waAAan shimalee, wamin fawqee, wa-aAAoothu biAAathamatika an oghtala min tahtee
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود برقم 5074، وابن ماجه برقم 3871. وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه 2/332.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يسأل الله العفو والعافية
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud, no. 5074, and Ibn Majah, no. 3871. See: Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/332.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would ask Allah for pardon and well-being.

adhkar.title: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عالِمَ الغَيْبِ والشَّهادَةِ فاطِرَ السمواتِ والأرضِ، رَبَّ كل شيءٍ ومَليكَهُ، أشْهَدُ أن لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ، أعوذُ بِكَ من شر نَفْسي، ومن شر الشيطانِ وشَرَكِهِ، وأن أَقْتَرِفَ على نفسي سُوءاً، أو أجُرَّهُ إلى مُسلِمٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim. (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
adhkar.sourceReference: الترمذي برقم 3392، وأبو داود برقم 5067. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/142.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها في الصباح والمساء كان له أجر عظيم
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi, no. 3392, and Abu Dawud, no. 5067. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/142.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this in the morning and evening will have a great reward.

adhkar.title: In the name of Allah with whose name...
adhkar.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللهِ الذي لا يَضُرُّ مع اسمهِ شيءٌ في الأرضِ ولا في السماءِ وهو السَّميعُ العَليمُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.’(three times)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 4/323 برقم 5088، والترمذي 5/465 برقم 3388، وابن ماجه برقم 3869، وأحمد برقم 446.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ثلاثاً إذا أصبح، وثلاثاً إذا أمسى لم يضره شيء
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it three times in the morning and three times in the evening, nothing will harm him
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 4/323, no. 5088, al-Tirmidhi 5/465, no. 3388, Ibn Majah, no. 3869, and Ahmad, no. 446.

adhkar.title: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord...
adhkar.arabicText: رضيت بالله رباً، وبالإسلام ديناً، وبمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم نبياً.
adhkar.transliteration: Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin nabiyya
adhkar.translation: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad as a Prophet.’(three times)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 4/318، والترمذي 5/465، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 4، وابن السني برقم 68، وأحمد 4/337.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ثلاثاً حين يصبح وحين يمسي كان حقاً على الله أن يرضيه يوم القيامة
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it three times in the morning and evening, it is Allah's right to please him on the Day of Resurrection
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 4/318, al-Tirmidhi 5/465, al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 4, Ibn al-Sunni, no. 68, and Ahmad 4/337.

adhkar.title: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of...
adhkar.arabicText: يا حَيُّ يا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أسْتَغيثُ أصلِحْ لي شأنيَ كلهُ ولا تَكِلْني إلى نَفْسي طَرْفَةَ عينٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha/nee kullah, wala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn
adhkar.translation: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.
adhkar.sourceReference: الحاكم 1/545 وصححه ووافقه الذهبي. وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/273.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها في الصباح والمساء أحيى الله قلبه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Hakim 1/545, authenticated by him and al-Dhahabi agreed. See: Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib, 1/273.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this in the morning and evening, Allah will enliven his heart.

adhkar.title: We have reached the morning and at this...
adhkar.arabicText: أصبَحْنا وأصْبَحَ المُلْكُ لِلهِ رَبِّ العالمينَ، اللَّهُـمَّ إني أسألكَ خيرَ هذا اليومِ: فَتْحَهُ، ونَصْرَهُ، ونورَهُ، وبَرَكَتَهُ، وهُدَاهُ، وأعوذُ بكَ من شر ما فيهِ وشر ما بعدَهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-yawm, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.)For the evening, the supplication is read as follows: (Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathihil-laylah, fat-haha, wanasraha, wanooraha, wabarakataha, wahudaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feeha washarri ma baAAdaha
adhkar.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it. For the evening, the supplication is read as follows: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/322 برقم 5084. وحسن إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط في تحقيق زاد المعاد 2/373.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها في الصباح كان محفوظاً بإذن الله
adhkar.titleAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/322, no. 5084. Shu'ayb and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut graded its chain as good in their verification of Zad al-Ma'ad, 2/373.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this in the morning will be protected by Allah's permission.

adhkar.title: We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and...
adhkar.arabicText: أصبَحْنا على فِطْرَةِ الإسلامِ، وعلى كَلِمَةِ الإخلاصِ، وعلى دينِ نَبِيِّنَا محمدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وعلى مِلَّةِ أبينا إبراهيمَ، حَنيفاً مُسلماً وما كان من المُشرِكينَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Asbahna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen
adhkar.translation: We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah. (fitrah: the religion of Islam, the way of Ibraheem u.)(Note: for the evening, one reads amsayna instead of asbahna.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أحمد 3/406 و407 برقم 15360 و15563، والنسائي، وابن السني برقم 34. وانظر: صحيح الجامع 4/209.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلم أصحابه هذا الذكر
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ahmad 3/406-7, nos. 15360 and 15563, al-Nasa'i, and Ibn al-Sunni, no. 34. See: Sahih al-Jami', 4/209.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would teach his companions this remembrance.

adhkar.title: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him
adhkar.arabicText: سُبْحانَ اللهِ وبِحَمْدِهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih
adhkar.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. (one hundred times)
adhkar.fadl: من قالها مائة مرة حين يصبح وحين يمسي لم يأت أحد يوم القيامة بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد قال مثل ما قال أو زاد
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it one hundred times in the morning and evening, no one will bring anything better on the Day of Resurrection except someone who said the same or more

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except...
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ، وهوَ على كل شيءٍ قَديرٌ. (عشرَ مرات)، أو (مرةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ).
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. ([ten times or once if lazy])
adhkar.sourceReference: صحيح البخاري برقم 6404، صحيح مسلم برقم 2693، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 24. وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/272. (مرة واحدة عند الكسل: أبو داود برقم 5077، وابن ماجه برقم 3798، وأحمد برقم 8719).
adhkar.fadl: عشرَ مرَّات أَوْ مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ، ومن قالها عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ.
adhkar.titleAr: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
adhkar.fadlEn: Ten times, or once if lazy. Whoever says it ten times is like one who freed four slaves from the descendants of Ishmael
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Sahih al-Bukhari, no. 6404, Sahih Muslim, no. 2693, al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 24. (Once if lazy: Abu Dawud, no. 5077, Ibn Majah, no. 3798, Ahmad, no. 8719).

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except...
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ، وهوَ على كل شيءٍ قَديرٌ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. ((one hundred times every day))
adhkar.sourceReference: صحيح البخاري برقم 6404، صحيح مسلم برقم 2693.
adhkar.fadl: عشرَ مرَّات أَوْ مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ، ومن قالها عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ.
adhkar.titleAr: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
adhkar.fadlEn: Ten times, or once if lazy. Whoever says it ten times is like one who freed four slaves from the descendants of Ishmael
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Sahih al-Bukhari, no. 6404, Sahih Muslim, no. 2693.

adhkar.title: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him...
adhkar.arabicText: سُبْحانَ اللهِ وبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، ورِضا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، ومِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, AAadada khalqihi warida nafsih, wazinata AAarshih, wamidada kalimatih
adhkar.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words. (three times)
adhkar.fadl: من قالها كسب بها أجراً عظيماً يوم القيامة
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this will earn a great reward on the Day of Resurrection.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ عِلْماً نافِعاً، ورِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وعملاً مُتَقَبَّلاً.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه ابن السني في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 54، وابن ماجه برقم 925.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها بعد صلاة الفجر غفر له
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ibn al-Sunni in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 54, and Ibn Majah, no. 925.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this after Fajr prayer will be forgiven.

adhkar.title: I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to...
adhkar.arabicText: أَستَغْفِرُ اللهَ وأتُوبُ إليهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Astaghfirullaaha wa 'atoobu 'ilayhi
adhkar.translation: ‘I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.’ [one hundred times a day]
adhkar.sourceReference: البخاري مع الفتح 11/101 برقم 6307، ومسلم 4/2075 برقم 2702.
adhkar.fadl: إنه ليغان على قلبي وإني لأستغفر الله في اليوم مائة مرة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari with al-Fath 11/101, no. 6307, and Muslim 4/2075, no. 2702.
adhkar.fadlEn: Truly, my heart becomes preoccupied and I seek forgiveness from Allah one hundred times a day.

adhkar.title: O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وسَلِّمْ على نَبَيِّنَا محمدٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin
adhkar.translation: ‘O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.’ [ten times]
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه الطبراني بإسنادين أحدهما جيد. انظر: مجمع الزوائد 10/120، وصحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/273 برقم 656.
adhkar.fadl: من صلّى عليَّ حين يصبح عشراً، وحين يمسي عشراً، أدركته شفاعتي يوم القيامة
adhkar.titleAr: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever sends blessings upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening, my intercession will reach him on the Day of Resurrection
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tabarani with two chains, one of which is good. See: Majma' al-Zawa'id 10/120, and Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib 1/273, no. 656.

adhkar.title: Recite Ayat-Al-Kursiy (Al-Baqarah :255)
adhkar.arabicText: أعوذ بالـلـه من الشيطان الـرجـيم ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ هُـوَ الْـحَيُّ الْـقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأخذُهُ سنَةٌ ولا نومٌ لهُ ما في السَّمَاوَاتِ وما في الأَرضِ من ذا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بإِذنهِ يعْلَمُ ما بينَ أيدِيهِمْ وما خلفَهُمْ ولا يُحيطُونَ بِشيءٍ مِّن عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسعَ كُرْسيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤودُهُ حِفظُهُمَا وهوَ العَليُّ العَظيمُ ۞ ﴾ [البقرة: ٢٥٥]
adhkar.transliteration: A'uwdhu bialllahi mina alshhaytaani alrrajiymi alllahu la iilaha iila huwa alhayyu alqayyuwmu la taakhudhuhu sinahun wala nawmun llahu maa fi alssamawaati wamaa fi alardi man dhaa alladhiy yashfa'u 'indahu iila biiidhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aydiyhim wamaa khalfahum wala yuhiytuwna bishay'in mmin 'ilmihi iila bimaa shaa' wasi'a kursiyyuhu alssamawaati waalarda wala yauuwduhu hifzuhumaa wahuwa al'aliyyu al'aziymu
adhkar.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
adhkar.sourceReference: القرآن 2:255. أخرجه الحاكم 1/562، وصححه الألباني في صحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/273، وعزاه إلى النسائي والطبراني وقال: إسناد الطبراني جيد.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح أُجير من الجن حتى يمسي، ومن قالها حين يمسي أُجير منهم حتى يصبح
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it in the morning is protected from the jinn until evening, and whoever recites it in the evening is protected from them until morning
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Qur'an 2:255. Recorded by al-Hakim, 1/562, and authenticated by al-Albani in Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib, 1/273, who attributed it to al-Nasa'i and al-Tabarani, saying: 'The chain of al-Tabarani is authentic.'

adhkar.title: Recite Soorah al-Ikhlaas
adhkar.arabicText: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُل هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۞ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۞ لم يلد ولم يولد ۞ ولم يَكُن لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ ۞ ﴾ [الإخلاص: ١-٤]
adhkar.translation: Say, He is Allah, [who is] One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/322 برقم 5082، والترمذي 5/567 برقم 3575. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/182.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, it will suffice him against all things
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/322, no. 5082, and al-Tirmidhi 5/567, no. 3575. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/182.

adhkar.title: Recite Soorah al-Falaq
adhkar.arabicText: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُل أَعوذُ بربِّ الفَلَقِ ۞ مِن شر ما خَلَقَ ۞ ومِن شر غاسِقٍ إِذا وَقَبَ ۞ ومِن شر النَّفّاثاتِ فِي العُقَدِ ۞ ومِن شر حاسِدٍ إِذا حَسَدَ ۞ ﴾ [الفلق: ١-٥]
adhkar.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/322 برقم 5082، والترمذي 5/567 برقم 3575. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/182.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, it will suffice him against all things
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/322, no. 5082, and al-Tirmidhi 5/567, no. 3575. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/182.

adhkar.title: Recite Soorah an-Naas
adhkar.arabicText: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُل أعوذُ بربِّ النّاسِ ۞ ملكِ النّاسِ ۞ إلهِ النّاسِ ۞ من شر الوَسواسِ الخَنّاسِ ۞ الذي يوسوِسُ في صدورِ النّاسِ ۞ منَ الجِنَّةِ والنّاسِ ۞ ﴾ [الناس: ١-٦]
adhkar.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind. From among the jinn and mankind.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/322 برقم 5082، والترمذي 5/567 برقم 3575. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/182.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ثلاث مرات حين يصبح وحين يمسي كفته من كل شيء
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, it will suffice him against all things
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/322, no. 5082, and al-Tirmidhi 5/567, no. 3575. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/182.

adhkar.title: We have reached the evening and at this...
adhkar.arabicText: أمسَينا وأمسَى المُـلكُ لله والحَمدُ لله، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُـلكُ ولهُ الحَمـد، وهو على كل شيءٍ قدير، رَبِّ أسـألُـكَ خـيرَ ما في هذه الليلة وخـيرَ ما بعدها، وأعـوذُ بِكَ من شـر ما في هذه الليلة وشر ما بعدها، رَبِّ أعـوذُ بِكَ من الْكَسَـلِ وسـوءِ الكِـبَر، رَبِّ أعـوذُ بِكَ من عـذابٍ في النّـارِ وعـذابٍ في القَـبْر.
adhkar.transliteration: Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah walhamdu lillah la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathihil-laylah, wakhayra ma baAAdaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathihil-laylah, washarri ma baAAdaha, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr
adhkar.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أصبح قال هذا الذكر، وإذا أمسى قال مثله
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this remembrance when morning came, and he would say the like when evening came.

adhkar.title: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أمسَينا، وبِكَ أصبَحنا، وبِكَ نحيا، وبِكَ نموتُ وإليكَ المصيرُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wabika asbahna, wabika nahya, wabika namootu wa-ilaykal-maseer
adhkar.translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أصبح قال هذا الدعاء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi 5/466, no. 3391. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/142.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication when morning came.

adhkar.title: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أنتَ رَبيِّ لا إله إلا أنتَ، خَلَقتنَيِ وأنا عَبدُكَ، وأنا على عَهْدِكَ ووعدِكَ ما استَطَعتُ، أعوذُ بكَ من شر ما صَنَعتُ، أبوءُ لكَ بنعمَتِكَ علَيَّ، وأبوءُ بذَنْبِي فاغْفِرْ لي فَإنَّهُ لَا يَغفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إلا أنتَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant
adhkar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.
adhkar.fadl: وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ النَّهَارِ مُوقِنًا بِهَا، فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُمْسِيَ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ، وَمَنْ قَالَهَا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ مُوقِنٌ بِهَا، فَمَاتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصْبِحَ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it during the day with conviction and dies that day before evening, he will be among the people of Paradise, and whoever says it during the night with conviction and dies before morning, he will be among the people of Paradise
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bukhari 7/150, no. 6306, al-Nasa'i, and al-Tirmidhi.

adhkar.title: O Allah, verily I have reached the evening...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أمسَيت أُشهِدُكَ، وأُشهِدُ حَمَلةَ عَرشِكَ، ومَلائِكَتَكَ، وجميعَ خَلقِكَ: أنكَ أنتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ وَحدَكَ لا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وأن مُحمَّدًا عبدُكَ ورسولُكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee asbahtu oshhiduk, wa-oshhidu hamalata AAarshik, wamala-ikatak, wajameeAAa khalqik, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluk .) instead of (asbahtu
adhkar.translation: O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angles, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger. (four times in the morning & evening)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsaytu. instead of (asbahtu).)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 4/317 برقم 5069، والبخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 1201، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 9، وابن السني برقم 70.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح، أو يمسي أربع مرات، أعتقه اللَّه من النار
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it four times in the morning or evening, Allah will free him from the Fire
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 4/317, no. 5069, al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad, no. 1201, al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 9, and Ibn al-Sunni, no. 70.

adhkar.title: O Allah, what blessing I or any of...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ ما أمسَى بي من نعمةٍ أو بأحدٍ من خلقِكَ فمنكَ وحدَكَ لا شريكَ لكَ فلكَ الحمدُ ولكَ الشُّكرُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.) instead of (asbaha
adhkar.translation: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon, is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks. (…whoever says this in the morning has indeed offered his day’s thanks and whoever says this in the evening has indeed offered his night’s thanks.)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsa. instead of (asbaha).)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 4/318 برقم 5073، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 7، وابن السني برقم 41، وابن حبان (موارد) برقم 2361.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح فقد أدَّى شكر يومه، ومن قالها حين يمسي فقد أدَّى شكر ليلته
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it in the morning has offered his day's thanks, and whoever says it in the evening has offered his night's thanks
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 4/318, no. 5073, al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 7, Ibn al-Sunni, no. 41, and Ibn Hibban (Mawarid), no. 2361.

adhkar.title: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عافِني في بدَني، اللَّهُمَّ عافِني في سمعي، اللَّهُمَّ عافِني في بصري، لا إلهَ إلا أنت. اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أعوذُ بِكَ منَ الكُفْرِ، والفقرِ، وأعوذُ بكَ من عذابِ القبرِ، لا إلهَ إلا أنت.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa ant..)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufr, walfaqr, wa-aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant
adhkar.translation: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You. (three times) (O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You. (three times))
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/324 برقم 5090، وأحمد 5/42 برقم 20430، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 22، وابن السني برقم 69.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يسأل الله العافية في الدنيا والآخرة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/324, no. 5090, Ahmad 5/42, no. 20430, al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 22, and Ibn al-Sunni, no. 69.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would ask Allah for well-being in this world and the Hereafter.

adhkar.title: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the...
adhkar.arabicText: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلا هُوَ علَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وهُوَ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظيم.
adhkar.transliteration: Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem
adhkar.translation: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.’ (Recite seven times in Arabic.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه ابن السني برقم 71 مرفوعاً، وأبو داود موقوفاً 4/321 برقم 5081. وصحح إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح وحين يمسي سبع مرات كفاه اللَّه ما أهمّه من أمر الدنيا والآخرة
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will suffice him for what concerns him of worldly and hereafter matters
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ibn al-Sunni, no. 71 as marfu', and Abu Dawud as mawquf, 4/321, no. 5081. Shu'ayb and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut authenticated its chain.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ العَفْوَ والعافيَةَ في الدنيا والآخرةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ العَفْوَ والعافيَةَ: في دينِي ودُنيَايَ وأهلِي، ومالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْراتي، وآمِنْ رَوْعاتي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي من بَينِ يَدَيَّ، ومن خَلْفي، وعن يَميني، وعن شِمالي، ومن فَوْقي، وأعوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أن أُغْتالَ من تَحتي.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah, fid-dunya wal-akhirah, allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah fee deenee, wadunyaya wa-ahlee, wamalee, allahummas-tur AAawratee, wa-amin rawAAatee, allahummah-fathnee min bayni yaday, wamin khalfee, waAAan yameenee, waAAan shimalee, wamin fawqee, wa-aAAoothu biAAathamatika an oghtala min tahtee
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود برقم 5074، وابن ماجه برقم 3871. وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه 2/332.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يسأل الله العفو والعافية
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud, no. 5074, and Ibn Majah, no. 3871. See: Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/332.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would ask Allah for pardon and well-being.

adhkar.title: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عالِمَ الغَيْبِ والشَّهادَةِ فاطِرَ السمواتِ والأرضِ، رَبَّ كل شيءٍ ومَليكَهُ، أشْهَدُ أن لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ، أعوذُ بِكَ من شر نَفْسي، ومن شر الشيطانِ وشَرَكِهِ، وأن أَقْتَرِفَ على نفسي سُوءاً، أو أجُرَّهُ إلى مُسلِمٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim. (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
adhkar.sourceReference: الترمذي برقم 3392، وأبو داود برقم 5067. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/142.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح وحين يمسي أربع مرات أعتقه الله من النار .
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it four times in the morning and evening, Allah will free him from the Fire
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi, no. 3392, and Abu Dawud, no. 5067. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/142.

adhkar.title: In the name of Allah with whose name...
adhkar.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللهِ الذي لا يَضُرُّ مع اسمهِ شيءٌ في الأرضِ ولا في السماءِ وهو السَّميعُ العَليمُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.’(three times)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 4/323 برقم 5088، والترمذي 5/465 برقم 3388، وابن ماجه برقم 3869، وأحمد برقم 446.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ثلاثاً إذا أصبح، وثلاثاً إذا أمسى لم يضره شيء
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it three times in the morning and three times in the evening, nothing will harm him
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 4/323, no. 5088, al-Tirmidhi 5/465, no. 3388, Ibn Majah, no. 3869, and Ahmad, no. 446.

adhkar.title: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord...
adhkar.arabicText: رضيت بالله رباً، وبالإسلام ديناً، وبمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم نبياً.
adhkar.transliteration: Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin nabiyya
adhkar.translation: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad as a Prophet.’(three times)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 4/318، والترمذي 5/465، والنسائي، وابن السني برقم 68، وأحمد 4/337.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح فقد أدي شكر يومه ، ومن قالها حين يمسى فقد أدى شكر ليلته .
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it in the morning has offered his day's thanks, and whoever says it in the evening has offered his night's thanks
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 4/318, al-Tirmidhi 5/465, al-Nasa'i, Ibn al-Sunni, no. 68, and Ahmad 4/337.

adhkar.title: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of...
adhkar.arabicText: يا حَيُّ يا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أسْتَغيثُ أصلِحْ لي شأنيَ كلهُ ولا تَكِلْني إلى نَفْسي طَرْفَةَ عينٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha/nee kullah, wala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn
adhkar.translation: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.
adhkar.sourceReference: الحاكم 1/545 وصححه ووافقه الذهبي. وانظر: صحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/273.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها في الصباح والمساء أحيى الله قلبه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Hakim 1/545, authenticated by him and al-Dhahabi agreed. See: Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib, 1/273.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this in the morning and evening, Allah will enliven his heart.

adhkar.title: We have reached the evening and at this...
adhkar.arabicText: أمسَينا وأمسَى الملك لِلهِ رَبِّ العالمينَ، اللَّهُـمَّ إني أسألكَ خيرَ هذه الليلة: فَتْحَها، ونَصْرَها، ونورَها، وبَرَكَتَها، وهُدَاها، وأعوذُ بكَ من شر ما فيهِا وشر ما بعدَها.
adhkar.transliteration: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-yawm, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.)For the evening, the supplication is read as follows: (Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathihil-laylah, fat-haha, wanasraha, wanooraha, wabarakataha, wahudaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feeha washarri ma baAAdaha
adhkar.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it. For the evening, the supplication is read as follows: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/322 برقم 5084. وحسن إسناده شعيب وعبد القادر الأرناؤوط في تحقيق زاد المعاد 2/373.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يصبح ويمسي سبع مرات كفاه الله ما أهمه من أمر الدنيا والآخرة .
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will suffice him for what concerns him of worldly and hereafter matters
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/322, no. 5084. Shu'ayb and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut graded its chain as good in their verification of Zad al-Ma'ad, 2/373.

adhkar.title: We enter the evening upon the fitrah of Islam...
adhkar.arabicText: أمسَينا على فِطْرَةِ الإسلامِ، وعلى كَلِمَةِ الإخلاصِ، وعلى دينِ نَبِيِّنَا محمدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وعلى مِلَّةِ أبينا إبراهيمَ، حَنيفاً مُسلماً وما كان من المُشرِكينَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Asbahna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen
adhkar.translation: We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah. (fitrah: the religion of Islam, the way of Ibraheem u.)(Note: for the evening, one reads amsayna instead of asbahna.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أحمد 3/406 و407 برقم 15360 و15563، والنسائي، وابن السني برقم 34. وانظر: صحيح الجامع 4/209.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلم أصحابه هذا الذكر
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ahmad 3/406-7, nos. 15360 and 15563, al-Nasa'i, and Ibn al-Sunni, no. 34. See: Sahih al-Jami', 4/209.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would teach his companions this remembrance.

adhkar.title: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him
adhkar.arabicText: سُبْحانَ اللهِ وبِحَمْدِهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih
adhkar.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. (one hundred times)
adhkar.fadl: من قالها مائة مرة حين يصبح وحين يمسي لم يأت أحد يوم القيامة بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد قال مثل ما قال أو زاد
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it one hundred times in the morning and evening, no one will bring anything better on the Day of Resurrection except someone who said the same or more

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except...
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ، وهوَ على كل شيءٍ قَديرٌ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. ([ten times or once if lazy])
adhkar.sourceReference: صحيح البخاري برقم 6404، صحيح مسلم برقم 2693.
adhkar.fadl: عشرَ مرَّات أَوْ مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ، ومن قالها عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ.
adhkar.fadlEn: Ten times, or once if lazy. Whoever says it ten times is like one who freed four slaves from the descendants of Ishmael
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Sahih al-Bukhari, no. 6404, Sahih Muslim, no. 2693.

adhkar.title: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from...
adhkar.arabicText: أعوذُ بِكَلِماتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ من شر ما خَلَقَ.
adhkar.transliteration: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
adhkar.translation: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created. (three times in the evening)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أحمد 2/290 برقم 7898، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 590، وابن السني برقم 68. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/187.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يمسي ثلاث مرات لم تضرّه حُمَة تلك الليلة
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it three times in the evening, no poisonous sting will harm him that night
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Ahmad 2/290, no. 7898, al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 590, and Ibn al-Sunni, no. 68. See: Sahih al-Tirmidhi, 3/187.

adhkar.title: O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وسَلِّمْ على نَبَيِّنَا محمدٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin
adhkar.translation: ‘O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.’ [ten times]
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه الطبراني بإسنادين أحدهما جيد. انظر: مجمع الزوائد 10/120، وصحيح الترغيب والترهيب 1/273 برقم 656.
adhkar.fadl: من صلّى عليَّ حين يصبح عشراً، وحين يمسي عشراً، أدركته شفاعتي يوم القيامة
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever sends blessings upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening, my intercession will reach him on the Day of Resurrection
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tabarani with two chains, one of which is good. See: Majma' al-Zawa'id 10/120, and Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib 1/273, no. 656.

adhkar.title: I ask Allah for forgiveness
adhkar.arabicText: أستغفرُ اللهَ (ثلاثاً) اللَّهُمَّ أنتَ السلامُ، ومنكَ السلامُ، تبارَكتَ يا ذا الجلالِ والإِكرامِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Astaghfirul-lah (Allahumma antas-salam waminkas-salam, tabarakta ya thal-jalali wal-ikram
adhkar.translation: I ask Allah for forgiveness.(three times) (O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.) (AS-Salam: The One Who is free from all defects and deficiencies.)
adhkar.fadl: عن ثوبان رضي الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا انصرف من صلاته استغفر ثلاثاً وقال: «اللهم أنت السلام ومنك السلام تباركت يا ذا الجلال والإكرام»
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/414.
adhkar.fadlEn: Thawban reported: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) finished his prayer, he would ask for forgiveness three times and say: 'O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.'

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except...
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وحدهُ لا شريكَ لهُ، لهُ الملكُ ولهُ الحمدُ وهوَ على كل شيءٍ قديرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لا مانعَ لما أعطَيتَ، ولا معطيَ لما منعتَ، ولا ينفعُ ذا الجدِّ منكَ الجدُّ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, allahumma la maniAAa lima aAAtayt, wala muAAtiya lima manaAAt, wala yanfaAAu thal-jaddi minkal-jad
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty.
adhkar.fadl: من قال دبر كل صلاة: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له...
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 1/255 and Muslim 1/414.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says after every prayer: 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, with no partner...'

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except...
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وحدهُ لا شريكَ لهُ، لهُ الملكُ، ولهُ الحمدُ، وهو على كل شيءٍ قديرٌ. لا حولَ ولا قوةَ إلا باللّهِ، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ، ولا نعبُدُ إلا إياهُ, لهُ النعمَةُ ولهُ الفضلُ ولهُ الثناءُ الحسنُ، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ مخلصينَ لهُ الدينَ ولو كَرِهَ الكافرُونَ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer. la hawla wala quwwata illa billah, la ilaha illal-lah, wala naAAbudu illa iyyah, lahun-niAAmatu walahul-fadl walahuth-thana-ol- hasan, la ilaha illal-lah mukhliseena lahud-deen walaw karihal-kafiroon
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. There is no might nor power except with Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we worship none except Him. For Him is all favour, grace, and glorious praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we are sincere in faith and devotion to Him although the disbelievers detest it.
adhkar.fadl: من قال دبر كل صلاة: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له... كانت له كفارة لذنوبه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 1/255 and Muslim 1/414.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this after every prayer, his sins will be forgiven...

adhkar.title: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for...
adhkar.arabicText: سبحانَ اللهِ، والحَمدُ للهِ، واللهُ أكبَرُ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وحدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلكُ ولهُ الحَمدُ وهو على كلِّ شيءٍ قديرٌ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanal-lah walhamdu lillah, wallahu akbar (thirty-
adhkar.translation: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the greatest.(thirty-three times) (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.)
adhkar.fadl: من سبح الله دبر كل صلاة ثلاثاً وثلاثين وحمد الله ثلاثاً وثلاثين وكبر الله أربعاً وثلاثين فذلك تسع وتسعون ثم قال: لا إله إلا الله... غفرت ذنوبه
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever glorifies Allah after every prayer 33 times, praises Allah 33 times, magnifies Allah 34 times, and then says 'La ilaha illallah...' his sins will be forgiven.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/418.

adhkar.title: What to say after completing the prayer 5
adhkar.arabicText: ۞ بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قل هو اللهُ أحدٌ ۞ اللهُ الصمدُ ۞ لم يلد ولم يُولَد ۞ ولم يكن لهُ كفواً أحدٌ﴾، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قل أعوذُ بربِّ الفلقِ ۞ من شر ما خلقَ ۞ ومن شر غاسقٍ إذا وقبَ ۞ ومن شر النَّفَّاثاتِ في العُقَدِ ۞ ومن شر حاسدٍ إذا حَسَدَ﴾، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قل أعوذُ بربِّ النَّاسِ ۞ ملكِ النَّاسِ ۞ إلهِ النَّاسِ ۞ مِن شر الوَسوَاسِ الخَنَّاسِ ۞ الذي يُوَسوِسُ في صدورِ النَّاسِ ۞ من الجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾
adhkar.transliteration: Bsm Allah alrhmn alrhym qul huwa alllahu ahadun alllahu alssamadu lam yalid walam yuwlad walam yakun llahu kufuwaan ahadun, bsm Allah alrhmn alrhym qul a'uwdhu birabbi alfalaqi min sharri maa khalaqa wamin sharri ghaasiqin iidhaa waqaba wamin sharri alnnaffaathaati fi al'uqadi wamin sharri haasidin iidhaa hasada, bsm Allah alrhmn alrhym qul a'uwdhu birabbi alnnaasi maliki alnnaasi iilahi alnnaasi min sharri alwaswaasi alkhannaasi alladhiy yuwaswisu fi suduwri alnnaasi mina aljinnahi wa alnnaasi ba'da kulli salahin
adhkar.translation: The following three Soorahs should be recited once after Zuhr, 'Asr and 'Ishaa prayers and thrice after the Fajr and Maghrib prayers.Soorah al-Ikhlaas Soorah al-Falaq Soorah an-Naas
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يتعوذ بالمعوذات دبر كل صلاة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 2/8 and Fath al-Bari 9/62.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would seek refuge with the Mu'awwidhat (Quls) after every prayer.

adhkar.title: What to say after completing the prayer 6
adhkar.arabicText: أعوذ بالـلـه من الشيطان الـرجـيم ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ هُـوَ الْـحَيُّ الْـقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأخذُهُ سنَةٌ ولا نومٌ لهُ ما في السَّمَاوَاتِ وما في الأَرضِ من ذا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بإِذنهِ يعْلَمُ ما بينَ أيدِيهِمْ وما خلفَهُمْ ولا يُحيطُونَ بِشيءٍ مِّن عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسعَ كُرْسيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤودُهُ حِفظُهُمَا وهوَ العَليُّ العَظيمُ ۞ ﴾ [البقرة: ٢٥٥]
adhkar.transliteration: Alllahu la iilaha iila huwa alhayyu alqayyuwmu la taakhudhuhu sinahun wala nawmun llahu maa fi alssamawaati wamaa fi alardi man dhaa alladhiy yashfa'u 'indahu iila biiidhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aydiyhim wamaa khalfahum wala yuhiytuwna bishay'in mmin 'ilmihi iila bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kursiyyuhu alssamawaati waalarda wala yauuwduhu hifzuhumaa wahuwa al'aliyyu al'aziymu 'aqiba klli salahin
adhkar.translation: It is also from the Sunnah to recite Aayat ul-Kursee after each prayer:Soorah al-Baqarah, Aayah 255
adhkar.sourceReference: النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 100، وابن السني برقم 121. وصححه الألباني في صحيح الجامع 5/339.
adhkar.fadl: من قرأها دبر كل صلاة لم يمنعه من دخول الجنة إلا أن يموت
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites it after every prayer, nothing prevents him from entering Paradise except death
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 100, and Ibn al-Sunni, no. 121. Authenticated by al-Albani in Sahih al-Jami' 5/339.

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except...
adhkar.arabicText: (لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وحدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلكُ ولهُ الحَمدُ يُحيي ويُميتُ وهو على كل شيءٍ قَديرٌ). عشرَ مراتٍ بعدَ صلاةِ المغربِ والصبحِ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, yuhyee wayumeet, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, He gives life and causes death and He is over all things omnipotent.(ten times after the maghrib and fajr prayers)
adhkar.sourceReference: رواه الترمذي 5/515 وأحمد 4/227. وانظر تخريجه في زاد المعاد 1/300.
adhkar.fadl: من قال عشر مرات دبر صلاة المغرب أو الصبح: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له... كتب الله له عشر حسنات
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Tirmidhi 5/515 and Ahmad 4/227. See its grading in Zad al-Ma'ad 1/300.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this ten times after Maghrib or Fajr prayer, Allah will record ten good deeds for him.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which...
adhkar.arabicText: (اللَّهُمَّ إني أَسألكَ علماً نافعاً، ورزقاً طَيباً، وعملاً مُتقبَّلاً). بعدَ السلامِ من صلاةِ الفجرِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.(after salam from fajr prayer
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable. (To be said after giving salam for the fajr prayer)
adhkar.sourceReference: ابن ماجه وغيره. وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 1/152 ومجمع الزوائد 10/111.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء بعد صلاة الفجر
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ibn Majah and others. See Sahih Ibn Majah 1/152 and Majma' al-Zawa'id 10/111.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication after the Fajr prayer.

adhkar.title: When retiring to his bed every night, the...
adhkar.arabicText: يَجْمَعُ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْفُثُ فِيهِمَا فَيَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قل هو اللهُ أحدٌ ۞ اللهُ الصمدُ ۞ لم يلد ولم يُولَد ۞ ولم يكن لهُ كفواً أحدٌ ۞ ﴾، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قل أعوذُ بربِّ الفلقِ ۞ من شر ما خلقَ ۞ ومن شر غاسقٍ إذا وقبَ ۞ ومن شر النَّفَّاثاتِ في العُقَدِ ۞ ومن شر حاسدٍ إذا حَسَدَ ۞ ﴾، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قل أعوذُ بربِّ النَّاسِ ۞ ملكِ النَّاسِ ۞ إلهِ النَّاسِ ۞ مِن شر الوَسوَاسِ الخَنَّاسِ ۞ الذي يُوَسوِسُ في صدورِ النَّاسِ ۞ من الجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ ۞ ﴾ ثمَّ يمسَحُ بهمَا ما استَطَاعَ من جَسَدِهِ يبدَأُ بهمَا على رأسهِ ووجهِهِ وما أقبَلَ من جَسَدِهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: yajma'u kaffayhi thumma yanfuthu fiyhimaa fayaqraau fiyhimaa:bsm Allah alrhmn alrhym qul huwa alllahu ahadun alllahu alssamadu lam yalid walam yuwlad walam yakun llahu kufuwaan ahadun. bsm Allah alrhmn alrhym qul a'uwdhu birabbi alfalaqi min sharri maa khalaqa wamin sharri ghaasiqin iidhaa waqaba wamin sharri alnnaffaathaati fi al'uqadi wamin sharri haasidin iidhaa hasada. bsm Allah alrhmn alrhym qul a'uwdhu birabbi alnnaasi maliki alnnaasi iilahi alnnaasi min sharri alwaswaasi alkhannaasi alladhiy yuwaswisu fi suduwri alnnaasi mina aljinnahi wa alnnaasi thumma yamsahu bihimaa maa astataa'a min jasadihi yabdaau bihimaa 'alaa raasihi wawajhihi wamaa aqbala min jasadihi)) (yf'lu dhlk thlatha mrraatin
adhkar.translation: When retiring to his bed every night, the Prophet would hold his palms together, spit (A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle. in them, recite the last three chapters (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas. of the Quran and then wipe over his entire body as much as possible with his hands, beginning with his head and face and then all parts of the body, he would do this three times.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أوى إلى فراشه جمع كفيه ثم نفث فيهما وقرأ المعوذات
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 6/61 and Muslim 4/2083.
adhkar.fadlEn: When the Prophet went to his bed, he would cup his hands together, blow into them, and recite the Mu'awwidhat (Quls).

adhkar.title: Recite Ayat-Al-Kursiy (Al-Baqarah :255)
adhkar.arabicText: أعوذ بالـلـه من الشيطان الـرجـيم ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ هُـوَ الْـحَيُّ الْـقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأخذُهُ سنَةٌ ولا نومٌ لهُ ما في السَّمَاوَاتِ وما في الأَرضِ من ذا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بإِذنهِ يعْلَمُ ما بينَ أيدِيهِمْ وما خلفَهُمْ ولا يُحيطُونَ بِشيءٍ مِّن عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسعَ كُرْسيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤودُهُ حِفظُهُمَا وهوَ العَليُّ العَظيمُ ۞ ﴾ [البقرة: ٢٥٥]
adhkar.transliteration: Alllahu la iilaha iila huwa alhayyu alqayyuwmu la taakhudhuhu sinahun wala nawmun llahu maa fi alssamawaati wamaa fi alardi man dhaa alladhiy yashfa'u 'inـــــــــــdahu iila biiidhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aydiyhim wamaa khalfahum wala yuhiytuwna bishay'in mmin 'ilmihi iila bimaa shaa' wasi'a kursiyyuhu alssamawaati waalarda wala yauuwduhu hifzuhumaa wahuwa al'aliyyu al'aziymu
adhkar.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
adhkar.fadl: إذا أويت إلى فراشك فاقرأ آية الكرسي، فإنه لن يزال عليك من الله حافظ ولا يقربك شيطان حتى تصبح
adhkar.fadlEn: When you go to your bed, recite Ayat al-Kursi, for there will remain over you a protector from Allah, and no devil will approach you until morning.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari with al-Fath 4/487.

adhkar.title: Recite last two verses of Soorah (Al-Baqarah :285-286)
adhkar.arabicText: ﴿آمنَ الرسولُ بما أُنزِلَ إليهِ من ربهِ والمُؤمِنُونَ كلٌّ آمنَ باللهِ وملآئكتِهِ وكتبِهِ ورُسلِهِ لا نفَرِّقُ بينَ أحدٍ من رسلِهِ وقالُواْ سمعنَا وأطَعنَا غُفرانَكَ ربَّنا وإليكَ المَصِيرُ ۞ لا يُكلِّفُ اللهُ نفْساً إلا وسعَهَا لها ما كسَبَتْ وعليهَا ما اكتَسَبَتْ ربَّنا لا تؤاخِذنَا إن نَّسِينَا أو أخطَأنا ربَّنا ولا تَحمِلْ علينَا إصراً كما حملتَهُ على الذينَ من قَبلِنَا ربَّنا ولا تُحَمِّلْنَا ما لا طاقةَ لنا به واعفُ عَنَّا واغفِرْ لنا وارحَمْنَآ أنتَ مولاَنَا فانصُرنَا على القَومِ الكَافِرِينَ﴾ [البقرة: ٢٨٥-٢٨٦]
adhkar.transliteration: Amana alrrasuwlu bimaa aunzila iilayhi min rrabbihi waalmuuminuwna kullun amana bialllahi wamalaiikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi la nufarriqu bayna ahadin mmin rrusulihi waqaaluwa sami'naa waata'naa ghufraanaka rabbanaa waiilayka almasiyru la yukallifu alllahu nafsaan iila wus'ahaa lahaa maa kasabat wa'alayhaa maa aktasabat rabbanaa la tuuaakhidhnaa iin nnasiynaa aw akhtaanaa rabbanaa wala tahmil 'alaynaa iisraan kamaa hamaltahu 'alaa alladhiyna min qablinaa rabbanaa wala tuhammilnaa maa la taaqaha lanaa bihi waa'fu 'annaa waaghfir lanaa waarhamnaa anta mawlanaa faansurnaa 'alaa alqawmi alkaafiriyna
adhkar.translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. We seek Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination. Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
adhkar.sourceReference: سورة البقرة 285-286. البخاري مع الفتح 9/94 ومسلم 1/554.
adhkar.fadl: من قرأ الآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Surah al-Baqarah 285-286. Al-Bukhari with al-Fath 9/94 and Muslim 1/554.

adhkar.title: In Your name my Lord, I lie down...
adhkar.arabicText: باسمِكَ ربي وضعْتُ جَنْبي، وبكَ أرفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وإن أرسَلْتَهَا فاحفَظهَا، بما تحفَظُ به عِبادكَ الصَّالِحينَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismika rabbee wadaAAtu janbee wabika arfaAAuh, fa-in amsakta nafsee farhamha, wa-in arsaltaha fahfathha bima tahfathu bihi AAibadakas-saliheen
adhkar.translation: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.
adhkar.fadl: إذا أتيت مضجعك فتوضأ وضوءك للصلاة ثم اضطجع على شقك الأيمن ثم قل: اللهم إني أسلمت وجهي إليك...
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari, no. 6320 (11/126) and Muslim, no. 2714 (4/2084).
adhkar.fadlEn: When you come to your bed, perform ablution like for prayer, then lie on your right side and say: 'O Allah, I submit my face to You...'

adhkar.title: O Allah, verily You have created my soul...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إنكَ خلقْتَ نفْسِي وأنتَ توفَّاها، لكَ مماتُهَا ومحياها، إن أحييتَهَا فاحفَظهَا، وإن أمَتَّها فاغفِر لها. اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ العَافِيَةَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsee wa-anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wamahyaha in ahyaytaha fahfathha, wa-in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafiyah
adhkar.translation: O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take it’s life, to You belongs it’s life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take it’s life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant me good health.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أوى إلى فراشه قال هذا الدعاء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 4/2083 and Ahmad 2/79.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication when going to his bed.

adhkar.title: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ قِني عذابكَ يومَ تَبْعَثُ عِبادَكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma qinee AAathabaka yawma tabAAathu AAibadak
adhkar.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء عند النوم
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 4/2083 and Ahmad 2/79.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication at bedtime.

adhkar.title: Bismikal-lahumma amootu wa-ahya.
adhkar.arabicText: بِاسمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أموتُ وأَحْيا.
adhkar.transliteration: Biasmika Allahumma amwtu waahyaa
adhkar.translation: In Your name O Allah, I live and die.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود برقم 5045 (4/311). وانظر صحيح الترمذي 3/143.
adhkar.fadl: إذا أتيت مضجعك فقل: باسمك اللهم أموت وأحيا
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud, no. 5045 (4/311). See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/143.
adhkar.fadlEn: When you go to your bed, say: 'In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.'

adhkar.title: How Perfect Allah is
adhkar.arabicText: سُبحَانَ اللهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) والحَمدُ للهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) واللهُ أكبَرُ (أربعاً وثلاثينَ).
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanal-lah. (thirty-
adhkar.translation: How Perfect Allah is. (thirty-three times. All praise is for Allah.(thirty-three times. Allah is the greatest.(thirty-four times)
adhkar.fadl: من قالها قبل النوم فهي خير من خادم
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this before sleep, it is better than a servant.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/311. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/143.

adhkar.title: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّماواتِ السَّبْع وربَّ الأرضِ، وربَّ العَرشِ العظيمِ، ربَّنا وربَّ كل شيءٍ، فالقَ الحَبِّ والنَّوى، ومُنزِلَ التورَاةِ والإنجيلِ، والفُرقانِ، أعوذُ بكَ من شر كل شيءٍ أنتَ آخِذٌ بناصيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أنتَ الأولُ فليسَ قبلَكَ شيءٌ، وأنتَ الآخرُ فليسَ بعدَكَ شيءٌ، وأنتَ الظاهرُ فليسَ فوقكَ شيءٌ، وأنتَ الباطنُ فليْس دونَكَ شيءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وأغنِنَا مِنَ الفَقْرِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAA, warabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem, rabbana warabba kulli shay/, faliqal-habbi wannawa, wamunazzilat-tawra, wal-injeel, walfurqan, aAAoothu bika min sharri kulli shayin anta akhithun binasiyatih. Allahumma antal-awwal, falaysa qablaka shay/, wa-antal-akhir, falaysa baAAdaka shay/, wa-antath-thahir falaysa fawqaka shay/, waantal-batin, falaysa doonaka shay/, iqdi AAannad-dayna wa-aghnina minal-faqr
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock (i.e. You have total mastery over). O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You.You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You.Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty. (Tawrah: The book revealed to Moosa u.)(Injeel: The book revealed to Easa u.)(Furqan: One of the many names of the Quran, means: The Criterion which distinguishes between truth and falsehood.)(Aththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.)
adhkar.fadl: من قالها عند النوم غفر له ذنبه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/2084.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this at bedtime, his sins will be forgiven.

adhkar.title: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us...
adhkar.arabicText: الحَمدُ للهِ الذي أطعَمَنا وسَقانا، وكَفانا، وآوَانا، فكم مِمَّنْ لا كافيَ لهُ ولا مؤْوِيَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamana wasaqana, wakafana, wa-awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu'wee
adhkar.translation: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.
adhkar.fadl: إذا أكل أحدكم طعاماً ثم قال: الحمد لله الذي أطعمني هذا... غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari with al-Fath 7/71 and Muslim 4/2091.
adhkar.fadlEn: When one of you eats food and then says: 'Alhamdulillah...' his previous sins are forgiven.

adhkar.title: O Allah, Knower of the seen and the...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عالِمَ الغَيْبِ والشهادَةِ فاطرَ السَّمواتِ والأرضِ، ربَّ كل شيءٍ ومليكَهُ، أشهَدُ أن لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ، أعوذُ بكَ من شر نفسي، ومن شر الشيطانِ وشركِهِ، وأن أقترِفَ على نفسِي سوءاً، أو أجرَّهُ إلى مُسلِمٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, wa-an aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim. (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أوى إلى فراشه قال هذا الدعاء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/2084.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication when going to his bed.

adhkar.title: The Prophet never used to sleep until he...
adhkar.arabicText: يَقرأُ ﴿الم﴾ تنزيلَ السَّجدَةِ، وتباركَ الذي بيَدِهِ المُلكُ.
adhkar.transliteration: yaqraau alm tanziyla alssajdah ِ, watabaaraka alladhy biyadihi almulku
adhkar.translation: The Prophet never used to sleep until he had recited Soorat As-Sajdah (chapter 32) and Soorat Al-Mulk (chapter 67).
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لا ينام حتى يقرأ سورة السجدة والملك
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi 5/168 and al-Hakim 3/560.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would not sleep until he recited Surah al-Sajdah and Surah al-Mulk.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I submit my soul unto You...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أسلَمتُ نَفسي إليكَ، وفوَّضتُ أمري إليكَ، ووجَّهتُ وَجْهي إليكَ، وأَلجَأْتُ ظَهري إليكَ، رَغبةً ورهبَةً إليكَ، لا ملجَأَ ولا منجَا منكَ إلا إليكَ، آمنتُ بكِتابِكَ الذي أنزلتَ، وبنَبيِّكَ الذي أرسَلتَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wafawwadtu amree ilayk, wawajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa-alja/tu thahree ilayk, raghbatan warahbatan ilayk, la maljaa wala manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-lathee anzalt, wabinabiyyikal-lathee arsalt
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You.Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent. (If you then die, you will die upon the fitrah.)(fitrah: the religion of Islam, the way of Ibraheem u.)
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ثم مات من ليلته مات على الفطرة
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it then dies that night, dies upon the fitrah (natural disposition of Islam)
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari, no. 6313 (11/113) and Muslim, no. 2710 (4/2081).

adhkar.title: All praise is for Allah who gave us...
adhkar.arabicText: الحَمدُ للهِ الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتَنا، وإليهِ النُّشُورُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana baAAda ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor
adhkar.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
adhkar.notes: أي الموت المجازي وهو النوم، يقال النوم الموت الخفيف
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يستيقظ من نومه فقد أدى شكر نومه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari with al-Fath 11/113 and Muslim 4/2083.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this when waking up has given thanks for his sleep.

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except...
