adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وحدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلكُ ولهُ الحَمدُ، وهو على كل شيءٍ قديرٌ، سُبحَانَ اللهِ، والحَمدُ للهِ، ولا إلهَ إلا اللهُ، واللهُ أكبَرُ، ولا حَولَ ولا قُوةَ إلا باللهِ العَلِيِّ العظيمِ، ربِّ اغفر لي.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAaliyyil AAatheem. Rabbigh-fir lee
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without associate, to Him belongs sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable. How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme.O my Lord forgive me
adhkar.fadl: من قالها حين يستيقظ غفر له، وإن دعا استجيب له، وإن قام فتوضأ ثم صلى قبلت صلاته
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it when waking up, he is forgiven; if he supplicates, it is answered; if he performs ablution and prays, his prayer is accepted
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari with al-Fath 3/39 and Ibn Majah 2/335.

adhkar.title: All praise is for Allah who restored to...
adhkar.arabicText: الحَمدُ للهِ الذي عافاني في جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee fee jasadee waradda AAalayya roohee wa-athina lee bithikrih
adhkar.translation: All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and has allowed me to remember Him.
adhkar.notes:
الإحياء بعد الإماتة (البعثة)
الإحياء بعد الإماتة (البعثة)
الإحياء بعد الإماتة (البعثة)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء عند الاستيقاظ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi 5/473, no. 3401. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/144.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication upon waking up.

adhkar.title: From Verse 3:190 till the end of the chapter Al-Imran
adhkar.arabicText: ﴿إِنَّ في خلقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ والأَرْضِ واختلافِ اللَّيْلِ والنَّهَارِ لَآياتٍ لأُولي الألبابِ ۞ الذينَ يذكرونَ اللهَ قياماً وقعُوداً وعلى جنوبهِمْ ويتفَكَّرُونَ في خلقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ والأَرْضِ ربَّنا ما خلَقتَ هذا باطلاً سُبحانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ۞ ربَّنا إنَّك من تُدخِلِ النارَ فقد أخزيتهُ وما للظالمينَ من أنصارٍ ۞ ربَّنا إننا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً ينادِي للإيمانِ أن آمنوا بربكم فآمنا ربَّنا فاغفِر لنا ذنوبنا وكفِّر عنا سيِّئاتنا وتوفَّنا مع الأبرارِ ۞ ربَّنا وآتنا ما وعدتنا على رُسُلكَ ولا تُخزنا يوم القيامةِ إنكَ لا تُخلِفُ الميعادَ ۞ فاستَجابَ لهم ربهم أني لا أُضيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ منكم من ذكر أو أنثى بعضكُم من بعض فالذينَ هاجرُواْ وأُخرِجُوا من ديارهم وأُوذوا في سبيلي وقاتلوا وقُتِلوا لأُكفرَنَّ عنهم سيئاتهِم ولأُدخلَنَّهُم جنَّاتٍ تجرِي من تحتِها الأنهارُ ثواباً من عِندِ اللهِ واللهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ ۞ لا يغُرنَّكَ تقلُّبُ الذينَ كَفَرُواْ في البلادِ ۞ مَتاعٌ قَليلٌ ثمَّ مأواهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وبِئْسَ المِهَادُ ۞ لكِن الذينَ اتَّقَوا ربَّهم لهُم جنَّاتٌ تجري من تَحتِها الأنهارُ خالدينَ فيها نزلاً من عندِ اللهِ وما عندَ اللهِ خَيرٌ للأَبرَارِ ۞ وإنَّ من أهلِ الكِتابِ لمن يؤمِنُ باللهِ وما أُنزلَ إليكم ومآ أُنزِلَ إليهم خاشعينَ للهِ لا يشتَرونَ بآياتِ اللهِ ثَمَناً قَليلاً أولئكَ لهم أجرُهُم عند ربهم إن اللهَ سَريعُ الحسَابِ ۞ يا أيها الذينَ آمنوا اصبروا وصابروا ورابطوا واتَّقُوا اللهَ لعلكم تُفلِحُونَ﴾
adhkar.transliteration: Iinna fi khalqi alssamawaati waalardi waakhtilafi alllayli waalnnahaari laayaatin lauwliy alalbaabi alladhiyna yadhkuruwna alllaha qiyaamaan waqu'uwdaan wa'alaaa junuwbihim wayatafakkaruwna fi khalqi alssamawaati waalardi rabbanaa maa khalaqta hadha baatilaan subhaanaka faqinaa 'adhaaba alnnaari rabbanaa iinnaka man tudkhili alnnaara faqad akhzaytahu wamaa lilzzaalimiyna min ansaarin rrabbanaa iinnanaa sami'naa munaadiyaan yunaadiy liliiymaani an aminuwa birabbikum faamannaa rabbanaa faaghfir lanaa dhunuwbanaa wakaffir 'annaa sayyiiaatinaa watawaffanaa ma'a alabraari rabbanaa waatinaa maa wa'adttanaa 'alaa rusulika wala tukhzinaa yawma alqiyaamahi iinnaka la tukhlifu almiy'aada faastajaaba lahum rabbuhum anniy la audiy'u 'amala 'aamilin mminkum mmin dhakarin aw aunthaa ba'dukum mmin ba'din faalladhiyna haajaruwa waaukhrijuwa min diyaarihim waauwdhuwa fi sabiyliy waqaataluwa waqutiluwa laukaffiranna 'anhum sayyiiaatihim walaudkhilannahum jannaatin tajriy min tahtihaa alanhaaru thawaabaan mmin 'indi alllahi waalllahu 'indahu husnu althhawaabi la yaghurrannaka taqallubu alladhiyna kafaruwa fi albiladi mataa'un qaliylun thumma maawaahum jahannamu wabiisa almihaadu lakini alladhiyna attaqawa rabbahum lahum jannaatun tajriy min tahtihaa alanhaaru khaalidiyna fiyhaa nuzulaan mmin 'indi alllahi wamaa 'inda alllahi khayrun llilabraari waiinna min ahli alkitaabi laman yuuminu bialllahi wamaa aunzila iilaykum wamaa aunzila iilayhim khaashi'iyna lillahi la yashtaruwna biayaati alllahi thamanaan qaliylaan auwlaiika lahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim iinna alllaha sariy'u alhisaabiyaa ayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa asbiruwa wasaabiruwa waraabituwa waattaquwa alllaha la'allakum tuflihuwna
adhkar.translation: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding. Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers. Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in Your promise. And their Lord responded to them, Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allah, and Allah has with Him the best reward. Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land. It is but a small enjoyment; then their [final] refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place. But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allah. And that which is with Allah is best for the righteous. And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, [being] humbly submissive to Allah. They do not exchange the verses of Allah for a small price.Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allah is swift in account. O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا استيقظ من نومه قرأ هذه الآيات
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi 5/473. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/144.
adhkar.fadlEn: When the Prophet woke up from sleep, he would recite these verses.

adhkar.title: All Praise is for Allah who has clothed...
adhkar.arabicText: الحَمدُ للهِ الذي كساني هذا (الثَّوبَ) ورَزَقَنيهِ من غير حَوْل مِنِّي ولا قُوَّة.
adhkar.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee kasanee hatha (aththawb) warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah
adhkar.translation: All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أهل السنن إلا النسائي. انظر إرواء الغليل 7/47.
adhkar.fadl: من لبس ثوباً جديداً فقال: الحمد لله الذي كساني هذا... غفر له
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by the Sunan compilers except al-Nasa'i. See Irwa' al-Ghalil 7/47.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever puts on a new garment and says this, his sins will be forgiven.

adhkar.title: O Allah, for You is all praise, You...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لك الحَمدُ أنتَ كسَوتنيهِ، أسألكَ من خَيرِهِ وخَيرِ ما صُنِعَ لهُ، وأعوذُ بكَ من شرهِ وشر ما صُنِعَ لَهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtaneeh, as-aluka min khayrihi wakhayri ma suniAAa lah, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharrihi washarri ma suniAAa lah
adhkar.translation: O Allah, for You is all praise, You have clothed me with it (i.e. the garment), I ask You for the good of it and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of it and the evil for which it was made.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود برقم 4020 والترمذي برقم 1767 والبغوي. واللفظ لأبي داود.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا لبس ثوباً جديداً دعا بهذا الدعاء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud, no. 4020, al-Tirmidhi, no. 1767, and al-Baghawi. The wording is from Abu Dawud.
adhkar.fadlEn: When the Prophet put on a new garment, he would supplicate with this.

adhkar.title: May you wear it out and Allah تعالى...
adhkar.arabicText: تُبلِي ويُخلِفُ اللهُ تَعالى.
adhkar.transliteration: Tublee wayukhliful-lahu taAAala
adhkar.translation: May you wear it out and Allah تعالى replace it (with another).’ The intended meaning: A supplication for long life.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود برقم 4020 (4/41). وانظر صحيح أبي داود 2/760.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا لمن لبس ثوباً جديداً
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud, no. 4020 (4/41). See Sahih Abi Dawud 2/760.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this to someone who put on a new garment.

adhkar.title: Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed
adhkar.arabicText: اِلبَس جَديداً وعِشْ حَمِيداً ومُتْ شَهِيداً.
adhkar.transliteration: Ilbas jadeedan waAAish hameedan wamut shaheedan
adhkar.translation: Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed. (shaheed:One who dies fighting the kuffar in order to make the word of Allah superior or in defense of Islam. It also has other meanings found in the Sunnah such as: the one who dies defending his life, wealth or family; the woman who passes away due to childbirth; one who drowns…etc.)
adhkar.fadl: ابن ماجه 2/ 1178 والبغوي 12/ 41 و
adhkar.fadlEn: Ibn Majah 2/1178 and al-Baghawi 12/41
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Sahih Ibn Majah 2/275.

adhkar.title: Bismil-lah.
adhkar.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi allhi
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah.
adhkar.sourceReference: الترمذي 2/505 برقم 606 وصحيح الجامع 3/203 برقم 3210. وانظر إرواء الغليل برقم 50.
adhkar.fadl: ستر ما بين أعين الجن وعورات بني آدم إذا وضع أحدهم ثوبه أن يقول: بسم الله
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi 2/505, no. 606, and Sahih al-Jami' 3/203, no. 3210. See Irwa' al-Ghalil, no. 50.
adhkar.fadlEn: It is a screen between the eyes of the jinn and the private parts of the children of Adam when one removes his garment to say: In the name of Allah

adhkar.title: In the name of Allah
adhkar.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللهِ اللهم إني أعوذُ بكَ من الخُبثِ والخَبائِث.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lah) allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه البخاري 1/45 ومسلم 1/283. وزيادة بسم الله في أوله متفق عليها.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا دخل الخلاء قال هذا الدعاء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bukhari 1/45 and Muslim 1/283. The addition of 'Bismillah' at its beginning is agreed upon.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication when entering the restroom.

adhkar.title: Ghufranak.
adhkar.arabicText: غُفْرَانَكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Ghufraanaka
adhkar.translation: I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness.
adhkar.sourceReference: الترمذي برقم 7، وأبو داود برقم 30، وابن ماجه برقم 300، والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 79.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا خرج من الخلاء قال: غفرانك
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi, no. 7, Abu Dawud, no. 30, Ibn Majah, no. 300, and al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, no. 79.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say 'Ghufranak' when leaving the restroom.

adhkar.title: Bismil-lah.
adhkar.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi allhi
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah.
adhkar.sourceReference: الترمذي 2/505 برقم 606 وصحيح الجامع 3/203 برقم 3210. وانظر إرواء الغليل برقم 50.
adhkar.fadl: من توضأ وذكر اسم الله تطهر جسده كله، ومن توضأ ولم يذكر اسم الله لم يتطهر إلا ما مسه الماء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi 2/505, no. 606, and Sahih al-Jami' 3/203, no. 3210. See Irwa' al-Ghalil, no. 50.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever performs ablution and mentions Allah's name, his whole body is purified; whoever does not mention Allah's name, only the parts touched by water are purified.

adhkar.title: I bear witness that none has the right...
adhkar.arabicText: أشهَدُ أن لا إلهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وحدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ له وأشهَدُ أن مُحَمَّداً عَبدُهُ ورَسُولُهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh
adhkar.translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.
adhkar.fadl: من توضأ فأحسن الوضوء ثم قال: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله... فتحت له أبواب الجنة الثمانية
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever performs ablution properly and then says: 'I bear witness...' the eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 1/209.

adhkar.title: O Allah, make me of those who return...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجعَلني من التَّوابِينَ واجعَلني من المُتَطَهِّرِينَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummaj-AAalnee minat-tawwabeena wajAAalnee minal-mutatahhireen
adhkar.translation: O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها عند الوضوء فتحت له أبواب الجنة الثمانية يدخل من أيها شاء
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it upon performing ablution, the eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him to enter from whichever he wishes
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi 1/78. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 1/18.

adhkar.title: How perfect You are O Allah, and I...
adhkar.arabicText: سبحانكَ اللَّهُمَّ وبحمدِكَ، أشهَدُ أن لا إلهَ إلاَّ أنتَ، أَستَغفِرُكَ وأتوبُ إليكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk
adhkar.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You.
adhkar.fadl: النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة ص173 و
adhkar.fadlEn: Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah p. 173
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Irwa' al-Ghalil 1/135 and 2/94.

adhkar.title: In the name of Allah, I place my...
adhkar.arabicText: بسمِ اللهِ، توكَّلتُ على اللهِ، ولا حَولَ ولا قوةَ إلا باللهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lah, tawakkaltu AAalal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
adhkar.fadl: إذا خرج الرجل من بيته فقال: بسم الله توكلت على الله... قال: حسبك، هديت وكفيت ووقيت
adhkar.fadlEn: When a man leaves his home and says: 'Bismillah, I place my trust in Allah...' it will be said: 'You are guided, sufficed, and protected.'
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/151.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I take refuge with You lest...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ بكَ أن أَضِلَّ، أو أُضَلَّ، أو أَزِلَّ، أو أُزَلَّ، أو أَظْلِمَ، أو أُظْلَمَ، أو أَجْهَلَ، أو يُجْهَلَ عَليَّ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an adilla aw odal, aw azilla aw ozall, aw athlima aw othlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala AAalay
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly. (slip: i.e. to commit a sin unintentionally)
adhkar.sourceReference: أهل السنن. وانظر صحيح الترمذي 3/152 وصحيح ابن ماجه 2/336.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا الدعاء عند خروجه من منزله
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: The compilers of the Sunan. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/152 and Sahih Ibn Majah 2/336.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would supplicate with this when leaving his home.

adhkar.title: In the name of Allah we enter and...
adhkar.arabicText: بسمِ اللهِ ولجنَا، وبسمِ اللهِ خرجنَا، وعلى اللهِ ربِّنا توكَّلنَا، ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّم على أهلِهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lahi walajna, wabismil-lahi kharajna, waAAala rabbina tawakkalna
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.
adhkar.fadl: إذا دخل الرجل بيته فذكر الله عند دخوله وعند طعامه قال الشيطان: لا مبيت لكم ولا عشاء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/325.
adhkar.fadlEn: When a man enters his home and mentions Allah at his entrance and while eating, Satan says: 'There is no shelter for you here tonight and no food.'

adhkar.title: O Allaah, place within my heart light; and...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجعَل في قلبي نوراً، وفي لساني نوراً، وفي سَمعي نوراً، وفي بصري نوراً، ومن فوقي نوراً، ومن تحتي نوراً، وعن يميني نوراً، وعن شمالي نوراً، ومن أمامي نوراً، ومن خلفي نوراً، واجعَل في نفسي نوراً، وأَعظِم لي نوراً، وعَظِّم لي نوراً، واجعَل لي نوراً، واجعَلني نوراً، اللَّهُمَّ أعطني نوراً، واجعَل في عَصَبي نوراً، وفي لَحمِي نوراً، وفي دمي نوراً، وفي شَعري نوراً، وفي بَشَري نوراً)(اللَّهُمَّ اجعَل لي نوراً في قَبرِي.. ونوراً في عِظَامي)(وزِدني نوراً، وزِدني نوراً، وزِدني نوراً)(وَهَبْ لي نوراً على نورٍ).
adhkar.transliteration: Allaahummaj 'al fee qalbee nooran, wa fee lisaanee nooran, wa fee sam'ee nooran, wa fee basaree nooran, wa min fawqee nooran, wa min tahtee nooran, wa 'an yameenee nooran, wa 'an shimaalee nooran, wa min 'amaamee nooran, wa min khalfee nooran. Wa j'al fee nafsee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran. Waj'al lee nooran, waj'alnee nooran. Allaahumma a'tineje nooran, waj'al fee 'asabee nooran, wa fee lahmee nooran, wa fee damee nooran, wa fee sha'ree nooran, wa fee basharee nooran.Allaahummaj'al lee nooran fee qabree, wa nooran fee 'idhaamee.Wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran.Wa hab lee nooran 'alaa noor
adhkar.translation: ‘O Allaah, place within my heart light; and upon my tongue light; and within my ears light; and within my eyes light; and place above me light; and beneath me light; and on my right light; and on my left light; and in front of me light; and behind me light; and place light within my soul; and augment light for me; and greaten light for me; and grant me light and make me light. O Allaah, bestow upon me light; and place light in my tendons; and light in my flesh; and light in my blood; and in light in my hair and light in my skin.’ O Allaah, place light for me in my grave and light in my bones. And increase me with light and increase me with light and increase me with light. And grant me light upon light.’
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا الدعاء عند ذهابه إلى المسجد
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 11/116, no. 6316 and Muslim 1/526, 529, 530, no. 763.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would supplicate with this when going to the mosque.

adhkar.title: I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and...
adhkar.arabicText: (يبدأُ برجلِهِ اليُمنَى) ، ويقول: (أعوذُ باللهِ العظيم، وبوَجههِ الكَريم، وسُلطانهِ القَديم، من الشَّيطانِ الرجيمِ) [بسمِ اللهِ، والصَّلَاةُ] [والسلامُ على رسولِ اللهِ] (اللَّهُمَّ افتَح لي أبوابَ رَحمَتِكَ).
adhkar.transliteration: aAAoothu billahil-AAatheem wabiwajhihil-kareem wasultanihil-qadeem minash-shaytanir-rajeem, bismil-lah, wassalatu wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah , allahumma iftah lee abwaba rahmatik
adhkar.translation: I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود. وانظر صحيح الجامع برقم 4591.
adhkar.fadl: إذا دخل أحدكم المسجد فليقل: اللهم افتح لي أبواب رحمتك
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud. See Sahih al-Jami', no. 4591.
adhkar.fadlEn: When one of you enters the mosque, let him say: 'O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.'

adhkar.title: In the name of Allah, and prayers and...
adhkar.arabicText: (يبدأُ برجلِهِ اليُسرَى) ويقول: (بسمِ اللهِ والصلاةُ والسلامُ على رسولِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ من فَضلِك، اللَّهُمَّ اعصِمني من الشيطانِ الرجيمِ).
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lah wassalatu wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah, allahumma innee as-aluka min fadlik, allahumma iAAsimnee minash-shaytanir-rajeem
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil.
adhkar.sourceReference: الحاكم 1/218 والبيهقي 2/442. حسنه الألباني في السلسلة الصحيحة برقم 2478. وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 1/129.
adhkar.fadl: إذا خرج أحدكم من المسجد فليقل: اللهم إني أسألك من فضلك
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Hakim 1/218, al-Bayhaqi 2/442. Al-Albani declared it hasan in Silsilah al-Ahadith al-Sahihah, no. 2478. See Sahih Ibn Majah 1/129.
adhkar.fadlEn: When one of you leaves the mosque, let him say: 'O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.'

adhkar.title: One repeats just as the mu-aththin (one who...
adhkar.arabicText: يقولُ مثلَ ما يقولُ المؤَذِّنُ إلا في (حَيَّ على الصَّلاةِ وحَيَّ على الفلاحِ) فيقولُ: (لا حولَ ولا قُوَّةَ إلا باللهِ).
adhkar.transliteration: Yaquwlu mithla maa yaquwlu almuuadhhinu iila fi ((hayya 'alaa alssalaahi wahayya 'alaa alfalaahi)) fayquwlu: ((la hawla wala quwwaha iila bialllahi
adhkar.translation: ‘One repeats just as the mu-aththin (one who calls to prayer. says, except when he says: Hayya AAalas-salah (or. hayya AAalal-falah ‘come to prayer, come to success’ instead, one should say: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah. ‘There is no might nor power except with Allah.’
adhkar.fadl: إذا سمعتم المؤذن فقولوا مثل ما يقول
adhkar.fadlEn: When you hear the mu'adhdhin, repeat what he says.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 1/152 and Muslim 1/288.

adhkar.title: Immediately following the declaration of faith called by...
adhkar.arabicText: يقولُ: (وأنا اشهَد أن لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ وأنَّ محمداً عَبْدُهُ ورسولُهُ، رَضيتُ باللهِ ربَّاً، وبِمحمدٍ رسولاً، وبالإسلامِ ديناً) (يقولُ ذلكَ عَقِبَ تشهُّدِ المُؤَذِّنِ).
adhkar.transliteration: Immediately following the declaration of faith called by the mu-aththin, one says:Wa-ana ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh, radeetu billahi rabban wabimuhammadin rasoolan wabil-islami deena
adhkar.translation: Immediately following the declaration of faith called by the mu-aththin, one says:'And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His salve and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Muhammad as a Messenger and Islam as a religion.'
adhkar.fadl: من قال حين يسمع النداء: وأنا أشهد... دخل الجنة
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this when hearing the call to prayer will enter Paradise.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/290.

adhkar.title: One should then send prayers on the Prophet...
adhkar.arabicText: يصلِّي على النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بعدَ فراغِهِ من إجابةِ المُؤَذِّنِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Yusalliy 'alaa alnnabiy sla Allah 'lyh wslm ba'da faraaghihi min iijaabahi almuuadhhini
adhkar.translation: ‘One should then send prayers on the Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam. after answering the call of the mu.adhdhin’.
adhkar.fadl: من صلى على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم صلاة صلى الله عليه بها عشرا
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever sends blessings upon the Prophet once, Allah will send ten blessings upon him
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/288.

adhkar.title: O Allah, Owner of this perfect call and...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ هذه الدَّعوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، والصلاةِ القائِمَةِ، آتِ محمداً الوسيلةَ والفضيلَةَ، وابعَثْهُ مقاماً محموداً الذي وَعَدْتَهُ، [إنكَ لا تُخْلِفُ المِيعَادَ]
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hathihid-daAAwatit-tammah, wassalatil-qa-imah ati Muhammadan alwaseelata wal-fadeelah, wabAAath-hu maqaman mahmoodan allathee waAAadtah, innaka la tukhliful-meeAAad
adhkar.translation: ‘O Allah, Owner of this perfect call and Owner of this prayer to be performed, bestow upon Muhammad al-waseelah and al-fadeelah and send him upon a praised platform which You have promised him. Verily, You never fail in Your promise.’al-waseelah: A station in paradise.al-fadeelah: A rank above the rest of creation.praised platform: One in which all of creation will praise him on, in order to bring about the account quickly and be relieved from the lengthy standing or the role of intercession.
adhkar.fadl: من قال حين سماع الأذان: اللهم رب هذه الدعوة التامة... حلت له شفاعة محمد يوم القيامة
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this when hearing the adhan will receive the intercession of Muhammad on the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 1/152. The addition is from al-Bayhaqi 1/410.

adhkar.title: One should also supplicate for himself during the...
adhkar.arabicText: يَدعُو لنَفسِهِ بينَ الأذانِ والإقامةِ فإنَّ الدعاءَ حِينَئذٍ لا يُرَدُّ.
adhkar.transliteration: yad'uw linafsihi bayna aladhaani waaliiqaamahi faiinna alddu'aa'a hiynaiidhin la yuraddu
adhkar.translation: One should also supplicate for himself during the time between the athan and the iqamah as supplication at such time is not rejected.
adhkar.sourceReference: الترمذي وأبو داود وأحمد. وانظر إرواء الغليل 1/262.
adhkar.fadl: الدعاء بين الأذان والإقامة لا يرد
adhkar.fadlEn: Supplication between the Adhan and Iqamah is not rejected
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud, and Ahmad. See Irwa' al-Ghalil 1/262.

adhkar.title: O Allah, distance me from my sins just...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ باعد بيني وبينَ خطايايَ كما باعدتَ بينَ المَشرقِ والمَغربِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقني من خطايايَ كما يُنَقى الثوبُ الأبيَضُ من الدنسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغسِلني من خطايايَ، بالثلج والماءِ والبَرَدِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma baAAid baynee wabayna khatayaya kama baAAadta baynal-mashriqi walmaghrib, allahumma naqqinee min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, allahummagh-silnee min khatayaya biththalji walma/i walbarad
adhkar.translation: O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You have distanced The East from The West, O Allah, purify me of my sins as a white robe is purified of filth, O Allah, cleanse me of my sins with snow, water, and ice.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء في افتتاح الصلاة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 1/181 and Muslim 1/419.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication at the beginning of the prayer.

adhkar.title: How perfect You are O Allah, and I...
adhkar.arabicText: سبحانكَ اللَّهُمَّ وبحمدِكَ، وتباركَ اسمُكَ، وتعالى جَدُّكَ، ولا إلهَ غيرُكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika watabarakas-muka wataAAala jadduka wala ilaha ghayruk
adhkar.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. Blessed be Your name, and lofty is Your position and none has the right to be worshipped except You.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أصحاب السنن الأربعة. وانظر صحيح الترمذي 1/77 وصحيح ابن ماجه 1/135.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يستفتح الصلاة بهذا الدعاء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by the four Sunan compilers. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 1/77 and Sahih Ibn Majah 1/135.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would open the prayer with this supplication.

adhkar.title: I have turned my face sincerely towards He...
adhkar.arabicText: وَجَّهتُ وجهيَ للذي فطَرَ السماوات والأرضَ حَنيفاً وما أنا من المُشركينَ، إن صلاتي، ونُسُكي، ومَحْيَايَ، ومَمَاتي للهِ ربِّ العالمينَ، لا شريكَ لهُ وبذلكَ أُمرتُ وأنا من المُسلمينَ. اللَّهُمَّ أنتَ المَلِكُ لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ، أنتَ ربِّي وأنا عبدُكَ، ظَلَمتُ نفسي واعترفتُ بذنبي فاغفِر لي ذنوبي جميعاً إنهُ لا يَغفِرُ الذنوبَ إلا أنتَ. واهدني لِأحسَنِ الأخلاقِ لا يَهدي لِأحسنِها إلا أنتَ، واصرِف عني سَيئَها، لا يصرِفُ عني سَيئَها إلا أنتَ، لبَّيكَ وسَعْدَيْكَ، والخيرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَـدَيْكَ، والشر ليسَ إليكَ، أنا بكَ وإليكَ، تباركتَ وتَعالَيْتَ، أَستَغْفِرُكَ وأَتوبُ إليكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fataras-samawati wal-arda haneefan wama ana minal-mushrikeen, inna salatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, la shareeka lahu wabithalika omirtu wa-ana minal-muslimeen. Allahumma antal-maliku la ilaha illa ant. anta rabbee wa-ana AAabduk, thalamtu nafsee waAAtaraftu bithanbee faghfir lee thunoobee jameeAAan innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.wahdinee li-ahsanil-akhlaqi la yahdee li-ahsaniha illa ant, wasrif AAannee sayyi-aha la yasrifu AAannee sayyi-aha illa ant, labbayka wasaAAdayk,walkhayru kulluhu biyadayk, washsharru laysa ilayk, ana bika wa-ilayk, tabarakta wataAAalayt, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk
adhkar.translation: I have turned my face sincerely towards He who has brought forth the heavens and the Earth and I am not of those who associate (others with Allah). Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, no partner has He, with this I am commanded and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant, I have wronged my own soul and have acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins except You. Guide me to the best of characters for none can guide to it other than You, and deliver me from the worst of characters for none can deliver me from it other than You. Here I am, in answer to Your call, happy to serve you. All good is within Your hands and evil does not stem from You. I exist by your will and will return to you. Blessed and High are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent unto You. (Allah does not create pure evil which does not have any good or contain any benefit, wisdom or mercy at all, nor does He punish anyone without having commited a sin. Something can be good in terms of its creation when viewed in a particular perspective and at the same time be evil when viewed in another way. Allah created the devil and by him, He tests His servants, so there are those who hate the devil, fight him and his way and they stand at enmity towards him and his followers and there are others who are at allegiance with the devil and follow his steps. So evil exists in His creatures by His will and wisdom, not in His actions or act of creating.)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء عند افتتاح الصلاة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/534.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication at the beginning of the prayer.

adhkar.title: O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ جبرائيلَ، وميكائيلَ، وإسرافيلَ، فَاطِرَ السماوات والأرضِ، عالِمَ الغيبِ والشهادةِ أنتَ تَحكُمُ بينَ عبادِكَ فيما كانوا فيهِ يختلفونَ. اهدِني لما اختُلِفَ فيهِ منَ الحق بإذنِكَ إنكَ تَهدي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إلى صِرَاطٍ مُستَقيمٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma rabba jibra-eel, wameeka-eel, wa-israfeel fatiras-samawati walard, AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, anta tahkumu bayna AAibadika feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon. ihdinee limakh-tulifa feehi minal-haqqi bi-ithnik, innaka tahdee man tasha-o ila siratin mustaqeem
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel (great angles), Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Knower of the seen and the unseen. You are the arbitrator between Your servants in that which they have disputed. Guide me to the truth by Your leave, in that which they have differed, for verily You guide whom You will to a straight path.
adhkar.fadl: من قال هذا الدعاء استجاب الله له
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/534.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this supplication, Allah will answer him.

adhkar.title: Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great...
adhkar.arabicText: (اللهُ أكبَرُ كبيراً، اللهُ أكبَرُ كبيراً، اللهُ أكبَرُ كبيراً، والحَمدُ للهِ كثيراً، والحَمدُ للهِ كثيراً، والحَمدُ للهِ كثيراً، وسُبحَانَ اللهِ بُكرَةً وأَصيلاً) ثلاثاً (أعوذُ باللهِ مِنَ الشيطانِ: مِنْ نَفْخِهِ، ونَفْثِهِ، وهَمْزِهِ).
adhkar.transliteration: Allahu akbaru kabeera, Allahu akbaru kabeera, Allahu akbaru kabeera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, wasubhanal-lahi bukratan wa-aseela.)(aAAoothu billahi minash-shaytani min nafkhihi wanafthihi wahamzih
adhkar.translation: Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great, much praise is for Allah, much praise is for Allah, much praise is for Allah, and I declare the perfection of Allah in the early morning and in the late afternoon. (I take refuge with Allah from the devil, from his pride, his poetry and his madness.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 1/203 وابن ماجه 1/265 وأحمد 4/85. وأخرجه مسلم عن ابن عمر بنحوه 1/420.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الذكر في افتتاح الصلاة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 1/203, Ibn Majah 1/265, Ahmad 4/85. Muslim narrated a similar version from Ibn 'Umar 1/420.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this remembrance at the beginning of the prayer.

adhkar.title: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لكَ الحَمدُ، أنتَ نورُ السماواتِ والأرضِ ومن فيهنَّ، ولكَ الحَمدُ أنتَ قيِّمُ السماواتِ والأرضِ ومن فيهنَّ، [ولكَ الحَمدُ أنتَ ربُّ السماواتِ والأرضِ ومن فيهنَّ] [ولكَ الحَمدُ لكَ مُلكُ السماواتِ والأرضِ ومن فيهنَّ] [ولكَ الحَمدُ أنتَ مَلِكُ السماواتِ والأرضِ] [ولكَ الحَمدُ] [أنتَ الحقُّ، ووعدُكَ الحقُّ، وقولُكَ الحقُّ، ولقاؤكَ الحقُّ، والجَنَّةُ حقٌّ، والنَّارُ حقٌّ، والنبِيُّونَ حقٌّ، ومحمدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم حقٌّ، والساعَةُ حقٌّ] [اللَّهُمَّ لكَ أسلَمتُ، وعليكَ توكَّلتُ، وبكَ آمنْتُ، وإليكَ أنبتُ، وبكَ خاصَمْتُ، وإليكَ حاكَمْتُ. فاغفِرْ لِي ما قَدَّمْتُ، وما أَخَّرتُ، وما أَسرَرتُ، وما أَعلَنْتُ] [أنتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وأنتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ] [أنتَ إلهِي لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ]
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamd anta noorus-samawati wal-ardi waman feehin, walakal-hamd, anta qayyimus-samawati walardi waman feehin, walakal-hamd, anta rabbus-samawati walardi waman feehin, walakal-hamd, laka mulkus-samawati walardi waman feehin walakal-hamd, anta malikus-samawati walard walakal-hamd antal-haq, wawaAAdukal-haq, waqawlukal-haq, waliqa-okal-haq, waljannatu haq wannaru haq, wannabiyyoona haq, wa Muhammadun haq, wassaAAatu haq allahumma laka aslamt, waAAalayka tawakkalt, wabika amant, wa-ilayka anabt, wabika khasamt, wa-ilayka hakamt, faghfir lee ma qaddamt, wama akhkhart, wama asrart, wama aAAlant antal-muqaddim, wa-antal-mu-akhkhir, la ilaha illa ant anta ilahee la ilaha illa ant
adhkar.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise, You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise. You are Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise and the kingdom of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise, You are the King of the heavens and the Earth and to You belongs all praise. You are The Truth, Your promise is true, your Word is true, and the Day in which we will encounter You is true, the Garden of Paradise is true and the Fire is true, and the Prophets are true, Muhammad is true and the Final Hour is true. O Allah, unto You I have submitted, and upon You I have relied, and in You I have believed, and to You I have turned in repentance, and over You I have disputed, and to You I have turned for judgment. So forgive me for what has come to pass of my sins and what will come to pass, and what I have hidden and what I have made public. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You, You are my Deity, none has the right to be worshipped except You. (Meaning of Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir: Allah puts forward and favours whom He wills from amongst His creation just as He defers and holds back whom He wills in accordance to His wisdom. E.g. Favouring man over the rest of creation, favouring the Prophets over the rest of mankind, favouring Muhammad over all the Prophets and Messengers…etc.)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا في الصلاة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 11/116 and Muslim 1/532.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would supplicate with this during prayer.

adhkar.title: How perfect my Lord is, The Supreme
adhkar.arabicText: سُبحانَ ربِّيَ العَظيمِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhana rabbiyal-AAatheem
adhkar.translation: How perfect my Lord is, The Supreme.’(three times)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول في ركوعه: سبحان ربي العظيم
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/534.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say in his bowing: 'Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent.'

adhkar.title: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord...
adhkar.arabicText: سُبحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ ربَّنا وبِحَمدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغفِرْ لي.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanakal-lahumma rabbana wabihamdik, allahummagh-fir lee
adhkar.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء في ركوعه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 1/199 and Muslim 1/350.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication in his bowing.

adhkar.title: Subboohun quddoos, rabbul-mala-ikati warrooh.
adhkar.arabicText: سُبُّوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، ربُّ الملائِكَةِ والرُّوحِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subbuwhun, qudduwsun, rabbu almalaiikahi waalrruwhi
adhkar.translation: Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول في ركوعه وسجوده: سبوح قدوس
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/353 and Abu Dawod 1/230.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say in his bowing and prostrating: 'Subboohun Quddoos.'

adhkar.title: O Allah, unto You I have bowed, and...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لكَ ركعْتُ، وبكَ آمنتُ، ولكَ أسلَمتُ، خَشَعَ لكَ سَمعي، وبَصري، ومُخِّي، وعَــــظْمِي، وعَصَبِي، [وما استَقَلَّتْ بِهِ قَدَمِي]
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma laka rakaAAt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt, khashaAAa laka samAAee, wabasaree, wamukhkhee, waAAathmee, waAAasabee, wamas-taqalla bihi qadamee
adhkar.translation: O Allah, unto You I have bowed, and in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, sight, mind, bones, tendons and what my feet carry are humbled before You.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء في ركوعه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/534 and the four compilers except Ibn Majah.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication in his bowing.

adhkar.title: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total...
adhkar.arabicText: سبحانَ ذي الجَبروتِ، والمَلَكوتِ، والكِبرِياءِ، والعَظَمَةِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhana thil-jabaroot, walmalakoot, walkibriya/, walAAathamah
adhkar.translation: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 1/230 والنسائي وأحمد وإسناده حسن.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الذكر في ركوعه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 1/230, al-Nasa'i, and Ahmad. Its chain is good.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this remembrance in his bowing.

adhkar.title: May Allah answer he who praises Him
adhkar.arabicText: سَمِعَ اللهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: SamiAAal-lahu liman hamidah
adhkar.translation: May Allah answer he who praises Him. (This supplication is to be made while rising.)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا رفع رأسه من الركوع قال: سمع الله لمن حمده
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Fath al-Bari, no. 795 (2/282).
adhkar.fadlEn: When the Prophet raised his head from bowing, he would say: 'Allah hears those who praise Him.'

adhkar.title: Our Lord, for You is all praise, an...
adhkar.arabicText: ربَّنا ولكَ الحَمدُ، حَمداً كثيراً طَيِّباً مُباركاً فيهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbana walakal-hamdu hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, for You is all praise, an abundant beautiful blessed praise.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها ابتدرها بضعة وثلاثون ملكا أيهم يكتبها أول
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it, thirty-something angels rush to record it first
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari with al-Fath 2/282.

adhkar.title: The heavens and the Earth and all between...
adhkar.arabicText: ملءَ السماواتِ وملءَ الأرضِ، وما بينهُمَا، وملءَ ما شئتَ من شيءٍ بعدُ. أهلَ الثَّناءِ والمَجدِ، أحقُّ ما قالَ العَبدُ، وكلنَا لكَ عبدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ لا مانعَ لما أعطَيتَ، ولا مُعطيَ لما مَنَعْتَ، ولا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ.
adhkar.transliteration: Mil-as-samawati wamil-al-ard, wama baynahuma, wamil/a ma shi/ta min shay-in baAAd, ahlath-thana-i walmajd, ahaqqu ma qalal-AAabd, wakulluna laka AAabd. Allahumma la maniAAa lima aAAtayt, wala muAAtiya lima manaAAt, wala yanfaAAu thal-jaddi minkal-jad
adhkar.translation: The heavens and the Earth and all between them abound with Your praises, and all that You will abounds with Your praises. O Possessor of praise and majesty, the truest thing a slave has said of You, and we are all Your slaves. O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty. (This supplication is made optionally only in conjunction with the previous one.)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يزيد في هذا الموضع من الصلاة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/535.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would add additional words at this point in the prayer.

adhkar.title: How perfect my Lord is, The Most High
adhkar.arabicText: سُبحانَ ربِّيَ الأعلى.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhana rabbiyal-aAAla
adhkar.translation: How perfect my Lord is, The Most High.’(three times)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول في سجوده: سبحان ربي الأعلى
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/534.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say in his prostration: 'Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.'

adhkar.title: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord...
adhkar.arabicText: سُبحانكَ اللَّهُمَّ ربَّنا وبِحَمدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanakal-lahumma rabbana wabihamdik, allahummagh- fir lee
adhkar.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord, and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء في سجوده
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari and Muslim. Its grading preceded under no. 34.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication in his prostration.

adhkar.title: Subbohoon quddos, rabbul-mala-ikati warrooh.
adhkar.arabicText: سُبوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، ربُّ المَلائِكَةِ والرُّوحِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subbuwhun, qudduwsun, rabbu almalaiikahi waalrruwhi
adhkar.translation: Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول في سجوده: سبوح قدوس
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/533. Preceded under no. 35.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say in his prostration: 'Subboohun Quddoos.'

adhkar.title: O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لكَ سَجدتُ وبكَ آمنتُ، ولكَ أسلَمتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ للذي خَلَقَهُ، وصَوَّرَهُ، وشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وبَصَرَهُ، تَبارَكَ اللهُ أحسنُ الخالِقينَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma laka sajadt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt, sajada wajhee lillathee khalaqahu wasawwarahu washaqqa samAAahu wabasarahu, tabarakal-lahu ahsanul-khaliqeen
adhkar.translation: O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and in You I have believed, and unto You I have submitted. My face has prostrated before He Who created it and fashioned it, and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء في سجوده
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/534 and others.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication in his prostration.

adhkar.title: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total...
adhkar.arabicText: سُبحانَ ذِي الجَبروتِ، والمَلَكُوتِ، والكِبرِياءِ، والعَظَمَةِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhana thil-jabaroot, walmalakoot, walkibriya/, walAAathamah
adhkar.translation: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 1/230 والنسائي وأحمد. وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 166.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الذكر في سجوده
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 1/230, al-Nasa'i, and Ahmad. Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih Abi Dawud 166.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this remembrance in his prostration.

adhkar.title: O Allah, forgive me all of my sins...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغفِرْ لي ذنبي كلهُ: دِقهُ وجلهُ، وأولهُ وآخِرَهُ، وعلانيَّتَهُ وسِرَّهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lee thanbee kullah, diqqahu wajillah, wa-awwalahu wa-akhirah, wa- AAalaniyyatahu wa-sirrah
adhkar.translation: O Allah, forgive me all of my sins, the small and great of them, the first and last of them, and the seen and hidden of them.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يكثر من هذا الدعاء في سجوده
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/350.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would frequently say this supplication in his prostration.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ برضاكَ من سخطكَ، وبمُعافاتِكَ من عقوبتِكَ، وأعوذُ بكَ منكَ، لا أُحصِي ثَناءً عليكَ، أنتَ كما أَثنَيتَ على نفسِكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik, wa-bimuAAafatika min AAuqoobatik, wa-aAAoothu bika mink, la ohsee thana-an AAalayk, anta kama athnayta AAala nafsik
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise, You are as You have praised Yourself.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يتعوذ بالله في سجوده
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/352.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would seek refuge in Allah during his prostration.

adhkar.title: My Lord forgive me, My Lord forgive me
adhkar.arabicText: ربِّ اغفِرْ لي، ربِّ اغفِرْ لي.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbigh-fir lee, rabbigh-fir lee
adhkar.translation: My Lord forgive me, My Lord forgive me.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود برقم 874 (1/231). وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 1/148.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول بين السجدتين: رب اغفر لي
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud, no. 874 (1/231). See Sahih Ibn Majah 1/148.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say between the two prostrations: 'My Lord, forgive me.'

adhkar.title: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغفِرْ لي، وارحَمْني، واهْدِني، واجْبُرني، وعافِني، وارزُقْني، وارْفَعْني.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wajburnee, waAAafinee, warzuqnee warfaAAnee
adhkar.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, enrich me, give me health, grant me sustenance and raise my rank.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أصحاب السنن إلا النسائي. وانظر صحيح الترمذي 1/90 وصحيح ابن ماجه 1/148.
adhkar.fadl: إذا قرأ ابن آدم السجدة فسجد اعتزل الشيطان يبكي
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by the Sunan compilers except al-Nasa'i. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 1/90 and Sahih Ibn Majah 1/148.
adhkar.fadlEn: When the son of Adam recites a prostration verse and prostrates, Satan withdraws weeping.

adhkar.title: My face fell prostrate before He who created...
adhkar.arabicText: سَجَدَ وجهيَ للذي خَلَقَهُ، وشَقَّ سَمعَهُ وبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وقُوَّتِهِ، ﴿فتبارَكَ اللهُ أَحسَنُ الخالقينَ﴾.
adhkar.transliteration: Sajada wajhee lillathee khalaqahu washaqqa samAAahu wabasarahu bihawlihi waquwwatih { tabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeen}
adhkar.translation: My face fell prostrate before He who created it and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing by His might and power.<< So Blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
adhkar.sourceReference: الترمذي 2/474 وأحمد 6/30 والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/ 220 والزيادة له
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقرأ القرآن ويسجد في السجدة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi 2/474 and Ahmad 6/30 and al-Hakim who authenticated it and al-Dhahabi agreed, 1/220. The addition is from him.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would recite the Quran and prostrate at the prostration verses.

adhkar.title: O Allah, record for me a reward for...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اكتُبْ لي بها عندكَ أجراً، وضَعْ عني بها وِزراً، واجعَلها لي عندكَ ذُخراً، وتقبَّلها مني كما تقبَّلتها من عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummak-tub lee biha AAindaka ajra, wadaAA AAannee biha wizra, wajAAalha lee AAindaka thukhra, wataqabbalha minnee kama taqabbaltaha min AAabdika Dawood
adhkar.translation: O Allah, record for me a reward for this (prostration), and remove from me a sin. Save it for me and accept it from me just as You had accepted it from Your servant Dawood.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا الدعاء في سجود التلاوة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi 2/473 and al-Hakim who authenticated it and al-Dhahabi agreed, 1/219.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would supplicate with this during the prostration of recitation.

adhkar.title: At-tahiyyat is for Allah
adhkar.arabicText: التَّحِيَّاتُ للهِ، والصَّلَواتُ، والطَّيِّباتُ، السلامُ عليكَ أيها النبيُّ ورَحمَةُ اللهِ وبركاتُهُ، السلامُ علينا وعلى عبادِ اللهِ الصالحينَ. أشهدُ أن لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وأشهدُ أن محمداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسولُهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Attahiyyatu lillahi wassalawatu wattayyibat, assalamu AAalayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu warahmatul-lahi wabarakatuh, assalamu AAalayna waAAala AAibadil-lahis-saliheen. Ash-hadu an la ilaha illal-lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh
adhkar.translation: At-tahiyyat is for Allah. All acts of worship and good deeds are for Him. Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you O Prophet. Peace be upon us and all of Allah’s righteous servants. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. (At-tahiyyat: all words which indicate the glorification of Allah. His eternal existence, His perfection and His sovereignty.)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلم أصحابه التشهد في الصلاة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari with al-Fath 1/13 and Muslim 1/ 301
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would teach his companions the tashahhud in prayer.

adhkar.title: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صلِّ على محمدٍ، وعلى آلِ محمدٍ، كما صلَّيتَ على إبراهيمَ، وعلى آلِ إبراهيمَ، إنكَ حميدٌ مجيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ باركْ على محمدٍ وعلى آلِ محمدٍ، كما باركتَ على إبراهيمَ وعلى آلِ إبراهيمَ، إنكَ حميدٌ مجيدٌ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta AAala Ibraheema wa-AAala ali Ibraheem, innaka Hameedun Majeed, allahumma barik AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala ali Muhammad, kama barakta AAala Ibraheema wa-AAala ali Ibraheem, innaka Hameedun Majeed
adhkar.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the followers of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon Ibraheem and upon the followers of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty. O Allah, send blessings upon Mohammad and upon the family of Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon Ibraheem and upon the family of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty. (send prayers: praise and exalt him in the highest and superior of gatherings: that of the closest angels to Allah)((al. has been translated in it’s broadest sense: some scholars are of the view that the meaning here is more specific and that it means: his followers from among his family.)
adhkar.fadl: كيف نصلي عليك يا رسول الله؟ قال: قولوا: اللهم صل على محمد...
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 1/301 and Muslim 1/301.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Companions asked: How should we send blessings upon you? He said: Say: O Allah, bless Muhammad...

adhkar.title: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صلِّ على محمدٍ وعلى أزواجِهِ وذُريتِهِ، كما صلَّيتَ على آلِ إبراهيمَ. وباركْ على محمدٍ وعلى أزواجِهِ وذُريتِهِ، كما باركتَ على آلِ إبراهيمَ. إنكَ حميدٌ مجيدٌ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad wa-AAala azwajihi wathurriyyatihi kama sallayta AAala ali Ibraheem, wabarik AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala azwajihi wathurriyyatih, kama barakta AAala ali Ibraheem. innaka Hameedun Majeed
adhkar.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibraheem, and send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلم أصحابه كيف يصلون عليه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 1/301 and Muslim 1/301.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would teach his companions how to send blessings upon him.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I take refuge in You from...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ بكَ من عذابِ القَبرِ، ومن عذابِ جهنَّمَ، ومن فتنَةِ المَحيَا والمماتِ، ومن شر فتنَةِ المَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, wamin AAathabi jahannam, wamin fitnatil-mahya walmamat, wamin shari fitnatil-maseehid-dajjal
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the torment of the Fire, from the trials and tribulations of life and death and from the evil affliction of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal. (Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind, which every Prophet has warned about. Most of mankind will follow him. He will appear from Asbahan, Iran at the time when the Muslims will conquer Constantinople. He will be given special powers and will make the truth seem false and vice versa. He will claim to be righteous and then he will claim prophethood and finally, divinity. From his features is that he will be blind in his right eye which is a definite proof that contradicts his claim to be Allah as it is a sign of imperfection. The word Kafir will be written between his eyes which every believer, literate or illiterate will recognise.)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يتعوذ بالله من عذاب القبر والنار
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhārī (2/102) and Muslim (1/412)
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would seek refuge in Allah from the punishment of the grave and the Fire.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I take refuge in You from...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ بكَ من عذابِ القَبرِ، وأعوذُ بكَ من فتنَةِ المَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وأعوذُ بكَ من فتنَةِ المَحيَا والمماتِ. اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ بكَ من المَأْثَمِ والمَغْرَمِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatil-maseehid-dajjal, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatil-mahya walmamat. Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-ma/thami walmaghram
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I take refuge in You from the temptation and trial of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of life and death. O Allah, I take refuge in You from sin and debt.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يتعوذ بالله من عذاب القبر وفتنة الدجال
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 1/202, Muslim 1/412.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would seek refuge in Allah from the punishment of the grave and the trial of the Dajjal.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I have indeed oppressed my soul...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني ظَلَمْتُ نفسي ظُلْماً كَثيراً، ولا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إلا أنتَ، فاغفِرْ لي مغفِرَةً من عندكَ وارْحَمْني، إنكَ أنتَ الغَفورُ الرَّحيمُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee thalamtu nafsee thulman katheeran wala yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant, faghfir lee maghfiratan min AAindik warhamnee, innaka antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I have indeed oppressed my soul excessively and none can forgive sin except You, so forgive me a forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy upon me. Surely, You are The Most-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful. (From Yourself: i.e. from Your innermost grace without deserving it and a forgiveness which is befitting to your tremendous generosity.)
adhkar.fadl: هذا الدعاء من أدعية النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في الصلاة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 8/168, Muslim 4/2078.
adhkar.fadlEn: This is one of the Prophet's supplications during prayer.

adhkar.title: O Allah, forgive me for those sins which...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغفِرْ لي ما قدمتُ، وما أَخَّرتُ، وما أَسْرَرْتُ، وما أَعْلَنْتُ، وما أَسْرَفْتُ، وما أنتَ أعْلَمُ به مني. أنتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وأنتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lee ma qaddamtu, wama akhkhart, wama asrartu wama aAAlant, wama asraftt, wama anta aAAlamu bihi minnee, antal-muqaddimu wa-antal-mu-akhkhiru la ilaha illa ant
adhkar.translation: O Allah, forgive me for those sins which have come to pass as well as those which shall come to pass, and those I have committed in secret as well as those I have made public, and where I have exceeded all bounds as well as those things about which You are more knowledgeable. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You. (Meaning of Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir: Allah puts forward and favours whom He wills from amongst His creation just as He defers and holds back whom He wills in accordance to His wisdom. E.g. Favouring man over the rest of creation, favouring the Prophets over the rest of mankind, favouring Muhammad over all the Prophets and Messengers…etc.)
adhkar.fadl: كان آخر ما يقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بين التشهد والتسليم
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/534.
adhkar.fadlEn: This was the last thing the Prophet would say between the tashahhud and taslim.

adhkar.title: O Allah, help me to remember You, to...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَعني على ذِكرِكَ، وشكرِكَ، وحُسنِ عِبادَتِكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma aAAinnee AAala thikrik, washukrik, wahusni AAibadatik
adhkar.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of manners.
adhkar.sourceReference: Abū Dāwud (#1522, 2/86) and al-Nasāʾī (3/53). Al-Albānī authenticated it in Ṣaḥīḥ Abī Dāwud (1/284)
adhkar.fadl: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لمعاذ: والله إني لأحبك، فلا تدعن أن تقول دبر كل صلاة: اللهم أعني على ذكرك وشكرك وحسن عبادتك
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abū Dāwud (#1522, 2/86) and al-Nasāʾī (3/53). Al-Albānī authenticated it in Ṣaḥīḥ Abī Dāwud (1/284)
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said to Mu'adh: By Allah, I love you, so do not leave saying after every prayer: 'O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.'

adhkar.title: O Allah, I take refuge in You from...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ بكَ من البُخل، وأعوذُ بكَ من الجُبنِ، وأعوذُ بكَ من أن أُرَدَّ إلى أَرْذَلِ العمُرِ، وأعوذُ بكَ من فِتنَةِ الدنيا وعذابِ القَبْرِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-bukhl, wa-aAAoothu bika minal-jubn, wa-aAAoothu bika min an oradda ila arthalil- AAumur, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatid-dunya waAAathabil-qabr
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from miserliness and cowardice, I take refuge in You lest I be returned to the worst of lives “i.e. old age, being weak, incapable and in a state of fear”, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of this life and the punishment of the grave.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يتعوذ بالله من البخل والجبن
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari, cf. Fath al-Bari 6/35.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would seek refuge in Allah from miserliness and cowardice.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I ask You to grant me...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ الجَنَّةَ وأعوذُ بكَ من النَّارِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-alukal-jannah, wa-aAAoothu bika minan-nar
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You to grant me Paradise and I take refuge in You from the Fire.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود. وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه 2/328.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها في دبر الصلاة غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud. See also: Sahih Ibn Majah 2/328.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this after prayer, his previous sins will be forgiven.

adhkar.title: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بعلمِكَ الغَيبَ وقُدرَتكَ على الخَلقِ أَحيِني ما عَلِمْتَ الحياةَ خيراً لي، وتوفَّني إذا عَلِمْتَ الوَفاةَ خيراً لي، اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ خَشْيَتَكَ في الغَيبِ والشهادةِ، وأسألكَ كلمةَ الحقِّ في الرضا والغَضَبِ، وأسألكَ القَصْدَ في الغِنَى والفَقْرِ، وأسألكَ نَعيماً لا يَنفدُ، وأسألكَ قرَّةَ عينٍ لا تنقَطِعُ، وأسألكَ الرضا بعدَ القَضاءِ، وأســــألكَ بَرْدَ العَيْشِ بعدَ الموتِ، وأسألكَ لَذةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ إلى لِقائكَ في غَيرِ ضراءَ مُضِرَّةٍ، ولا فتنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زيِّنَا بزينَةِ الإيمانِ، واجعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma biAAilmikal-ghayb, waqudratika AAalal-khalq, ahyinee ma AAalimtal-hayata khayran lee watawaffanee itha AAalimtal-wafata khayran lee, allahumma innee as-aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi washshahadah, wa-as-aluka kalimatal-haqqi fir-rida walghadab, wa-as-alukal-qasda fil-ghina walfaqr, wa-as-aluka naAAeeman la yanfad, wa-as-aluka qurrata AAaynin la tanqatiAA, wa-as-alukar-rida baAAdal-qada/, wa-as-aluka bardal-AAayshi baAAdal-mawt, wa-as-aluka laththatan-nathari ila wajhik, washshawqa ila liqa-ik fee ghayri darraa mudirrah, wala fitnatin mudillah, allahumma zayyinna bizeenatil-eeman wajAAalna hudatan muhtadeen
adhkar.translation: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know such life to be good for me and take me if You know death to be better for me. O Allah, make me fearful of You whether in secret or in public and I ask You to make me true in speech, in times of pleasure and anger.I ask you to make me moderate in times of wealth and poverty and I ask You for everlasting bliss and joy which will never cease.I ask You to make me pleased with what You have decreed and for an easy life after death.I ask You for the sweetness of looking upon Your Face and a longing to encounter You in a manner which does not entail a calamity which will bring about harm nor a trial which will cause deviation. O Allah, beautify us with the adornment of faith and make us of those who guide and are rightly guided.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلم أصحابه هذا الدعاء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: An-Nasa'i 3/54, 55, and Ahmad 4/364. See also: Sahih An-Nasa'i 1/281.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would teach his companions this supplication.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I ask You O Allah, as...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ يا اللهُ بأنكَ الواحِدُ الأحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الذي لم يَلِدْ ولَم يولَدْ، ولم يكن لهُ كُفُواً أحدٌ، أن تَغْفِرَ لي ذنوبي إنكَ أنتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِّيمُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka ya Allah bi-annakal-wahidul-ahadus-samad, allathee lam yalid walam yoolad, walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad, an taghfira lee thunoobee innaka antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You O Allah, as You are The One, The Only, AS-Samad, The One who begets not, nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him that You forgive me my sins for verily You are The Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful. (AS-Samad: The Self-Sufficient Master, Possessor of perfect attributes whom all of creation turn to in all their needs.)
adhkar.fadl: من قالها غفر الله له ذنوبه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: An-Nasa'i 3/52, and Ahmad 4/338. See also: Sahih An-Nasa'i 1/280.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this, Allah will forgive his sins.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I ask You as unto You...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ بأن لكَ الحَمدَ لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ وَحدَكَ لا شَريكَ لكَ، المَنَّانُ، يا بديعَ السماواتِ والأرْض يا ذا الجلاَل والإكرامِ، يا حيُّ يا قَيُّومُ إني أسألكَ الجَنَّةَ وأعوذُ بكَ من النَّارِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka bianna lakal-hamd, la ilaha illa ant wahdaka la shareeka lak, almannan, ya badeeAAas-samawati wal-ard, ya thal-jalali wal-ikram, ya hayyu ya qayyoom, innee as-alukal-jannah, wa-aAAoothu bika minan-nar
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner. You are the Benefactor. O Originator of the heavens and the Earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, verily I ask You for Paradise and I take refuge with You from the Fire.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود، والنسائي، وابن ماجه، والترمذي. وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه 2/329.
adhkar.fadl: كان هذا الدعاء من أحب الأدعية إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud, An-Nasa'i, Ibn Majah, and At-Tirmidhi. See also: Sahih Ibn Majah 2/329.
adhkar.fadlEn: This supplication was among the most beloved to the Prophet.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I ask You, as I bear...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ بأني أشهدُ أنكَ أنتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ الأحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الذي لم يَلِدْ ولم يُولَدْ ولم يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma inne as-aluka biannee ashhadu annaka antal-lah, la ilaha illa ant, al-ahadus-samad, allathee lam yalid walam yoolad walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You, as I bear witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, The One, AS-Samad Who begets not nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him. (AS-Samad: The Self-Sufficient Master, Possessor of perfect attributes whom all of creation turn to in all their needs.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 2/62، وابن ماجه 2/1267، والترمذي 5/515، وأحمد 5/360. وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه 2/329، وصحيح الترمذي 3/163.
adhkar.fadl: من دعا الله بهذا الدعاء استجاب له
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 2/62, Ibn Majah 2/1267, At-Tirmidhi 5/515, and Ahmad 5/360. See also: Sahih Ibn Majah 2/329, and Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/163.
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever supplicates Allah with this, He will answer him.

adhkar.title: Istikharah (seeking Allah's Counsel)
adhkar.arabicText: قال جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنهُما: كان رسولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يعَلِّمُنَا الاستِخارَةَ في الأمورِ كلّها كما يُعلِّمُنا السُّورَةَ من القُرآنِ، يقولُ: (إذا هَمَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بالأمرِ فَلْيَركعْ ركعَتَيْنِ من غيرِ الفريضَةِ، ثُمَّ ليقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إني أَستخيرُكَ بعلْمِكَ، وأَستقدِرُكَ بقُدْرَتِكَ، وأسألكَ من فضلِكَ العظيمِ؛ فإنكَ تَقدِرُ ولا أَقدِرُ، وتَعْلَمُ ولا أَعْلَمُ، وأنتَ عَلاَّمُ الغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إن كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هذا الأمرَ - ويُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ - خيرٌ لي في ديني ومعاشي وعاقِبَةِ أمري – أو قالَ: عاجلهِ وآجلهِ - فاقْدُرْهُ لي ويَسِّرْهُ لي ثمَّ بارِكْ لي فيهِ، وإن كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هذا الأمرَ شر لي في ديني ومعاشي وعاقِبَةِ أمري – أو قالَ: عاجلهِ وآجلهِ – فاصرِفهُ عني واصرفني عنهُ واقدُرْ ليَ الخَيرَ حَيثُ كانَ، ثمَّ أَرضني بهِ). وما ندِمَ مَن استَخارَ الخَالقَ، وشاوَرَ المخلوقينَ المُؤْمنينَ وتثبَّتَ في أمرِهِ، فقد قالَ الله تعالى: ﴿وشاوِرهُمْ في الأمرِ فإذا عزَمتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ على اللهِ﴾.
adhkar.transliteration: On the authority of Jabir Ibn AAabdullah , he said: ’The Prophet would instruct us to pray for guidance in all of our concerns, just as he would teach us a chapter from the Quran. He would say ’ If any of you intends to undertake a matter then let him pray two supererogatory units (two rakAAah nafilah) of prayer and after which he should supplicate:Allahumma innee astakheeruka biAAilmik, wa-astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa-as-aluka min fadlikal-AAatheem, fa-innaka taqdiru wala aqdir, wataAAlamu wala aAAlam ,wa-anta AAallamul ghuyoob, allahumma in kunta taAAlamu anna hathal-amr (say your need) khayrun lee fee deenee wamaAAashee waAAaqibati amree faqdurhu lee, wayassirhu lee, thumma barik lee feeh, wa-in kunta taAAlamu anna hathal-amr sharrun lee fee deenee wamaAAashee waAAaqibati amree fasrifhu AAannee wasrifnee AAanh, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kan, thumma ardinee bih.)(One who seeks guidance from his Creator and consults his fellow believers and then remains firm in his resolve does not regret, for Allah has said:washawirhum fee al-amri fa-itha AAazamta fatawakkal AAala Allah)(chapter 3 verse 159
adhkar.translation: On the authority of Jabir Ibn AAabdullah, he said: 'The Prophet would instruct us to pray for guidance in all of our concerns, just as he would teach us a chapter from the Quran. He would say: If any of you intends to undertake a matter then let him pray two supererogatory units (two rakAAah nafilah) of prayer and after which he should supplicate: O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and by Your power I seek strength and I ask You from Your immense favour, for verily You are able while I am not and verily You know while I do not and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this affair - and here he mentions his need - to be good for me in relation to my religion, my life, and end, then decree and facilitate it for me, and bless me with it, and if You know this affair to be ill for me towards my religion, my life, and end, then remove it from me and remove me from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it be and make me satisfied with such. (One who seeks guidance from his Creator and consults his fellow believers and then remains firm in his resolve does not regret, for Allah has said: ...and consult them in the affair. Then when you have taken a decision, put your trust in Allah...)
adhkar.fadl: وما ندم من استخار الخالق، وشاور المخلوقين المؤمنين وتثبت في أمره
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 7/162
adhkar.fadlEn: One who seeks guidance from his Creator and consults his fellow believers and then remains firm in his resolve does not regret.

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except...
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ الواحِدُ القهّارُ، ربُّ السمواتِ والأرضِ وما بَيْنَهُمَا العَزيزُ الغَفَّارُ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahul-wahidul-qahhar, rabbus-samawati wama baynahuma, alAAazeezul-ghaffar
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar.Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all between them, The Exalted in Might, The Oft-Forgiving. (AL-Qahhar:The One Who has subdued all of creation and Whom all of creation are subservient to. All movements occur by His will.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه الحاكم وصححه ووفقه الذهبي 1/ 540 والنسائي في اليوم والليلة وابن السني وانظر صحيح الجامع 4/213
adhkar.fadl: يقول ذلك إذا تقلب من جنب إلى جنب في الليل .
adhkar.fadlEn: He says this when turning from side to side during the night
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Recorded by al-Hakim who authenticated it and al-Dhahabi agreed, 1/540, and al-Nasa'i in al-Yawm wa al-Laylah, and Ibn al-Sunni. See Sahih al-Jami' 4/213.

adhkar.title: I take refuge in the perfect words of...
adhkar.arabicText: أعوذُ بكلماتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ من غَضَبِهِ وعِقابِهِ، وشر عبادهِ، ومن همزاتِ الشياطينِ وأن يَحْضُرُونِ.
adhkar.transliteration: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat min ghadabih,waAAiqabih, washarri AAibadih, wamin hamazatish-shayateen, wa-an yahduroon
adhkar.translation: I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلم أصحابه هذا الدعاء إذا فزعوا في نومهم
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/12. See also: Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/171.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would teach his companions this supplication when they became frightened in their sleep.

adhkar.title: Spit on your left three times)(Spit: A form...
adhkar.arabicText: يَنفُثُ عن يسارِهِ (ثلاثاً) - يستعيذُ باللهِ من الشيطانِ ومن شر ما رَأى (ثلاث مراتٍ) - (لا يُحدِّثْ بها أحَداً) - (يَــتَحَوَّلُ عن جَنبهِ الذي كان عليهِ).
adhkar.translation: [((Spit on your left three times)(Spit: A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle)) - (Seek refuge in Allah from shaytan and the evil of what you saw (Three Times)) - (Do not relate it to anyone) - (Turn and sleep on the opposite side to which you were sleeping on previously.) - (Get up and pray if you so desire.) ]
adhkar.fadl: فَإِنَّهَا لا تَضُرُّهُ
adhkar.fadlEn: Indeed, it will not harm him
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/1773

adhkar.title: Get up and pray if you so desire
adhkar.arabicText: ويَقُومُ يُصلِّي إن أرادَ ذلكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: wyaquwmu yusalliy iin araada dhalika
adhkar.translation: Get up and pray if you so desire.
adhkar.fadl: إذا رأى أحدكم ما يكره فليقم فليصل ولا يحدث بها الناس
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim. See also: Fath al-Bari 12/394.
adhkar.fadlEn: If one of you sees something he dislikes (in a dream), let him get up and pray, and not tell people about it.

adhkar.title: O Allah, guide me along with those whom...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدني فيمَنْ هديْتَ، وعافني فيمَنْ عافَيْتَ، وتولَّني فيمَنْ تولَّيْتَ، وبارِكْ لي فيمَا أعطَيْتَ، وقِني شر ما قَضَيْتَ؛ فإنكَ تَقْضِي ولا يُقْضَى عليكَ، إنهُ لا يَذِلُّ من واليْتَ، [ولا يَعزُّ من عَادَيْتَ]، تَبارَكْتَ ربَّنا وتَعالَيْتَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummah-dinee feeman hadayt, waAAafinee feeman AAafayt, watawallanee feeman tawallayt, wabarik lee fee ma aAAtayt, waqinee sharra ma qadayt, fa-innaka taqdee wala yuqda AAalayk, innahu la yathillu man walayt, [wala yaAAizzu man AAadayt], tabarakta rabbana wataAAalayt
adhkar.translation: O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, grant me security along with those whom You have granted security, take me into Your charge along with those whom You have taken into Your charge. Bless for me that which You have bestowed upon me. Protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. For You decree and none can decree over You. Truly he whom You befriend suffers no indignity. [He whom You take as an enemy is not honored.] Blessed and Exalted are You, Our Lord.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أصحاب السنن الأربعة وأحمد والدرامي والحاكم والبيهقي وما بين المعكوفين للبيهقي وانظر صحيح الترمذي 1/144وصحيح ابن ماجه 1/194 وإرواء الغليل للألباني 2/172
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقنت في الوتر بهذا الدعاء
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by the four Sunan compilers and Ahmad, al-Darimi, al-Hakim, and al-Bayhaqi. What is between the brackets is for al-Bayhaqi. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 1/144 and Sahih Ibn Majah 1/130.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would recite qunut in the witr prayer with this supplication.

adhkar.title: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ برِضاكَ من سَخطِكَ، وبمُعافاتِكَ من عُقُوبَتِكَ، وأعــــوذُ بكَ مِنْكَ، لا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عليكَ، أنتَ كما أثْنَيْتَ على نَفْسِكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik, wabimuAAafatika min AAuqoobatik, wa-aAAoothu bika mink, la ohsee thanaan AAalayk, anta kama athnayta AAala nafsik
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot fully praise You; You are as You have praised Yourself.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلم أصحابه القنوت في الوتر
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would teach his companions qunut in the witr prayer.

adhkar.title: O Allah, it is You we worship, and...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إياكَ نعْبُدُ، ولكَ نُصلِّي ونسجدُ، وإليكَ نَسْعَى ونَحْفِدُ، نرجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذابَكَ، إن عَذابَكَ بالكافِرينَ مُلْحَقٌ. اللَّهُمَّ إنا نَستعينُكَ، ونَستغفِرُكَ، ونثني عليكَ الخيرَ، ولا نكفُرُكَ، ونُؤْمِنُ بكَ، ونَخْضَعُ لكَ، ونَخْلَعُ من يَكْفرُكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma iyyaka naAAbud, walaka nusallee wanasjud, wa-ilayka nasAAa wanahfid, narjoo rahmatak, wanakhsha AAathabak, inna AAathabaka bilkafireena mulhaq. Allahumma inna nastaAAeenuk, wanastaghfiruk, wanuthnee AAalaykal- khayr, wala nakfuruk, wanu/minu bik, wanakhdaAAu lak wanakhlaAAu man yakfuruk
adhkar.translation: O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers.O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You.We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه البيهقي في السنن الكبرى وصحح إسناده 2/211 وقال الشيخ الألباني في إرواء الغليل وهذا إسناد صحيح 2/170 .وهو موقوف على عمر
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا القنوت في الوتر
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bayhaqi in al-Sunan al-Kubra who authenticated its chain, 2/211. Shaykh al-Albani said in Irwa' al-Ghalil: "This chain is authentic," 2/170. It is a mawquf narration from Ibn 'Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would supplicate with this qunut in the witr prayer.

adhkar.title: How perfect The King, The Holy One is
adhkar.arabicText: (سُبحانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ) ثلاثَ مراتٍ والثالثَةُ يَجْهَرُ بها ويَمُدُّ بها صَوتَهُ يقولُ: [ربِّ المَلائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ]
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanal-malikil-quddoos..on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: (Rabbil-mala-ikati warrooh
adhkar.translation: How perfect The King, The Holy One is.(three times. on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).)
adhkar.sourceReference: رواه أبو داود وغيره. وانظر صحيح أبي داود 3/965.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول بعد الوتر: سبحان الملك القدوس
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud and others. See Sahih Abi Dawud 3/965.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say after the witr prayer: 'Glory be to the Sovereign, the Most Holy.'

adhkar.title: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني عبدُكَ، ابنُ عبدِكَ، ابنُ أَمَتِكَ، ناصيَتِي بيدِكَ، ماضٍ فيَّ حكْمُكَ، عدلٌ فيَّ قضاؤُكَ، أسألكَ بكُــــلِّ اسم هُوَ لكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بهِ نفسَكَ، أو أنزَلْتَهُ في كِتَابِكَ، أو عَلَّمْتَهُ أحَداً من خَلْقِكَ، أو اسْتَأثَرْتَ به في عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عندَكَ، أن تجعَلَ القُرآنَ رَبيعَ قلبي، ونورَ صدري، وجلاءَ حُزني، وذَهابَ هَمِّي.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee AAabduk, ibnu AAabdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyatee biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, AAadlun fiyya qada-ok, as-aluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fee kitabik, aw AAallamtahu ahadan min khalqik awis-ta/tharta bihi fee AAilmil-ghaybi AAindak, an tajAAalal-Qurana rabeeAAa qalbee, wanoora sadree, wajalaa huznee wathahaba hammee
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand (i.e. You have total mastery over), Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.
adhkar.fadl: إلا أذهب الله همه وحزنه وأبدله مكانه فرجًا
adhkar.fadlEn: Allah will remove his worries and sorrow and replace them with relief
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ahmad 1/391and authenticated by al-Albani
