adhkar.title: O Allah, I take refuge in You from...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ بكَ من الهَمِّ والحَزَنِ، والعَجزِ والكَسَلِ، والبُخْلِ والجُبْنِ، وضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasali walbukhli waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.
adhkar.sourceReference: البخاري 7/158 كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يكثر من هذا الدعاء.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا الدعاء عند الهم والحزن
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 7/158. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him, used to make this supplication frequently.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would supplicate with this when experiencing worry and grief.

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except...
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ العظيمُ الحليمُ، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ ربُّ العَرْشِ العظيمِ، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ ربُّ السماواتِ وربُّ الأرضِ وربُّ العَرْشِ الكَريمِ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahul-AAatheemul-haleem, la ilaha illal-lahu rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem, la ilaha illal-lahu rabbus-samawati warabbul-ardi warabbul-AAarshil-kareem
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.
adhkar.fadl: دعاء الكرب: لا إله إلا الله العظيم الحليم...
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 7/154 and Muslim 4/2092.
adhkar.fadlEn: The supplication for distress: 'There is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing...'

adhkar.title: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ رَحمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فلا تَكلني إلى نفسي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وأَصْلِحْ لي شأني كُلَّهُ، لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn, wa-aslih lee sha/nee kullah, la ilaha illa ant
adhkar.translation: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs.None has the right to be worshipped except You.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/324 وأحمد 5/42 وحسنه الألباني في صحيح أبو داود 3/ 959
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا عند الكرب
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/324 and Ahmad 5/42 and al-Albani graded it as hasan in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/959.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would supplicate with this when in distress.

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except...
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu minath-thalimeen
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.
adhkar.fadl: الترمذي 5/529 والحاكم وصححه ووفقه الذهبي 1/505 و
adhkar.fadlEn: Al-Tirmidhi 5/529; al-Hakim authenticated it and al-Dhahabi agreed 1/505
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Sahih al-Tirmidhi3/ 168

adhkar.title: None has the right to be worshipped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.
adhkar.arabicText: اللهُ اللهُ ربِّي لا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً.
adhkar.transliteration: Allah Allah rabbiy laa aushriku bihi shayiaan
adhkar.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 2/87 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/335
adhkar.fadl: قالها إبراهيم عليه السلام حين ألقي في النار، وقالها المؤمنون حين رجعوا من الأحزاب
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 2/87 and see Sahih Ibn Majah 2/335
adhkar.fadlEn: Ibrahim said this when he was thrown into the fire, and the believers said it when they returned from the confederates' battle.

adhkar.title: O Allah, we place You before them and...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إنَّا نجعَلُكَ في نُحورِهِم، ونعوذُ بكَ من شُرُورِهِم.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma inna najAAaluka fee nuhoorihim wanaAAoothu bika min shuroorihim
adhkar.translation: O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 2/89 وصححه الحاكم ووافقه الذهبي 2/142
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا الدعاء عند لقاء العدو
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 2/89 and al-Hakim authenticated it and al-Dhahabi agreed 2/142
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would supplicate with this when meeting the enemy.

adhkar.title: O Allah, You are my supporter and You...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أنتَ عَضُدي، وأنتَ نَصيري، بكَ أحولُ وبكَ أصولُ، وبكَ أُقاتِلُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma anta AAadudee, wa-anta naseeree, bika ajoolu wabika asoolu wabika oqatil
adhkar.translation: O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.
adhkar.fadl: أبو داود 3/42 والترمذي 5/572 ،و
adhkar.fadlEn: Abu Dawud 3/42 and al-Tirmidhi 5/572
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Sahih al-Tirmidhi3/183

adhkar.title: Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine...
adhkar.arabicText: حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Hasbunal-lahu waniAAmal-wakeel
adhkar.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee (He is).
adhkar.fadl: الذين قال لهم الناس إن الناس قد جمعوا لكم فاخشوهم فزادهم إيمانا وقالوا حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Qur'an 3:173. Narrated by al-Bukhari 7/162.
adhkar.fadlEn: Those to whom the people said: 'Indeed the people have gathered against you, so fear them,' but it increased them in faith and they said: 'Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.'

adhkar.title: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السماواتِ السَّبْعِ، وربَّ العَرْشِ العظيمِ، كُنْ لي جاراً من فلان بن فلانٍ، وأحزابِهِ من خلائقِكَ، أن يفرُطَ عليَّ أحَدٌ منهُمْ أو يطغَى، عَزَّ جارُكَ، وجلَّ ثناؤُكَ، ولا إلهَ إلا أنتَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allaahumma rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, Kun lee jaaran min (here you mention the person's name) wa 'ahzabihi min khalaa'iqika, 'an yafruta 'alayya 'ahadun minhum 'aw yatghaa,'Azza jaaruka, wa jalla thanaa'uka, wa laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا الدعاء إذا خاف ظلم السلطان
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bukhari, cf. Fath al-Bari 11/119.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would supplicate with this when fearing the ruler's injustice.

adhkar.title: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all...
adhkar.arabicText: اللهُ أكبَرُ، اللهُ أعَزُّ من خَلْقِهِ جميعاً، اللهُ أعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ باللهِ الذي لا إلهَ إلا هوَ، المُمسِكِ السماواتِ السبع أن يقعنَ على الأرْض إلا بِإِذنهِ، من شر عَبْدِكَ فلانٍ، وجنودِهِ وأتْباعِهِ وأشياعِهِ، من الجن والإنسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لي جاراً من شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثناؤُكَ وعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وتبارَكَ اسْمُكَ، ولا إلهَ غَيْرُكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahu 'a'azzu min khalqihi jamee'an, Allaahu 'a'azzu mimmaa 'akhaafu wa 'ahdharu, 'a'oothu billaahil-lathee laa ilaaha illaa huwa, almumsikis-samaawaatis-sab'i 'an yaqa'na 'alaal-'ardhi 'illaa bi'ithnihi, min sharri 'abdika (name of the person) wa junoodihi wa 'atbaa'ihi wa ashyaa'ihi minal-jinni wal'insi, Allaahumma kun lee jaaran min sharrihim, Jalla thanaa'uka wa 'azza aaruka, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruka
adhkar.translation: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. I seek refuge in You Allah from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You. (Recite three times in Arabic)
adhkar.sourceReference: البخاري في الأدب المفرد برقم 708 وصححه الألباني وفي صحيح الأدب المفرد برقم
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يتعوذ بالله من الجبن
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-Mufrad no. 708 and authenticated by al-Albani and in Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad no.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would seek refuge in Allah from cowardice.

adhkar.title: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ مُنزِلَ الكتابِ، سَريعَ الحِسابِ، اهْزِمِ الأحزابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وزَلْزِلْهُمْ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma munzilal-kitab, sareeAAal-hisab, ihzimil-ahzab, allahummah-zimhum wazalzilhum
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو بهذا الدعاء على العدو
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 3/1362
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would supplicate with this against the enemy.

adhkar.title: O Allah, protect me from them with what...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummak-fineehim bima shi/
adhkar.translation: O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء إذا خاف قوماً
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication when fearing a group of people.

adhkar.title: Say: I seek refuge in Allah. (Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.)
adhkar.arabicText: يَسْتَعِيذُ باللهِ ويَنْتَهِي عَمَّا شك فيهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: yasta'iydhu bialllahi w yantahiy 'ammaa shk fiyhi
adhkar.translation: Say: I seek refuge in Allah. (Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.)
adhkar.fadl: إذا وجد أحدكم في صلاته شيئاً فليتعوذ بالله من الشيطان
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bukhari 4/330 and Muslim 1/120.
adhkar.fadlEn: If any of you experiences something during prayer, let him seek refuge in Allah from Satan.

adhkar.title: He should say: ( Amantu billahi warusulih.)
adhkar.arabicText: يَقُولُ: (آمَنْتُ باللهِ ورُسُلِهِ).
adhkar.transliteration: yaquwlu: ((amantu bialllahi warusulihi
adhkar.translation: He should say: I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.)
adhkar.fadl: إذا جاء الشيطان فقال: من خلق كذا فقولوا: آمنت بالله
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 1/120.
adhkar.fadlEn: When Satan comes saying: 'Who created this?' say: 'I believe in Allah.'

adhkar.title: He should also recite the following verse: (He...
adhkar.arabicText: يَقرأُ قَولَهُ تَعالى: ﴿هُوَ الأوَّلُ والآخِرُ والظّاهِرُ والباطِنُ وهُوَ بِكُلِّ شيءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾.
adhkar.transliteration: He should also recite the following verse: (Huwa al-awwalu, waal-akhiru, waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleem
adhkar.translation: He should also recite the following verse: He is The First and The Last, Aththahir and Al-Batin and He knows well all things.)(ththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.)
adhkar.fadl: فإن الله تعالى يقول: {هو الأول والآخر والظاهر والباطن وهو بكل شيء عليم}
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Qur'an 57:3.
adhkar.fadlEn: For Allah says: 'He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.'

adhkar.title: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اكفِني بحلالِكَ عن حرامِكَ، وأَغنِني بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummak-finee bihalalika AAan haramik, wa-aghninee bifadlika AAamman siwak
adhkar.translation: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others.
adhkar.fadl: أذهب الله همه وقضى دينه
adhkar.fadlEn: Allah will remove his worries and settle his debts
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Tirmidhi 5/560 and see Sahih al-Tirmidhi3/ 180

adhkar.title: O Allah, I take refuge in You from...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ بكَ من الهَمِّ والحَزَنِ، والعَجزِ والكَسَلِ، والبُخلِ والجُبنِ، وضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasal, walbukhl, waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.
adhkar.fadl: من قالها كفاه الله همه وقضى دينه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 7/158
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says this, Allah will suffice him against his worry and settle his debt.

adhkar.title: othman Ibn Al-AAas narrated: I said ‘O Messenger...
adhkar.arabicText: أعوذُ بِاللهِ من الشيطانِ الرجيمِ، واتْفُلْ على يَسَارِكَ (ثلاثاً).
adhkar.transliteration: A'uwdhu biallhi mina alshhaytaani alrrajiymi, watful 'alaa yasarika
adhkar.translation: othman Ibn Al-AAas narrated: I said ‘O Messenger of Allah, verily the devil comes between me and my prayer and recitation making me confused’ The Messenger of Allah replied ‘That is a devil called Khanzab, so if you sense his presence then seek refuge in Allah from him and spit (A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle. on your left side three times.
adhkar.sourceReference: مسلم 4/1729 من حديث عثمان بن العاص رضي الله عنه وفيه ففعلت ذلك فأذهبه الله عني
adhkar.fadl: إذا أحس أحدكم بالوسوسة فليقل: آمنت بالله
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/1729 from the hadith of 'Uthman ibn al-'As, may Allah be pleased with him, in which he said: "I did that and Allah removed it from me."
adhkar.fadlEn: If any of you experiences whisperings, let him say: 'I believe in Allah.'

adhkar.title: O Allah, there is no ease except in...
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لا سَهْلَ إلا ما جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وأنتَ تَجْعَلُ الحَزنَ إذا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma jaAAaltahu sahla, wa-anta tajAAalul- hazana in shi'ta sahla
adhkar.translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.
adhkar.sourceReference: رواة ابن حبان في صحيحه برقم 2427 (موارد) وابن السني برقم 351 وقال الحافظ هذا حديث صحيح وصححه عبد القادر الأرناؤوط في تخريج الأذكار للنووي ص106
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول هذا الدعاء إذا استصعب عليه أمر
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Ibn Hibban in his Sahih, no. 2427 (Mawarid), and Ibn al-Sunni, no. 351. Al-Hafiz said: "This hadith is authentic," and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut authenticated it in his verification of Riyad al-Salihin.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say this supplication when something became difficult for him.

adhkar.title: Any servant who commits a sin and as...
adhkar.arabicText: ما من عبدٍ يذنبُ ذَنباً فيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يقومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ إلا غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Maa min 'abdin yudhnibu dhanbaan fayuhsinu alttuhuwra, thumma yaquwmu fayusalliy rak'atayni, thumma yastaghfiruallha illaa ghafara Allah lahu
adhkar.translation: Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer (i.e. two rakAAas) and then seeks Allah's forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 2/86 والترمذي 2/257 وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 1/ 283
adhkar.fadl: من عمل سيئة ثم توضأ ثم صلى ركعتين ثم استغفر الله غفر له
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 2/86 and al-Tirmidhi 2/257 and authenticated by al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1/ 283
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever commits a sin, then performs ablution, prays two units, and seeks forgiveness from Allah, He will forgive him.

adhkar.title: Seeking refuge from him
adhkar.arabicText: الاسْتِعَاذَةُ باللهِ مِنْهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Alasti'aadhahu biallhi minhu
adhkar.translation: Seeking refuge from him.
adhkar.sourceReference: Abū Dāwud (1/206) and al-Tirmidhī. Also see Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tirmidhī (1/77)
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يعوذ بالله من الشيطان
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abū Dāwud (1/206) and al-Tirmidhī. Also see Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tirmidhī (1/77)
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would seek refuge in Allah from Satan.

adhkar.title: The Adhaan [call to prayer
adhkar.arabicText: الأذَانُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Aladhaanu
adhkar.translation: The Adhaan [call to prayer]
adhkar.fadl: من قال لا إله إلا الله خرج من قلبه كل وسوسة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhārī (#608, 1/151) and Muslim (#389, 1/291)
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says 'La ilaha illallah,' every whisper leaves his heart.

adhkar.title: Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts...
adhkar.arabicText: الأذْكارُ وقِرَاءَةُ القُرآنِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Aladhkaaru wa qira'ahu alqurani
adhkar.translation: Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts of remembrance and supplications. (e.g. ‘Do not make your homes like the graveyards, indeed the devils flee from the house in which soorat Al-Baqarah has been read’ related by Muslim 1/539, also supplication and remembrance for the morning & evening, before sleep, when getting up, entering and leaving the toilet, entering and leaving the mosque, the recitation of ayat Al-kursiyy and the last two verses of soorat Al-Baqarah before sleeping, the athan…etc.)
adhkar.fadl: إذا نزغ الشيطان فاستعذ بالله
adhkar.fadlEn: If Satan provokes you, seek refuge in Allah.

adhkar.title: Invocation when something you dislike happens
adhkar.arabicText: قدر الله وما شاءَ فَعَلَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Qaddaral-lah, wama shaa faAAal
adhkar.translation: Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does. (for verily ‘If’ lets in the work of the devil.)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُحْمَدَ. وَقَالَ: إِذَا أَصَابَ أَحَدَكُمْ مَا يَكْرَهُ فَلْيَقُلْ: قَدَّرَ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: If something you dislike happens, say: Allah has decreed and what He wills He does.

adhkar.title: Congratulations for a newborn and its reply
adhkar.arabicText: (بارَكَ اللهُ لكَ في المَوْهُوبِ لكَ، وشَكَرْتَ الوَاهِبَ، وبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، ورُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ). ويَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ المُهــــــنَّأُ فيقولُ: (بارَكَ اللهُ لكَ وبارَكَ عليْكَ، وجزاكَ اللهُ خيراً، ورَزَقَكَ اللهُ مِثْلَهُ، وأَجْزَلَ ثَوابَكَ).
adhkar.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruzigta birrahu. The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakallaahu khayran, wa razaqakallaahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzala thawaabaka
adhkar.translation: May Allah bless you with His gift to you and may you (the new parent. give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness. The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly
adhkar.sourceReference: انظر الأذكار للنووي ص349 وصحيح الأذكار للنووي ، لسليم الهلالي 2/713
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا وُلِدَ لأَحَدِكُمْ وَلَدٌ فَلْيَقُلْ: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See al-Adhkar by al-Nawawi, p. 349, and Sahih al-Adhkar by al-Nawawi, verified by Salim al-Hilali, 2/713.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: When a child is born to one of you, say: May Allah bless you in the gift given to you.

adhkar.title: Seeking protection for children
adhkar.arabicText: كانَ رسولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَوِّذُ الحَسَنَ والحسينَ رضي الله عنهما (أعيذُكُمَا بكلمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّةِ من كُلِّ شيطانٍ وهَامَّةٍ، ومن كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ).
adhkar.transliteration: Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:(OAAeethukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wahammah, wamin kulli AAaynin lammah
adhkar.translation: Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying: I commend you two to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.)
adhkar.sourceReference: البخاري 4/119 من حديث ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُعَوِّذُ الْحَسَنَ وَالْحُسَيْنَ وَيَقُولُ: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 4/119 from the hadith of Ibn 'Abbas, may Allah be pleased with them both.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would seek protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn with these words.

adhkar.title: Visiting the sick: words of comfort
adhkar.arabicText: لا بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إن شاءَ اللهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ba'sa tahoorun in shaal-lah
adhkar.translation: Never mind, may it (the sickness. be a purification, if Allah wills.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا دَخَلَ عَلَى مَرِيضٍ يَعُودُهُ قَالَ: لاَ بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
adhkar.fadlEn: When the Prophet visited a sick person he would say: No harm, purification if Allah wills.

adhkar.title: Visiting the sick: seeking healing
adhkar.arabicText: أسأَلُ اللهَ العَظيمَ ربَّ العَرْشِ العَظيمِ أن يَشْفيَكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Asalul-lahal-AAatheem rabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem an yashfeek (7times
adhkar.translation: I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’.(7times) (he (the sick person. will be cured.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه الترمذي وأبو داود وانظر صحيح الترمذي2/ 210 وصحيح الجامع 5/180
adhkar.fadl: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ لِلْمَرِيضِ: أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَماً
adhkar.fadlEn: Aisha reported that the Prophet would say to the sick: Remove the harm, Lord of mankind, cure and You are the Healer.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud and see Sahih al-Tirmidhi2/ 210 and Sahih al-Jami' 5/180

adhkar.title: The reward for visiting the sick
adhkar.arabicText: قال النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (إذا عادَ الرجُلُ أخاهُ المُسلِمَ مَشى في خِرافَةِ الجَنَّةِ حتى يجلِسَ، فإذَا جلَسَ غمَرَتْهُ الرَّحمَةُ، فإن كانَ غُدوةً صلَّى عليهِ سبعونَ ألفَ مَلَكٍ حتى يُمسيَ، وإن كانَ مساءً صلَّى عليهِ سَبْعُونَ ألفَ مَلَكٍ حتى يُصْبِحَ).
adhkar.transliteration: Qaala alnnabiyyu sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((iidhaa 'aada alrrajulu akhaahu almuslima mashaa fi khiraafahi aljannahi hattaa yajlisa, faiidhaa jalasa ghamarathu alrrahmahu, faiin kaana ghudwahan sallaa 'alayhi sab'uwna alfa malakin hattaa yumsiya, waiin kaana masaa'an sallaa 'alayhi sab'uwna alfa malakin hattaa yusbiha
adhkar.translation: Ali Ibn Abee Talib related that he heard the Messenger of Allah say: ‘If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the morning.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by At-Tirmidhi 3/347. See also: Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/89.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: When a man visits his sick Muslim brother, he walks in the harvest of Paradise until he sits.

adhkar.title: Supplication of the terminally ill
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي، وارحَمني، وأَلحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الأعلى.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee wa-alhiqnee birrafeeqil-aAAla
adhkar.translation: ‘O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْمَرَضِ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari 7/10 and Muslim 4/1893
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say when ill: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, and join me with the Highest Companion.

adhkar.title: Prompting the dying person
adhkar.arabicText: جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عندَ موتِهِ يدخِلُ يديْهِ في الماءِ فَيَمْسَحُ بهمَا وَجْهَهُ، ويقولُ: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ إن للموتِ سَكَرَاتٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) related that The Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) during his illness in which he passed away would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say:La ilaha illal-lah, inna lilmawti lasakarat
adhkar.translation: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa. related that The Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: لَقِّنُوا مَوْتَاكُمْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 1/52.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Prompt your dying to say: There is no god but Allah.

adhkar.title: Remembrance at the moment of death
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ واللهُ أكبَرُ، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ لهُ المُلْكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ ولا حَوْلَ ولا قُوَّةَ إلا بِاللهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, la shareeka lah, la ilaha illal-lahu lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, la ilaha illal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه الترمذي وابن ماجه وصححه الألباني ، وانظر صحيح الترمذي 3/152وصحيح ابن ماجه 2/317
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلاَمِهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Tirmidhi and Ibn Majah and authenticated by al-Albani. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/152 and Sahih Ibn Majah 2/317.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever has his last words be "there is no god but Allah" will enter Paradise.

adhkar.title: Encouraging the dying to say La ilaha illallah
adhkar.arabicText: من كانَ آخِرُ كلامِهِ لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ.
adhkar.transliteration: i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (He whose last words are: (La ilaha illal-lah.) will enter Paradise
adhkar.translation: i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (He whose last words are: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah. will enter Paradise.)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلاَمِهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 3/190 and see Sahih al-Jami' 5/432
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: The person whose last words are "La ilaha illallah" enters Paradise.

adhkar.title: Remembrance when afflicted by calamity
adhkar.arabicText: إنَّا لِلهِ وإنَّا إليهِ راجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أجُرني في مُصيبَتي، وأَخْلِفْ لي خَيْرَاً منها.
adhkar.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa-inna ilayhi rajiAAoon, allahumma/- jurnee fee museebatee wakhluf lee khayran minha
adhkar.translation: To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return.O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ تُصِيبُهُ مُصِيبَةٌ فَيَقُولُ: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْراً مِنْهَا، إِلاَّ آجَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِيهَا وَأَخْلَفَ لَهُ خَيْراً مِنْهَا
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 2/632
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: No servant is afflicted with a calamity and says: To Allah we belong... except that Allah rewards him and gives him better.

adhkar.title: Supplication when closing the eyes of the deceased
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغفِرْ لفلانٍ (باسمِهِ) وارفعْ دَرَجتهُ في المَهْدِيِّينَ، واخْلُفْهُ في عَقِبِهِ في الغَابرينَ، واغفِرْ لنا ولهُ يا ربَّ العالمينَ، وافسَحْ لهُ في قبرِهِ، ونَوِّرْ لهُ فيهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir li-name the dead- warfaAA darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeen, wakhlufhu fee AAaqibihi fil-ghabireen, waghfir lana walahu ya rabbal-AAalameen wafsah lahu fee qabrih, wanawwir lahu feeh
adhkar.translation: O Allah, forgive -here the name of the deceased is mentioned- and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him. (A successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death. This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that Adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated. of Allah on earth because Allah is never absent, and will never die. This supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that Allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent (also refer to supplication #198).)
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَغْمَضَ الْمَيِّتَ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلاَنٍ وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 2/634.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet, when closing the eyes of the deceased, said: O Allah, forgive him and raise his rank.

adhkar.title: Funeral prayer: seeking forgiveness
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغفِر لهُ وارحَمهُ، وعافِهِ، واعفُ عنهُ، وأَكرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، ووَسِّعْ مُدخَلهُ، واغْسِلْهُ بالماءِ والثَّلْجِ والبَرَدِ، ونَقِّهِ من الخطايا كما نَقَّيتَ الثَّوْبَ الأبيضَ من الدنَسِ، وأبدلهُ داراً خيراً من دارِهِ، وأهلاً خيراً من أهلِهِ، وزَوجَاً خيراً من زَوجِهِ، وأدخِلهُ الجَنَّةَ، وأعِذْهُ من عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وعَذَابِ النَّارِ]
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lahu warhamh, waAAafihi, waAAfu AAanh, wa-akrim nuzulah, wawassiAA mudkhalah, waghsilhu bilma-i waththalji walbarad, wanaqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa-abdilhu daran khayran min darih, wa-ahlan khayran min ahlih wazawjan khayran min zawjih, wa-adkhilhul-jannah, wa-aAAithhu min AAathabil-qabr, waAAathabin-nar
adhkar.translation: O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 2/663
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say in the funeral prayer: O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, pardon him...

adhkar.title: Funeral prayer: comprehensive supplication
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغفِر لحيِّنَا ومَيِّتنا، وشاهِدِنا وغائِبِنا، وصَغيرِنا وكَبيرِنا، وذَكَرِنا وأُنْثانا. اللَّهُمَّ من أَحيَيْتَهُ منَّا فأحيِهِ على الإسلامِ، ومن توفَّيْتَهُ منا فَتَوَفَّهُ على الإيمانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، ولا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lihayyina wamayyitina washahidina, wagha-ibina, wasagheerina wakabeerina, wathakarina wa-onthana. Allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa-ahyihi AAalal-islam, waman tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu AAalal-eeman, allahumma la tahrimna ajrah, wala tudillana baAAdah
adhkar.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.
adhkar.fadl: ابن ماجه 1/480 وأحمد 2/368 و
adhkar.fadlEn: Ibn Majah 1/480 and Ahmad 2/368
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Sahih Ibn Majah1/ 251

adhkar.title: Funeral prayer: protection in the grave
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إن فلانَ بن فلاَن في ذمتِكَ، وحبل جوارِكَ، فَقِهِ من فتْنَةِ القَبْرِ، وعذابِ النَّارِ، وأنتَ أَهْلُ الوفاءِ والحَقِّ، فاغفِر لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma inna -name the dead- fee thimmatik, wahabli jiwarik, faqihi min fitnatil-qabr waAAathabin-nar, wa-anta ahlul-wafa/, walhaq, faghfir lahu warhamh, innaka antal-ghafoorur-raheem
adhkar.translation: O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه ابن ماجه ، وانظر صحيح ابن ماجة1/ 251ورواه أبو داود 3/211
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ فَقِهِ فِتْنَةَ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابَ النَّارِ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Ibn Majah. See Sahih Ibn Majah 1/251. Also narrated by Abu Dawud 3/211.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say in the funeral prayer: O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care, protect him from the trial of the grave.

adhkar.title: Funeral prayer: need of Allah's mercy
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ عبدُكَ وابنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إلى رَحْمَتِكَ، وأنتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إن كانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ في حَسَنَاتِهِ، وإن كانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عنهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma AAabduka wabnu amatik, ihtaja ila rahmatik, wa-anta ghaniyyun AAan AAathabih, in kana muhsinan fazid fee hasanatih, wa-in kana museean fatajawaz AAanh
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه مسلم 2/663. وانظر: أحكام الجنائز للألباني ص125.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 2/663. See also: Ahkam al-Jana'iz by al-Albani, p.125.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said in the funeral prayer: O Allah, Your servant is in need of Your mercy...

adhkar.title: Funeral prayer for a deceased child
adhkar.arabicText: (اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ من عذابِ القبرِ) وإن قال: (اللَّهُمَّ اجعَلهُ فَرَطاً وذُخراً لوالِدَيْهِ، وشفيعاً مجاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ به موازينَهُمَا، وأعظِم به أجورَهُمَا، وألحِقهُ بصالِح المُؤمنينَ، واجعَلهُ في كَفَالَةِ إبراهيمَ، وقِهِ برحمَتِكَ عذابَ الجحيمِ، وأبدِلهُ داراً خيراً من دارِهِ، وأهلاً خيراً من أهلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغفِر لأَسلافِنا، وأفراطِنا، ومن سَبَقَنا بالإيمانِ) فَحَسَنٌ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allaahumma 'a'ith-hu min 'athaabil-qabri.) or say:(Allahummaj-AAalhu faratan, wathukhran liwalidayh, washafeeAAan mujaban. Allahumma thaqqil bihi mawazeenahuma wa-aAAthim bihi ojoorahuma, wa-alhiqhu bisalihil-mu'mineen, wajAAalhu fee kafalati Ibraheem, waqihi birahmatika AAathabal-jaheem, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, Allaahum-maghfir li'aslaafinaa, wa afraatinaa wa man sabaqanaa bil'eemaan
adhkar.translation: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave. [It is also good to say] O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good) and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim. Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our children lost by death, and those who have preceded us in faith.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه مالك في الموطأ 1/288 وابن أبي شيبه في المصنف 3/ 217 والبيهقي 4/9، وصحح إسناده شعيب الأرناؤوط في تحقيقه لشرح السنة للبغوي 5/357
adhkar.fadl: قال سعيد بن المسيب صليت وراء أبي هريرة على صبي لم يعمل خطيئة قط فسمعته يقول ... الحديث .
adhkar.fadlEn: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab said: I prayed behind Abu Hurairah over a child who had never committed a sin, and I heard him say... the hadith
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Malik narrated it in al-Muwatta' 1/288, and Ibn Abi Shaybah in al-Musannaf 3/217, and al-Bayhaqi 4/9. Shu'ayb al-Arna'ut authenticated its chain in his verification of Sharh al-Sunnah.

adhkar.title: Supplication for a deceased child
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اجعَلهُ لنا فَرَطاً، وسَلَفاً، وأجراً.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummaj-AAalhu lana farata, wasalafan wa-ajra
adhkar.translation: O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه البغوي في شرح السنة 5/357وعبد الرزاق برقم 6588، وعلقه البخاري في كتاب الجنائز ، 65باب قراءة فاتحة الكتاب على الجنازة 2/113
adhkar.fadl: كان الحسن يقرأ على الطفل بفاتحة الكتاب ويقول ..  الحديث
adhkar.fadlEn: Al-Hasan would recite Surah al-Fatihah over the child and say... the hadith
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Recorded by al-Baghawi in Sharh al-Sunnah 5/357, and 'Abd al-Razzaq, no. 6588, and al-Bukhari in a mu'allaq form in the Book of Funerals, chapter on reciting al-Fatihah over the deceased.

adhkar.title: Words of consolation for the bereaved
adhkar.arabicText: (إن للهِ ما أَخَذَ، ولهُ ما أَعطَى، وكُلُّ شيءٍ عندَهُ بأجلٍ مُسمَّى... فلتَصْبِرْ ولتَحْتَسِبْ). وإن قالَ: (أعْظَمَ اللهُ أجرَكَ، وأحسَنَ عزاءَكَ، وغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ) فَحَسَنٌ.
adhkar.transliteration: Inna lillahi ma akhath, walahu ma aAAta, wakullu shayin AAindahu bi-ajalin musamma
adhkar.translation: Verily to Allah, belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed time…and then he ordered for her to be patient and hope for Allah’s reward. (The words (faltasbir waltahtasib. are commands in the feminine 3rd person form, so they will need to be changed in respect to whom is being addressed.)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari 2/80 and Muslim 2/636
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: To Allah belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave; everything has an appointed term.

adhkar.title: Supplication when placing the deceased in the grave
adhkar.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللهِ وعلى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lahi waAAala sunnati rasoolil-lah
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 3/314بسند صحيح وأحمد بلفظ بسم الله وعلى ملة رسول الله وسنده صحيح
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا وَضَعَ الْمَيِّتَ فِي الْقَبْرِ قَالَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 3/314 with an authentic chain, and Ahmad with the wording: "In the name of Allah and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah" and its chain is authentic.
adhkar.fadlEn: When placing the deceased in the grave, the Prophet would say: In the name of Allah and upon the Sunnah of His Messenger.

adhkar.title: Supplication after burying the deceased
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اغفِر لهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثبِّتْهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allaahum-maghfir lahu Allaahumma thabbithu
adhkar.translation: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him
adhkar.sourceReference: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا فرغ من دفن الميت وقف عليه فقال : استغفروا لأخيكم وسلوا له التثبيت فإنه الآن يُسأل .أبو داود 3/315 والحاكم وصححه ووافقه الذهبي 1/370
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ دَفْنِ الْمَيِّتِ وَقَفَ عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ: اسْتَغْفِرُوا لأَخِيكُمْ وَاسْأَلُوا لَهُ التَّثْبِيتَ فَإِنَّهُ الآنَ يُسْأَلُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: The Prophet, may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him, when he finished burying the deceased, would stand over him and say: "Ask forgiveness for your brother and ask for him to be steadfast, for he is now being questioned." Narrated by Abu Dawud, al-Hakim, and al-Bayhaqi. See Sahih al-Jami', 1/281, no. 1097.
adhkar.fadlEn: After burying the deceased, the Prophet said: Seek forgiveness for your brother and ask for steadfastness for him.

adhkar.title: Supplication when visiting graves
adhkar.arabicText: (السلامُ عليكم أهلَ الديارِ، من المؤمنينَ والمسلمينَ، وإنا إن شاءَ اللهُ بكمْ لاحقونَ، [ويَرحَمُ اللهُ المُستَقدمينَ منا والمُستأخِرينَ] أسالُ اللهَ لنا ولكمُ العافِيةَ).
adhkar.transliteration: Assalamu AAalaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu/mineena walmuslimeen, wa-inna in shaal-lahu bikum lahiqoon, nas-alul-laha lana walakumul-AAafiyah
adhkar.translation: Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you, we ask Allah for well-being for us and you.
adhkar.sourceReference: عن بريدة رضي الله عنه ، وما بين المعكوفين من حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها عند مسلم 2/671
adhkar.fadl: سلمم2/671 ،وابن ماجه واللفظ له 1/494
adhkar.fadlEn: Muslim 2/671; Ibn Majah with his wording 1/494
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: From Buraydah, may Allah be pleased with him. What is between the brackets is from the hadith of 'A'ishah, may Allah be pleased with her, in Muslim, 2/671.

adhkar.title: Supplication when the wind blows
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ خيرَها، وأعوذُ بكَ من شرها.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 4/326وابن ماجه 2/1228 وانظر  صحيح ابن ماجة2/ 305
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا هَبَّتِ الرِّيحُ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 4/326 and Ibn Majah 2/1228. See Sahih Ibn Majah 2/305.
adhkar.fadlEn: When the wind blew, the Prophet would ask Allah for its goodness and seek refuge from its evil.

adhkar.title: Supplication when hearing thunder
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ خيرَها، وخيرَ ما فيها، وخيرَ ما أُرْسِلَتْ بهِ، وأعوذُ بكَ من شرها، وشر ما فيها، وشر ما أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma feeha, wakhayra ma orsilat bih, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha, washarri ma feeha washarri ma orsilat bih
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُحَدِّثُ إِذَا سَمِعَ صَوْتَ الرَّعْدِ تَرَكَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 2/616 and al-Bukhari 4/76
adhkar.fadlEn: When the Prophet heard thunder, he would say: Glory be to Him Whom the thunder glorifies with His praise.

adhkar.title: Remembrance during thunder
adhkar.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanal-lathee yusabbihur-raAAdu bihamdih, walmala-ikatu min kheefatih
adhkar.translation: How perfect He is, (The One. Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.
adhkar.sourceReference: كان عبد الله بن الزبير رضي الله عنهما إذا سمع الرعد ترك الحديث وقال :.... الموطأ 2/992 وقال الألباني صحيح الإسناد موقوفاً
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ سَمَاعِ الرَّعْدِ: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: 'Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, may Allah be pleased with them both, when he heard thunder, would stop talking and say... Al-Muwatta' 2/992. Al-Albani said: "Authentic chain, a mawquf narration."
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say when hearing thunder: Glory be to Allah.

adhkar.title: Supplication when seeking rain
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اسقِنا غَيثاً مُغيثاً مَريئاً مَريعاً، نافعاً غيرَ ضارٍّ، عاجلاً غيرَ آجِلٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummas-qina ghaythan mugheethan maree-an mureeAAan, nafiAAan, ghayra dar, AAajilan ghayra ajil
adhkar.translation: O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 1/303 وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود1/ 216
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا اسْتَسْقَى قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 1/303 and authenticated by al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud1/ 216
adhkar.fadlEn: When the Prophet sought rain, he said: O Allah, send us a beneficial rain.

adhkar.title: Supplication during drought
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثنا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثنا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثنا.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna
adhkar.translation: O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْجَدْبِ: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 1/224, Muslim 2/613.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say during drought: O Allah, relieve us.

adhkar.title: Supplication for rain and mercy
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ اسقِ عبادكَ، وبَهَائِمَكَ، وانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وأحيي بَلَدَكَ المَيِّتَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahummas-qi AAibadak, wabaha-imak, wanshur rahmatak, wa-ahyi baladakal-mayyit
adhkar.translation: O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 1/305 وحسنه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود1/ 218
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ وَبَهَائِمَكَ وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ وَأَحْيِ بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 1/305 and al-Albani graded it as good in Sahih Abi Dawud1/ 218
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your animals.

adhkar.title: Supplication when it rains
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafiAAa
adhkar.translation: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا نَزَلَ الْمَطَرُ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً
adhkar.fadlEn: When it rained, the Prophet said: O Allah, (make it) a beneficial downpour.

adhkar.title: Thanksgiving after rain
adhkar.arabicText: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللهِ ورَحْمَتِهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Mutirnaa bifadli allhi warahmatihi
adhkar.translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ إِذَا مُطِرْنَا: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhārī (#846, 1/205) and Muslim (#71, 1/83)
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say when it rained: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

adhkar.title: Supplication when rain is excessive
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ حَوالينا ولا علينا، اللَّهُمَّ على الآكامِ والظِّرابِ، وبُطونِ الأودِيَةِ، ومَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma hawalayna wala AAalayna, allahumma AAalal-akami waththirab, wabutoonil-awdiyah, wamanabitish-shajar
adhkar.translation: O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, (let it fall. on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhārī (#1013, 1/224) and Muslim (#897, 2/614)
adhkar.fadlEn: When rain was feared harmful, the Prophet said: O Allah, around us and not upon us.

adhkar.title: Allah is the greatest
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُ أكبرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أهلَّهُ علينا بالأمن والإيمانِ، والسَّلامةِ والإسلامِ، والتَّوفيقِ لما تحبُّ ربَّنا وترضَى، ربُّنا وربُّك اللهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu AAalayna bil-amni wal-eeman, wassalamati wal-islam, wattawfeeiqi lima tuhibbu watarda, rabbuna warabbukal-lah
adhkar.translation: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
adhkar.fadl: الترمذي 5/504 والدارمي بلفظه 1/336 و
adhkar.fadlEn: Al-Tirmidhi 5/504 and al-Darimi with his wording 1/336
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Sahih al-Tirmidhi3/ 157

adhkar.title: The thirst has gone and the veins are...
adhkar.arabicText: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وابتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وثَبَتَ الأجْرُ إن شاءَ اللهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Thahabath-thama-o wabtallatil-AAurooq, wathabatal-ajru in shaal-lah
adhkar.translation: The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبي داود 2/306 وغيره وانظر صحيح الجامع 4/209
adhkar.fadl: وثبت الأجر إن شاء الله
adhkar.fadlEn: And the reward is confirmed, Allah willing
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Recorded by Abu Dawud 2/306 and others. See Sahih al-Jami' 4/209.

adhkar.title: Supplication for forgiveness when breaking fast
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ برحمَتِكَ التي وسِعَتْ كُلَّ شيءٍ أن تَغْفِرَ لي.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma inne as-aluka birahmatikal-latee wasiAAat kulla shay, an taghfira lee
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه ابن ماجه 1/557 من دعاء عبد الله بن عمرو رضي الله عنهما ،وحسنه الحافظ في تخريج الأذكار انظر شرح الأذكار 4/342
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ بَعْدَ الإِفْطَارِ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Ibn Majah 1/557 from the supplication of 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr, may Allah be pleased with them both. Al-Hafiz graded it as hasan in his grading of al-Adhkar. See Sharh al-Adhkar 4/342.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say after breaking his fast: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which encompasses everything.

adhkar.title: When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):Bismil-lahi fee awwalihi wa-akhirih.
adhkar.arabicText: إذا أكلَ أحدكُمْ طَعاماً فليَقُلْ بسمِ اللهِ، فإن نَسِيَ في أولهِ فليَقُلْ بسمِ اللهِ في أولهِ وآخرِهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: iidhaa akala ahadukum ta'aamaan falyaqul bismi alllahi, faiin nasiya fi awwalihi falyaqul bsmi alllahi fi awwalihi waakhirihi
adhkar.translation: When you are about to eat, you should say: Bismil-lah, and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember): In the name of Allah in its beginning and end.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود 3/347 برقم 3767، والترمذي 4/288 برقم 1858. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 2/167.
adhkar.fadl: إذا أكل أحدكم طعاماً فليقل بسم الله، فإن الشيطان يستحل الطعام الذي لم يذكر اسم الله عليه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud 3/347, no. 3767, and At-Tirmidhi 4/288, no. 1858. See: Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/167.
adhkar.fadlEn: When one of you eats, let him say Bismillah, for Satan considers lawful the food over which Allah's name is not mentioned.

adhkar.title: Supplication when fed by another
adhkar.arabicText: من أطعَمَهُ اللهُ الطَّعَامَ فليَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بارِكْ لنا فيهِ وأطعِمنا خيراً منهُ، ومن سَقَاهُ اللهُ لَبَناً فليقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ باركْ لنا فيهِ وزِدْنَا منهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Whomever Allah feeds, should say:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wa-atAAimna khayran minh.) and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wazidna minh
adhkar.translation: Whomever Allah feeds should say: O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it, and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Tirmidhi 5/506 and see Sahih al-Tirmidhi3/ 158
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever is fed by Allah should say: O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.

adhkar.title: Thanksgiving after eating
adhkar.arabicText: الحَمدُ لِلهِ الذي أطعَمَنِي هذا، ورزقَنيهِ، من غيرِ حولٍ مني ولا قُوَّةٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamanee hatha warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah
adhkar.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.
adhkar.sourceReference: Abū Dāwud (#4023), al-Tirmidhī (#3458) and Ibn Mājah (#3285). Also see Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tirmidhī (3/159)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ أَكَلَ طَعَاماً ثُمَّ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abū Dāwud (#4023), al-Tirmidhī (#3458) and Ibn Mājah (#3285). Also see Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tirmidhī (3/159)
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever eats food and says this supplication, his past sins are forgiven.

adhkar.title: Praise after finishing a meal
adhkar.arabicText: الحَمدُ لِلهِ حَمداً كثيراً طيِّباً مُباركاً فيهِ، غيرَ [مكفِيٍّ ولا ] مُوَدَّعٍ، ولا مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ ربَّنا.
adhkar.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin wala muwaddaAAin, wala mustaghnan AAanhu rabbuna
adhkar.translation: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord. (There are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. He is The One Who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. The One Who is longed for, along with that which is with Him and The One Who is needed, He is our Lord.)
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ طَعَامِهِ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ مُوَدَّعٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari 6/‌214 and al-Tirmidhi with his wording 5/ 507
adhkar.fadlEn: When the Prophet finished a meal, he said: All praise is for Allah, abundant, good, and blessed praise.

adhkar.title: Guest's supplication for the host
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بارِكْ لهمْ فيما رَزَقتَهُم، واغْفِر لهمْ وارحَمهمْ.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum feema razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum
adhkar.translation: O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.
adhkar.fadl: دَعَا النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لأَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ الَّذِينَ أَضَافُوهُ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 3/1626
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet supplicated for the household that hosted him: O Allah, bless what You have provided them.

adhkar.title: Supplication for one who provided food or drink
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ أطعِمْ من أطعَمَني، واسْقِ منْ سَقاني.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma atAAim man atAAamanee wasqi man saqanee
adhkar.translation: O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ صُنِعَ إِلَيْهِ مَعْرُوفٌ فَقَالَ لِفَاعِلِهِ: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، فَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ فِي الثَّنَاءِ
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever has a good deed done to him and says: Jazakallahu khayran, has expressed ample praise.

adhkar.title: Supplication after breaking fast at a home
adhkar.arabicText: أفطَرَ عندكمُ الصَّائمونَ، وأكلَ طعامكمُ الأبرارُ، وصَلَّتْ عليكمُ الملائكَةُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Aftara AAindakumus-sa-imoon, wa-akala taAAamakumul-abrar, wasallat AAalaykumul-mala-ikah
adhkar.translation: May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.
adhkar.sourceReference: سنن أبي داود 3/367، وابن ماجه 1/556 ،والنسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 298 ،ونص على أنه صلى الله عليه وسلم يقوله إذا أفطر عند أهل بيت ،وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 2/730
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَ قَوْمٍ: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الأَبْرَارُ وَتَنَزَّلَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Sunan Abi Dawud 3/367, and Ibn Majah 1/556, and al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah no. 298. It states that he, may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him, would say it when breaking his fast.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said when breaking fast at a home: May the fasting break their fast with you.

adhkar.title: Response when invited to eat while fasting
adhkar.arabicText: (إذا دُعِيَ أحدُكمْ فليُجِبْ، فإن كانَ صائماً فليُصَلِّ، وإن كانَ مفطِراً فليَطعَمْ) ، ومعنى فليُصَلِّ أَيْ فَلْيَدْعُ.
adhkar.transliteration: iidhaa du'iya ahadukum falyujib, faiin kaana saaiimaan falyusalli, waiin kaana muftiraan falyat'am)) , wama'naa falyusalli ay falyad'u
adhkar.translation: If you are not invited (to a meal), then answer. If you happen to be fasting, then supplicate (for those present), and if you are not fasting, then eat.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ فَلْيَقُلْ: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 2/1054
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: If one is invited to eat while fasting, let him say: I am fasting.

adhkar.title: Fasting person's reply when insulted
adhkar.arabicText: إني صائِمٌ، إني صائِمٌ.
adhkar.transliteration: Iinniy saaiimun, iinniy saaiimun
adhkar.translation: I am fasting, I am fasting.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا كَانَ صَوْمُ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلاَ يَرْفُثْ وَلاَ يَصْخَبْ، فَإِنْ سَابَّهُ أَحَدٌ فَلْيَقُلْ: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhārī (#1894, 4/103) and Muslim (#1151, 2/806)
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: When fasting, if someone insults you, say: I am fasting.

adhkar.title: Supplication upon seeing first fruits
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ بارِكْ لنا في ثمرِنا، وبارِكْ لنا في مدينَتِنا، وبارِكْ لنا في صاعِنا، وبارِكْ لنا في مُدِّنَا.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fee thamarina, wabarik lana fee madeenatina, wabarik lana fee saAAina wabarik lana fee muddina
adhkar.translation: O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our saAA for us and bless our mudd for us. (A saAA is equivalent to four mudds and a mudd is equivalent to a dry measure of an average man’s two palms.)
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا رَأَى بَاكُورَةَ الثَّمَرِ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 2/1000
adhkar.fadlEn: When seeing the first fruits, the Prophet said: O Allah, bless our fruit and our city.

adhkar.title: Supplication when sneezing
adhkar.arabicText: إذا عَطَسَ أحدكُم فلْيَقُلِ الحَمدُ لِلهِ، ولْيَقُلْ لهُ أخوهُ أو صاحبُهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللهُ، فإذا قالَ لهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللهُ، فلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللهُ ويُصْلِحُ بالَكُمْ.
adhkar.transliteration: When one of you sneezes he should say:(Alhamdu lillah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (Yarhamukal-lah.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(Yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum
adhkar.translation: When one of you sneezes he should say: All praise is for Allah, and his brother or companion should say to him: May Allah have mercy upon you, and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلْ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari 7/125
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: When one sneezes, let him say: Alhamdulillah, and let his brother say: Yarhamukallah.

adhkar.title: Yahdeekum wayuslihu balakum.
adhkar.arabicText: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللهُ ويُصْلِحُ بالَكُمْ.
adhkar.transliteration: yahdiykumu alllahu wayuslihu baalakum
adhkar.translation: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.
adhkar.fadl: الترمذي 5/82 وأحمد 4/400 وأبو داود 4/308، و
adhkar.fadlEn: Al-Tirmidhi 5/82, Ahmad 4/400, and Abu Dawud 4/308
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 2/354

adhkar.title: Marriage blessing for the groom
adhkar.arabicText: بارَكَ اللهُ لكَ، وبارَكَ عليكَ، وجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا في خيرٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: Barakal-lahu lak, wabaraka AAalayk, wajamaAAa baynakuma fee khayr
adhkar.translation: May Allah bless for you (your spouse), and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أصحاب السنن إلا النسائي وانظر صحيح الترمذي 1/316
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by the Sunan compilers except al-Nasa'i and see Sahih al-Tirmidhi 1/316
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: May Allah bless you, shower blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness.

adhkar.title: Supplication on the wedding night
adhkar.arabicText: إذا تزوَّجَ أحدكمُ امرأةً، أو إذَا اشترى خادِماً فلْيَقُلْ: (اللَّهُمَّ إني أسألكَ خيرَهَا، وخيرَ ما جَبَلْتَها عليهِ، وأعوذُ بكَ من شرها، وشر ما جَبَلْتَهَا عليْهِ، وإذا اشترى بَعيراً فليَأخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ ولْيَقُلْ مثلَ ذلكَ).
adhkar.transliteration: when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha AAalayh, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha washarri ma jabaltaha AAalayh.)(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say
adhkar.translation: when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.) (and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا وَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bukhari 7/22 and Muslim 4/1888.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: When one marries, let him take her forelock and say: O Allah, I ask You for her goodness.

adhkar.title: Supplication before intimate relations
adhkar.arabicText: بسمِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشيطانَ، وجَنِّبِ الشيطانَ ما رَزَقْتَنا.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lah, allahumma jannibnash-shaytan, wajannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا أَتَى أَهْلَهُ قَالَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا، فَإِنَّهُ إِنْ يُقَدَّرْ بَيْنَهُمَا وَلَدٌ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْطَانٌ أَبَداً
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari 6/141 and Muslim 2/1028
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: If one says before intercourse: In the name of Allah, O Allah keep the devil away from us... no devil will harm any child conceived.

adhkar.title: Supplication when angry
adhkar.arabicText: أعوذُ بِاللهِ من الشيطانِ الرَّجيمِ.
adhkar.transliteration: aAAoothu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem
adhkar.translation: I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ كَلِمَةً لَوْ قَالَهَا لَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ مَا يَجِدُ: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 6/99 and Muslim 4/2015.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: I know a word which if said would remove anger: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.

adhkar.title: Supplication upon seeing one afflicted
adhkar.arabicText: الحَمدُ لِلهِ الذي عافاني مما ابتلاكَ بهِ، وفَضَّلَني على كثيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً.
adhkar.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee mimmab-talaka bih, wafaddalanee AAala katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeela
adhkar.translation: All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ رَأَى مُبْتَلًى فَقَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، لَمْ يُصِبْهُ ذَلِكَ الْبَلاَءُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Tirmidhi 5/494 and 5/493 and see Sahih al-Tirmidhi3/ 153
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever sees an afflicted person and says: All praise is for Allah Who saved me... will not be struck by that affliction.

adhkar.title: Remembrance while sitting in a gathering
adhkar.arabicText: عن ابن عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قالَ: كانَ يُعَدُّ لرسولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم في المَجلِسِ الواحِدِ مائَةُ مَرَّةٍ من قبْل أن يَقومَ: (ربِّ اغفِرْ لي، وتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إنكَ أنتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ).
adhkar.transliteration: Ibn AAumar said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah would say at any one sitting before getting up: (Rabbigh-fir lee watub AAalay, innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor
adhkar.translation: Ibn AAumar said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me (to accept my repentance). Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.)
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُعَلِّمُهُمْ قَوْلَ: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 4/2092, no. 2733.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet taught them to say: Glory be to You O Allah, and praise, I bear witness that there is no god but You.

adhkar.title: Expiation of idle talk in a gathering
adhkar.arabicText: سبحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وبحَمدِكَ، أشهَدُ أن لا إلهَ إلا أنتَ، أستَغْفِرُكَ وأتوبُ إليكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk
adhkar.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أصحاب السنن وانظر صحيح الترمذي 3/153، وقد ثبت عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت :ما جلس رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم مجلساً ، ولاتلى قرآناً ، ولا صلاة إلا ختم ذلك بكلمات.... الحديث أخرجه النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة برقم 308 ، وأحمد 6/77 وصححه الدكتور فاروق حمادة في تحقيقه لعمل اليوم والليلة للنسائي ص273
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ جَلَسَ فِي مَجْلِسٍ فَقَالَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُومَ: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ... إِلاَّ غُفِرَ لَهُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by the compilers of the Sunan. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/153. It is authentically reported from 'A'ishah, may Allah be pleased with her, who said: "The Messenger of Allah, may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him, never sat in a gathering..."
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever says this before leaving a gathering will be forgiven.

adhkar.title: Responding to a favour with supplication
adhkar.arabicText: ولَكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Jazaaka Allah khayraan
adhkar.translation: If someone does you a favour and you say: May Allah reward you with goodness. then you have indeed excelled in praising him.
adhkar.sourceReference: Al-Tirmidhī (#2035). Also see Ṣaḥīḥ al-Jāmiʿ (#6244) and Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tirmidhī (2/200)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ صُنِعَ إِلَيْهِ مَعْرُوفٌ فَقَالَ لِفَاعِلِهِ: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، فَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ فِي الثَّنَاءِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhī (#2035). Also see Ṣaḥīḥ al-Jāmiʿ (#6244) and Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tirmidhī (2/200)
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever says Jazakallah to his benefactor has expressed ample praise.

adhkar.title: Supplication for one who does good
adhkar.arabicText: جَزَاكَ اللهُ خَيراً.
adhkar.transliteration: Jazaaka Allah khayraan
adhkar.translation: If someone does you a favour and you say: May Allah reward you with goodness. then you have indeed excelled in praising him.
adhkar.sourceReference: Al-Tirmidhī (#2035). Also see Ṣaḥīḥ al-Jāmiʿ (#6244) and Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tirmidhī (2/200)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ صُنِعَ إِلَيْهِ مَعْرُوفٌ فَقَالَ لِفَاعِلِهِ: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، فَقَدْ أَبْلَغَ فِي الثَّنَاءِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhī (#2035). Also see Ṣaḥīḥ al-Jāmiʿ (#6244) and Ṣaḥīḥ al-Tirmidhī (2/200)
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever says Jazakallah has indeed praised him sufficiently.

adhkar.title: Seeking protection from the Dajjal
adhkar.arabicText: (من حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آياتٍ من أوَّلِ سُورَةِ الكهفِ عُصِمَ من الدجالِ)، والاستِعاذَةُ بِاللهِ من فتنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الأخيرِ من كل صلاةٍ.
adhkar.transliteration: man hafiza 'ashra ayaatin min awwali suwrahi alkahfi 'usima mina alddajjaali)) , waalasti'aadhahu bialllahi min fitnatihi 'aqiba alttashahhudi alakhiyri min kulli salahin
adhkar.translation: Dajjal: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind, which every Prophet has warned about. Most of mankind will folow him. He will appear from Asbahan, Iran at the time when Muslims will conquer Constantinople. He will be given special powers and will make the truth seem false and vice versa. He will claim to be righteous and then he will claim prophet-hood and finally, divinity. From his features is that he will be blind in his right eye which is a definite proof that contradicts his claim to be Allah as it is a sign of imperfection. The word Kafir will be written between his eyes which every believer, literate or illiterate will recognise. (Whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat Al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjal.)(One should also seek refuge with Allah from the tribulations of the Dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.(Refer to supplications #55 & #56))
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود برقم 4324، والترمذي برقم 3404. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/151.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud, no. 4324, and At-Tirmidhi, no. 3404. See: Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/151.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever memorizes ten verses from the beginning of Surah Al-Kahf will be protected from the Dajjal.

adhkar.title: Response to: I love you for Allah's sake
adhkar.arabicText: أحبَّكَ الذي أحبَبتَني لهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Ahabbaka alladhiy ahbabtaniy lahu
adhkar.translation: May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.
adhkar.sourceReference: Abū Dāwud (#5125, 4/333) and Al-Albānī authenticated it in Ṣaḥīḥ Abī Dāwud (3/965)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا أَحَبَّ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ فَلْيُخْبِرْهُ أَنَّهُ يُحِبُّهُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abū Dāwud (#5125, 4/333) and Al-Albānī authenticated it in Ṣaḥīḥ Abī Dāwud (3/965)
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: If a man loves his brother, let him tell him that he loves him.

adhkar.title: Response to one who offers wealth
adhkar.arabicText: بارَكَ اللهُ لكَ في أهلِكَ ومالِكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Baaraka Allah laka fy ahlika wamalika
adhkar.translation: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari, al-Fath 4/88.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: The reward for a loan is praise and repayment.

adhkar.title: Supplication for one who lends
adhkar.arabicText: بارَكَ اللهُ لكَ في أهلِكَ ومالِكَ، إنما جزاءُ السلَفِ الحَمدُ والأداءُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Baaraka Allah laka fy ahlika wamalik, iinnamaa jazaa'u alssalafi alhamdu waladaa'u
adhkar.translation: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه النسائي في عمل اليوم والليلة ص 300 وابن ماجه 2/ 809 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/809 وانظر صحيح ابن ماجه 2/55
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِنَّ مِنْ أَفْضَلِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ قَضَاءً
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah p. 300 and Ibn Majah 2/ 809 and see Sahih Ibn Majah 2/809 and see Sahih Ibn Majah 2/55
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: The best of you are those best in repaying debts.

adhkar.title: Seeking protection from shirk
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ بكَ أن أشرِكَ بكَ وأنا أعلَمُ، وأسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لا أعلَمُ.
adhkar.transliteration: shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an oshrika bika wa-ana aAAlam, wa-astaghfiruka lima la aAAlam
adhkar.translation: shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah. (O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أحمد 4/403 وغيره وانظر صحيح الجامع 3/333 وصحيح الترغيب والترهيب للألباني
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ahmad 4/403 and others. See Sahih al-Jami' 3/333 and Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib by al-Albani.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from knowingly associating partners with You.

adhkar.title: Response to someone who says "May Allah bless you"
adhkar.arabicText: وفيكَ بارَكَ اللهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution. When the servant would come back (from distributing it), AAaishah would ask:
adhkar.translation: Aaishah reported that the Messenger of Allah was given a sheep and he ordered for it’s distribution. When the servant would come back (from distributing it), AAaishah would ask: ‘What did they say?’, he replied: They would supplicate: May Allah bless you all. AAaishah would then say: and may Allah bless them.) (we return their supplication in a similar way and our reward remains with us.)
adhkar.sourceReference: Ibn al-Sunnī (#278, p.\ 138). Also see Ibn Qayyim's al-Wābil al-Ṣayyib (p.\ 304) with research by Bashīr Muḥammad ʿUyūn
adhkar.fadl: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: أُهْدِيَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَاةٌ فَقَالَ: اقْسِمِيهَا. قَالَتْ: فَجَعَلْتُ الْخَادِمَ يَخْتَلِفُ وَيَقُولُ: قَالُوا: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيكُمْ، فَتَقُولُ: وَفِيهِمْ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ، نَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِمْ مِثْلَ مَا قَالُوا وَيَبْقَى أَجْرُنَا لَنَا. رَوَاهُ ابْنُ السُّنِّيِّ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ibn al-Sunnī (#278, p.\ 138). Also see Ibn Qayyim's al-Wābil al-Ṣayyib (p.\ 304) with research by Bashīr Muḥammad ʿUyūn
adhkar.fadlEn: Aishah (may Allah be pleased with her) said: The Prophet was given a sheep and he ordered it to be distributed. When the servant returned, he said: They said, "May Allah bless you." Aishah replied: "And may Allah bless them; we return to them the like of what they said while our reward remains with us."

adhkar.title: Supplication against superstition
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لا طَيرَ إلا طَيرُكَ، ولا خيرَ إلا خيرُكَ، ولا إلهَ غَيرُكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(Allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wala khayra illa khayruk, wala ilaha ghayruk
adhkar.translation: This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk. (O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أحمد 2/220 وابن السني برقم 292 وصححه الألباني في الأحاديث الصحيحة 3/54 رقم 1065 ، أما الفأل فكان يعجب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ؛ ولهذا سمع من رجل كلمة طيبة فأعجبته فقال : أخذنا فألك من فيك  أبو داود وأحمد ،وصححه الألباني في الصحيحة2/363 عند أبي الشيخ في أخلاق النبي
