adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: لاَ طِيَرَةَ وَخَيْرُهَا الْفَأْلُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ahmad 2/220 and Ibn al-Sunni no. 292 and authenticated by al-Albani in al-Ahadith al-Sahihah 3/54, no. 1065. As for optimism (al-fa'l), the Prophet, may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him, was pleased with it.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: There is no superstition, but optimism is good.

adhkar.title: Supplication when riding
adhkar.arabicText: بسمِ اللهِ، والحَمدُ للهِ ﴿سبحانَ الذي سَخَّرَ لنا هذا وما كنَّا له مُقرنينَ ۞ وإنا إلى ربِّنا لمُنقلِبونَ﴾، (الحمدُ لِلهِ، الحمدُ لِلهِ، الحمدُ لِلهِ، اللهُ أكبَرُ، اللهُ أكبَرُ، اللهُ أكبَرُ، سبحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إني ظَلَمْتُ نَفسي فاغفِرْ لي؛ فإنهُ لا يَغْفِرُ الذنوبَ إلا أنتَ).
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lah, walhamdu lillah, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanakal-lahumma innee thalamtu nafsee faghfir lee fainnahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this (transport. at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا رَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ قَالَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ...
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 2/978.
adhkar.fadlEn: When riding, the Prophet would say: In the name of Allah, all praise is for Allah, glory to Him Who subjected this to us.

adhkar.title: Supplication for travel
adhkar.arabicText: اللهُ أكبَرُ، اللهُ أكبَرُ، اللهُ أكبَرُ، ﴿سبحانَ الذي سَخَّرَ لنا هذا وما كنَّا له مُقرنينَ ۞ وإنا إلى ربِّنا لمُنقلِبونَ﴾ (اللَّهُمَّ إنا نسألُكَ في سفَرنا هذا البِرَّ والتَّقْوَى، ومنَ العَمَلِ ما تَرضى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ علينا سَفَرَنا هذا واطْوِ عنا بُعدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أنتَ الصاحبُ في السفرِ، والخليفَةُ في الأهلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إني أعوذُ بكَ من وعثاءِ السفرِ، وكآبَةِ المَنظَرِ، وسوءِ المُنقَلَبِ في المالِ والأهلِ)، وإذا رَجَعَ قالَهُنَّ وزَادَ فيهِنَّ: (آيبونَ، تائِبونَ، عابِدونَ، لربِّنا حامِدونَ).
adhkar.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, wa-inna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon, allahumma inna nas-aluka fee safarina hatha albirra wattaqwa, waminal-AAamali ma tarda, allahumma hawwin AAalayna safarana hatha, watwi AAanna buAAdah, allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, walkhaleefatu fil-ahl, allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min waAAtha-is-safar, waka-abatil-manthar, wasoo-il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl.)(upon returning the same supplication is recited with the following addition: (Ayiboona, ta-iboona, AAabidoona, lirabbina hamidoon
adhkar.translation: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, How perfect He is, The One Who has placed this (transport. at our service, and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. O Allah, we ask You for birr and taqwa in this journey of ours, and we ask You for deeds which please You. O Allah, facilitate our journey and let us cover it’s distance quickly. O Allah, You are The Companion on the journey and The Successor over the family, O Allah, I take refuge with You from the difficulties of travel, from having a change of hearts and being in a bad predicament, and I take refuge in You from an ill fated outcome with wealth and family. (birr and taqwa: two comprehensive terms which individually, refer to all good actions and obedience i.e. performing the commanded actions and avoiding the prohibited actions. When combined together, birr refers to doing those actions which have been commanded and taqwa refers to avoiding those actions which have been prohibited.)(A successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death. This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that Adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated. of Allah on earth because Allah is never absent, and will never die. This supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that Allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent.)(upon returning the same supplication is recited with the following addition: We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord.))
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا سَافَرَ قَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim2/ 978
adhkar.fadlEn: When traveling, the Prophet said: O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Successor over the family.

adhkar.title: Supplication when entering a town
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السماواتِ السبعِ وما أظْلَلْنَ، وربَّ الأَرَاضِينَ السبعِ وما أَقْلَلْنَ، وربَّ الشياطينِ وما أَضْلَلْنَ، وربَّ الرِّيَاحِ وما ذَرَيْنَ، أسألكَ خيرَ هذهِ القَريَةِ، وخيرَ أهلِهَا، وخيرَ ما فيها، وأعوذُ بكَ من شرها، وشر أهلِهَا، وشر ما فيها.
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAAi wama athlaln, warabbal-aradeenas-sabAAi wama aqlaln, warabbash-shayateeni wama adlaln, warabbar-riyahi wama tharayn, as-aluka khayra hathihil-qaryah, wakhayra ahlilha wakhayra ma feeha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha washarri ahliha, washarri ma feeha
adhkar.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه النسائي وابن السني. وانظر: صحيح الجامع 3/203.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ دَخَلَ قَرْيَةً فَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ... عُصِمَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by An-Nasa'i and Ibn al-Sunni. See: Sahih al-Jami' 3/203.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever enters a town and says this will be protected from its harm.

adhkar.title: Supplication when entering the marketplace
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وحدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلكُ، ولهُ الحَمدُ، يُحْيي ويُميتُ، وهوَ حَيٌّ لا يَموتُ، بِيَدِهِ الخيرُ، وهوَ على كل شيءٍ قَديرٌ.
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, yuhyee wayumeetu wahuwa hayyun la yamoot, biyadihil-khayru wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer
adhkar.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.
adhkar.sourceReference: الترمذي 5/491 والحاكم 1/538 وحسنه الألباني في صحيح ابن ماجه 2/21 وفي صحيح الترمذي3/ 152
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ دَخَلَ السُّوقَ فَقَالَ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ... كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ حَسَنَةٍ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Tirmidhi 5/491 and al-Hakim 1/538 and al-Albani graded it as good in Sahih Ibn Majah 2/21 and in Sahih al-Tirmidhi3/ 152
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever enters the market and says this, Allah writes a thousand good deeds for him.

adhkar.title: Supplication when the mount stumbles
adhkar.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismi allhi
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah.
adhkar.sourceReference: Al-Tirmidhī (#606, 2/505) and Sahīh al-Jāmiʿ (#3210, 3/203). Also see Irwāʾ al-Ghalīl (#50)
adhkar.fadl: عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ: كُنْتُ رِدْفَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَعَثَرَتْ دَابَّتُهُ فَقُلْتُ: تَعِسَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَقَالَ: لاَ تَقُلْ تَعِسَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَإِنَّكَ إِذَا قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ تَعَاظَمَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مِثْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيَقُولُ: بِقُوَّتِي. وَلَكِنْ قُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّكَ إِذَا قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ تَصَاغَرَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مِثْلَ الذُّبَابِ. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَابْنُ مَاجَهْ وَأَحْمَدُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhī (#606, 2/505) and Sahīh al-Jāmiʿ (#3210, 3/203). Also see Irwāʾ al-Ghalīl (#50)
adhkar.fadlEn: A man said: I was riding behind the Prophet when his mount stumbled, so I said: "May the devil perish." He said: "Do not say that, for when you say it, the devil becomes mighty like a house and says: 'By my strength!' Rather say: Bismillah, for when you say that, he becomes small like a fly." (Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, Ahmad)

adhkar.title: Farewell supplication for the traveler
adhkar.arabicText: أستَودِعكمُ اللهَ الذي لا تَضيعُ ودائِعُهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: AstawdiAAukumul-lah, allathee la tadeeAAu wada-iAAuh
adhkar.translation: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ لِلْمُسَافِرِ: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ahmad 2/7, and At-Tirmidhi 5/499. See: Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/155.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said to the traveler: I entrust to Allah your religion, trustworthiness, and the last of your deeds.

adhkar.title: Entrusting the traveler to Allah
adhkar.arabicText: أستَودِعُ اللهَ دينَكَ، وأمانَتَكَ، وخَواتيمَ عَمَلِكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: AstawdiAAul-laha deenak, wa-amanatak, wakhawateema AAamalik
adhkar.translation: I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Ahmad 2/7, al-Tirmidhi 5/499. See Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/155.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: I entrust to Allah your religion and the last of your deeds.

adhkar.title: Supplication for the departing traveler
adhkar.arabicText: زَوَّدَكَ اللهُ التَّقْوى، وغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، ويَسَّرَ لكَ الخيرَ حيثُ ما كُنْتَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Zawwadaka alllahu alttaqwaa, waghafaradhanbaka, wayassara laka alkhayra haythumaa kunta
adhkar.translation: May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be. (taqwa: a comprehensive term which refers to all good actions and obedience i.e. performing the commanded actions and avoiding the prohibited actions.)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Tirmidhi and see Sahih al-Tirmidhi3/ 155
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sin, and make goodness easy wherever you are.

adhkar.title: Glorifying Allah during travel
adhkar.arabicText: قالَ جابرٌ رضي الله عنه: (كنَّا إذا صَعَدنا كبَّرنا، وإذا نَزَلنا سَبَّحْنَا).
adhkar.transliteration: Qaala jaabirun rdy Allah 'nh: ((kunnaa iidhaa sa'adnaa kabbarnaa, waiidhaa nazalnaa sabbahnaa
adhkar.translation: Jabir said: Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allaahu 'Akber (Allah is the Most Great), and when we descended we would say Subhaanallaah (Glory is to Allah).
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا عَلَوْا شِعْباً كَبَّرُوا وَإِذَا هَبَطُوا سَبَّحُوا
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari, al-Fath 6/135.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet and his companions would magnify Allah when ascending and glorify Him when descending.

adhkar.title: The traveler's supplication at dawn
adhkar.arabicText: سَمَّعَ سامِعٌ بِحَمدِ اللهِ، وحُسْنِ بلائِهِ علينا، ربَّنا صاحِبنا، وأفضِلْ علينا، عائِذاً بِاللهِ من النَّارِ.
adhkar.transliteration: SamiAAa samiAAun bihamdil-lahi wahusni bala-ihi AAalayna. Rabbana sahibna wa-afdil AAalayna AAa-ithan billahi minan-nar
adhkar.translation: May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours and bounties upon us. Our Lord, protect us, show favour on us and deliver us from every evil. I take refuge in Allah from the fire.
adhkar.sourceReference: مسلم4/ 2086 ومعني سمع سامع : أي شهد شاهد على حمدنا لله تعالى على نعمه وحسن بلائه . ومعني سمع سامع : بلغ سامع قولي هذا لغيره وقال مثله تنبيهاً على الذكر في السحر والدعاء . وقوله : ربنا صاحبنا وأفضل علينا : أي احفظنا وحطنا واكلأنا وأفضل علينا بجزيل نعمك واصرف عنا كل مكروه ، شرح النووي 17/39
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَسْحَرَ فِي السَّفَرِ: سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا...
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/2086. The meaning of "Sami'a sami'" is: "May a witness bear witness to our praise of Allah the Exalted for His blessings and beautiful trial." Another meaning: "May a listener convey my words to the one who is absent..."
adhkar.fadlEn: At dawn during travel, the Prophet would say: May a witness hear our praise of Allah.

adhkar.title: Supplication when stopping at a place
adhkar.arabicText: أعوذُ بِكلماتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ من شر ما خَلَقَ.
adhkar.transliteration: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
adhkar.translation: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil that He has created.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مَنْ نَزَلَ مَنْزِلاً ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Whoever stops at a place and says: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of His creation, nothing will harm him until he leaves.

adhkar.title: Returning from travel: words of praise
adhkar.arabicText: يُكبِّرُ على كل شَرَفٍ ثلاثَ تَكبيراتٍ ثم يقولُ: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلكُ، ولهُ الحَمدُ، وهوَ على كل شيءٍ قديرٌ، آيِبونَ، تائبونَ، عابِدونَ، لربِّنا حامدونَ، صَدَقَ اللهُ وَعْدَهُ، ونَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وهَزَمَ الأحزابَ وَحدَهُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Ibn AAumar reported that the Messenger of Allah on return from a battle or from performing the pilgrimage would say at every high point: (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.) and then he would say: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, ayiboona ta-iboon, AAabidoon, lirabbina hamidoon, sadaqal-lahu waAAdah, wanasara AAabdah, wahazamal-ahzaba wahdah
adhkar.translation: Ibn AAumar reported that the Messenger of Allah on return from a battle or from performing the pilgrimage would say at every high point: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, and then he would say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies.
adhkar.sourceReference: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقوله إذا قفل من غزو أو حج ، البخاري 7/163 ومسلم 2/ 980
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ قَالَ: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: The Prophet, may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him, would say it when returning from a battle or pilgrimage. Al-Bukhari 7/163 and Muslim 2/980.
adhkar.fadlEn: When returning from travel, the Prophet said: Returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

adhkar.title: Supplication when pleased or displeased
adhkar.arabicText: كان النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أتاهُ الأمرُ يَسرُّهُ قالَ: (الحَمدُ لِلهِ الذي بنعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصالحاتُ) وإذا أتاهُ الأمرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قالَ: (الحَمدُ لِلهِ على كل حالٍ).
adhkar.transliteration: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet used to say:(Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat).And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say:(Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal
adhkar.translation: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet used to say: (Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)). Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected. And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say: (Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه ابن ماجه برقم 4023. وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه 2/345.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا رَأَى مَا يُحِبُّ قَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Ibn Majah, no. 4023. See: Sahih Ibn Majah 2/345.
adhkar.fadlEn: When seeing something pleasing, the Prophet said: All praise is for Allah by Whose grace good deeds are completed.

adhkar.title: The Prophet (PBUH) said: ‘Whoever sends a prayer...
adhkar.arabicText: قالَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (من صلَّى عليَّ صلاةً صلَّى اللهُ عليهِ بها عَشْراً).
adhkar.transliteration: Qaala alnnabiyyu sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((man sallaa 'alayya salahan sallaa alllahu 'alayhi bihaa 'ashraan
adhkar.translation: The Prophet (PBUH. said: ‘Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.
adhkar.fadl: صلَّى اللهُ عليهِ بها عَشْراً
adhkar.fadlEn: Allah will send ten blessings upon him
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 1/306.

adhkar.title: Sending blessings upon the Prophet
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (لا تجعَلُوا قبري عِيداً وصلُّوا عليَّ؛ فإن صلاتكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كنتُمْ).
adhkar.transliteration: Waqaala sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((la taj'aluwa qabriy 'iydaan wasalluwa 'alayya; faiinna salatakum tablughuniy haythu kuntum
adhkar.translation: He (PBUH. also said: ‘Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود برقم 2042، وأحمد 2/367. وانظر: صحيح أبي داود 2/673.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُمْ تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud, no. 2042, and Ahmad 2/367. See: Sahih Abi Dawud 2/673.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Do not take my grave as a festival, and send blessings upon me, for your blessings reach me.

adhkar.title: The miser who does not send blessings
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (البَخيلُ من ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ).
adhkar.transliteration: Waqaala sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((albakhiylu man dhukirtu 'indahu falam yusalli 'alayya
adhkar.translation: He (PBUH. also said: ‘A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه الترمذي برقم 3546، والنسائي 3/50. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/170.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by At-Tirmidhi, no. 3546, and An-Nasa'i 3/50. See: Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/170.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: The miser is the one in whose presence I am mentioned but he does not send blessings upon me.

adhkar.title: Angels convey greetings to the Prophet
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (إن لِلهِ ملائِكَةً سيَّاحينَ في الأرضِ يُبَلِّغوني من أُمَّتِي السَّلامَ).
adhkar.transliteration: Waqaala sla Allah 'lyh wslm:((iinna lillahi malaiikahan sayyaahiyna fi alardi yuballighuwniy min aummatiy alssalama
adhkar.translation: The Prophet PBUH said:'Indeed Allah has angels who roam the earth and they convey to me the greetings (or prayers of peace. of my 'Ummah (nation).
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ يُبَلِّغُونِي عَنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 1/307.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Allah has angels who convey the greetings of my nation to me.

adhkar.title: The Prophet PBUH said: 'No one sends greetings...
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (ما من أحَدٍ يُسلِّمُ عليَّ إلا رَدَّ اللهُ عليَّ رُوحِيَ حتى أَرُدَّ عليهِ السَّلامَ).
adhkar.transliteration: Waqaala sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((maa min ahadin yusallimu 'alayya iila radda alllahu 'alayya ruwhiya hattaa arudda 'alayhi alssalama
adhkar.translation: The Prophet PBUH said: 'No one sends greetings (or prayers of peace. upon me but Allah returns my soul to me so that I may return his greetings
adhkar.fadl: رَدَّ اللهُ عليَّ رُوحِيَ حتى أَرُدَّ عليهِ السَّلامَ
adhkar.fadlEn: Allah returned my soul to me so that I may return the greeting of peace
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 1/307.

adhkar.title: Spreading peace leads to love and faith
adhkar.arabicText: قالَ رسولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (لا تدخلوا الجَنَّةَ حتى تؤمنوا، ولا تؤمنوا حتى تَحابوا، أَوَلا أدُلكُم على شيءٍ إذا فَعَلْتُموهُ تَحابَبْتُم، أفشوا السَّلامَ بَيْنَكُمْ).
adhkar.transliteration: Qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((la tadkhuluwa aljannaha hattaa tuuminuwa, wala tuuminuwa hattaa tahaabbuwa, awala adullukum 'alaa shay'in iidhaa fa'altumuwhu tahaababtum, afshuwa alssalama baynakum
adhkar.translation: The Messenger of Allah said: ‘You shall not enter paradise until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. Shall I not inform you of something, if you were to act upon it, you will indeed achieve mutual love for one another? Spread the greeting amongst yourselves.
adhkar.fadl: تَحابَبْتُم
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 1/74 and others.
adhkar.fadlEn: you love one another

adhkar.title: Three qualities that complete faith
adhkar.arabicText: ثلاثٌ من جمعهُنَّ فقد جَمَعَ الإيمانَ: الإنصافُ من نفسكَ، وبَذْلُ السَّلامِ لِلعالَمِ، والإنفاقُ من الإقْتارِ.
adhkar.transliteration: thalathun man jama'ahunna faqad jama'a aliiymaana: aliinsaafu min nafsika, wabadhlu alssalami lil'aalami, waaliinfaaqu mina aliiqtaari
adhkar.translation: Aammar said: ‘Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend (charitably. out of the little you have.
adhkar.sourceReference: البخاري مع الفتح 1/ 82 عن عمار رضي الله عنه موقوفاً معلقاً
adhkar.fadl: فقد جَمَعَ الإيمانَ
adhkar.fadlEn: He has gathered all of faith
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari with al-Fath 1/82 from 'Ammar, may Allah be pleased with him, as a mawquf and mu'allaq narration.

adhkar.title: Six rights of a Muslim
adhkar.arabicText: وعن عبدِ اللهِ بن عُمَرَ رضيَ اللهُ عنهما: أن رجُلاً سَألَ النبيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أيُّ الإسلامِ خيرٌ قالَ: (تُطعِمُ الطعامَ، وتَقْرأُ السلامَ على من عَرَفْتَ ومن لم تَعْرِفْ).
adhkar.transliteration: Wa'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara radiya alllahu 'anhumaa: anna rajulaan saala alnnabiyya sla Allah 'lyh wslm ayyu aliislami khayrun qaala: ((tut'imu altta'aama, wataqrau alssalama 'alaa man 'arafta waman lam ta'rif
adhkar.translation: Aabdullah Ibn Aamr reported that a man asked the Prophet : ‘Which Islam is the best?’. He replied: Feed (the poor), and greet those whom you know as well as those whom you do not.
adhkar.fadl: أيُّ الإسلامِ خيرٌ
adhkar.fadlEn: Which aspect of Islam is best
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari with al-Fath 1/55 and Muslim 1/65

adhkar.title: Responding to a non-Muslim's greeting
adhkar.arabicText: إذا سَلَّمَ عليكم أهلُ الكتابِ فقولوا: وعليكُمْ.
adhkar.transliteration: idhaa sallama 'alaykum ahlu alkitaabi faquwluwa: wa'alaykum
adhkar.translation: When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying: And upon you.)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari with al-Fath 11/42, and Muslim 4/1705.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: When the People of the Book greet you, respond: And upon you.

adhkar.title: Supplication upon hearing rooster or donkey
adhkar.arabicText: إذا سَمعتُمْ صياحَ الدِّيَكةِ فاسألوا اللهَ من فَضلِهِ؛ فإنها رَأَتْ مَلَكاً وإذا سَمعتُمْ نَهِيقَ الحمارِ فَتَعوذوا بِاللهِ من الشيطانِ؛ فإنهُ رَأى شيطاناً.
adhkar.transliteration: iidhaa sami'tum siyaaha alddiyakahi faasaluwa alllaha min fadlihi; faiinnahaa raat malakaan waiidhaa sami'tum nahiyqa alhimaari fata'awwadhuwa bialllahi mina alshhaytaani; faiinnahu raaa shaytaanaan
adhkar.translation: If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty for it has seen an angel and if you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah for it has seen a devil.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ... وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bukhari 4/115 and Muslim 4/2092.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: If you hear a rooster, ask Allah for His bounty; if you hear a donkey, seek refuge from the devil.

adhkar.title: Supplication upon hearing dogs at night
adhkar.arabicText: إذا سَمعتُمْ نُباحَ الكلابِ ونَهِيقَ الحَميرِ بِالليلِ فتَعَوَّذوا بِاللهِ مِنْهُنَّ؛ فإنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ ما لا ترَوْنَ.
adhkar.transliteration: iidhaa sami'tum nubaaha alkilabi wanahiyqa alhamiyri bialllayli fata'awwadhuwa bialllahi minhunna; faiinnahunna yarayna maa la tarawna
adhkar.translation: If you hear the barking of dogs or the braying of asses at night, seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not.
adhkar.sourceReference: أبو داود 4/ 327 وأحمد 3/ 306 وصححه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود3/ 961
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: نُبَاحُ الْكِلاَبِ وَالنَّهِيقُ مِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abu Dawud 4/ 327 and Ahmad 3/ 306 and authenticated by al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud3/ 961
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Dog barking at night is from the devils, so seek refuge with Allah.

adhkar.title: Supplication for one wronged by speech
adhkar.arabicText: قالَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (اللَّهُمَّ فَأيُّما مؤمِن سَبَبْتُهُ فاجعَلْ ذلكَ لهُ قُربَةً إليكَ يومَ القِيامَةِ).
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma fa-ayyuma mu/minin sababtuhu fajAAal thalika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyamah
adhkar.translation: O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, let that be cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: اللَّهُمَّ فَإِنِّي اتَّخَذْتُ عِنْدَكَ عَهْداً لَنْ تُخْلِفَنِيهِ، فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ، فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْهَا لَهُ كَفَّارَةً
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 4/2000.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: O Allah, I have taken a covenant with You. I am human, so any believer I have cursed, make it an expiation for him.

adhkar.title: How to praise a fellow Muslim
adhkar.arabicText: قالَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (إذا كانَ أحدكُم مادِحاً صاحبَهُ لا مَحالةَ فليَقُلْ: أحسِبُ فلاناً واللهُ حَسيبُهُ، ولا أُزَكي على اللهِ أَحداً، أَحْسبُهُ – إن كانَ يَعْلَمُ ذاكَ – كَذا وكَذَا).
adhkar.transliteration: Qaala alnnabiyyu sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((iidhaa kaana ahadukum maadihaan saahibahu la mahaalaha falyaqul: ahsibu fulanaan waalllahu hasiybuhu, wala auzakkiy 'alaa alllahi ahadaan, ahsibuhu – iin kaana ya'lamu dhaaka – kadhaa wakadhaa
adhkar.translation: He said: ‘If anyone of you is impelled to praise his brother, then he should say: ‘I deem so-and-so to be…and Allah is his reckoner…and I don’t praise anyone, putting it (i.e. my praising. forward, in front of Allah’s commendation, however I assume him so and so’…if he knows that of him.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ مَادِحاً أَخَاهُ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 4/2296.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: If one must praise his brother, let him say: I consider him such, and Allah is his Judge.

adhkar.title: Supplication when praised
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ لا تُؤاخِذني بما يَقولونَ، واغفِر لي ما لا يَعْلَمُونَ، [واجْعَلْني خيراً مما يَظُّنُّونَ]
adhkar.transliteration: Allaahumma laa tu'aakhithnee bimaa yaqooloona, waghfir lee maa laa ya'lamoona waj'alnee khayram-mimmaa yadhunnoon
adhkar.translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine]
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه ابن ماجه عن عائشة. وانظر: صحيح ابن ماجه 2/345.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ إِذَا مُدِحَ: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Ibn Majah from 'A'ishah. See: Sahih Ibn Majah 2/345.
adhkar.fadlEn: When praised, the Prophet said: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say.

adhkar.title: Talbiyah for Hajj or Umrah
adhkar.arabicText: لبَّيكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لبَّيكَ لا شَريكَ لكَ لبَّيكَ، إن الحَمدَ، والنِّعمَةَ، لكَ والمُلكَ، لا شَرِيكَ لكَ.
adhkar.transliteration: Labbaykal-lahumma labbayk, labbayka la shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda wanniAAmata laka walmulk, la shareeka lak
adhkar.translation: Here I am O Allah, (in response to Your call), here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَفْضَلُ الدُّعَاءِ دُعَاءُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari with al-Fath 3/408, and Muslim 2/841.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: The best supplication is the supplication on the Day of Arafah.

adhkar.title: Magnifying Allah at the Black Stone
adhkar.arabicText: طافَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بالبَيتِ على بعيرٍ كلما أتى الرُّكْنَ أَشارَ إليهِ بِشيءٍ عندهُ وكَبَّرَ.
adhkar.transliteration: The Prophet circled the KaAAbah on a camel, every time he reached the black stone he would point to it with his staff and say: (Allahu akbar
adhkar.translation: The Prophet circled the KaAAbah on a camel, every time he reached the black stone he would point to it with his staff and say: Allah is the greatest)
adhkar.fadl: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: طَافَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ، كُلَّمَا أَتَى الرُّكْنَ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ وَكَبَّرَ. رَوَاهُ الْبُخَارِيُّ وَمُسْلِمٌ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bukhari 3/449 and Muslim 2/888.
adhkar.fadlEn: Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet performed Tawaf of the Kabah riding a camel, and every time he came to the corner (containing the Black Stone), he pointed to it with something he had and said: Allahu Akbar. (Al-Bukhari and Muslim)

adhkar.title: The Prophet PBUH used to say between the...
adhkar.arabicText: ﴿ربَّنا آتِنا في الدنيا حَسَنَةً وفي الآخرَةِ حَسَنَةً وقِنا عذابَ النَّارِ﴾.
adhkar.transliteration: The Prophet PBUH used to say between the Yemeni corner and the black stone: (Rabbana atina fee alddunya hasanatan wafee al-akhirati hasanatan waqina AAathaba alnnar)Al-Baqarah: 201
adhkar.translation: The Prophet PBUH used to say between the Yemeni corner and the black stone: O our Lord, grant us the best in this life and the best in the next life, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.)
adhkar.fadl: أبو داود 2/ 179 وأحمد 3/411 والبغوي في شرح السنة 7/128 ،وحسنه الألباني في صحيح أبي داود 1/ 354 ، والآية من
adhkar.fadlEn: Abu Dawud 2/179, Ahmad 3/411, and al-Baghawi in Sharh al-Sunnah 7/128; al-Albani graded it hasan in Sahih Abi Dawud 1/354, and the verse from
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Surah al-Baqarah, 201.

adhkar.title: Supplication at Safa and Marwah
adhkar.arabicText: لما دَنا النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم من الصَّفَا قرَأ: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا والمَرْوَةَ من شَعآئِرِ اللهِ﴾ أبْدَأُ بما بَدَأَ اللهُ بهِ فبَدَأَ بالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عليهِ حتى رَأَى البيتَ فاسْتَقْبَلَ القِبْلَةَ، فوَحَّدَ اللهَ وكبَّرَهُ وقالَ: (لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ وهوَ على كل شيءٍ قَديرٌ، لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ، أنجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، ونَصَرَ عبدَهُ، وهَزَمَ الأحزابَ وَحدَهُ، ثم دَعَا بينَ ذلكَ. قالَ مثلَ هذا ثلاثَ مراتٍ) الحديثُ. وفيهِ: (فَفَعَلَ على المَرْوَةِ كما فَعَلَ على الصَّفَا).
adhkar.transliteration: Lammaa danaa alnnabiyyu sla Allah 'lyh wslm mina alssafaa qaraa: iinna alssafaa waalmarwaha min sha'aaiiri alllahi abdaau bimaa badaa alllahu bihi)) fabadaa bialssafaa faraqiya 'alayhi hattaa raaa albayta, faastaqbala alqiblaha, fawahhada alllaha wakbbarahu waqaala: ((la iilaha iila alllahu wahdahu la shariyka lahu, lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadirun, la iilaha iila alllahu wahdahu, anjaza wa'dahu, wanasara 'abdahu, wahazama alahzaaba wahdahu, thumma da'aa bayna dhlka. qaala mithla hadhaa thalatha marraatin)) alhadiythu. wafiyhi: ((fafa'ala 'alaa almarwahi kamaa fa'ala 'alaa alssafaa
adhkar.translation: Jabir said when describing the Prophet's pilgrimage: '...and when he approached mount Safa he recited: Indeed Safa and Marwah are from the places of worship of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with. So he started with Safa and climbed it until he could see the KaAAbah, he then faced it and said: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, and then he would say the following three times, making a supplication (one should make a personal supplication after each time): None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant and single-handedly defeated the allies. (He would repeat this action at Marwah.)'
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أَتَى الصَّفَا يَقُولُ: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ...
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 2/888.
adhkar.fadlEn: When the Prophet approached Safa, he would recite: Indeed Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.

adhkar.title: Supplication on the Day of Arafah
adhkar.arabicText: قالَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (خيرُ الدعاءِ دُعاءُ يومِ عَرَفَةَ، وخيرُ ما قُلْتُ أنا والنَّبيُّونَ من قبلي: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ وهوَ على كل شيءٍ قَديرٌ).
adhkar.transliteration: The best of supplications is the supplication on the day of AAarafah and the best which I and the Prophets before me have said (is): (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer
adhkar.translation: The best of supplications is the supplication on the day of AAarafah and the best which I and the Prophets before me have said (is): None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.)
adhkar.sourceReference: الترمذي وحسنه الألباني في صحيح الترمذي 3/184، وفي الحديث الصحيحة 4/6
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: خَيْرُ الدُّعَاءِ دُعَاءُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhi and al-Albani graded it as hasan in Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/184, and in al-Silsilah al-Sahihah 4/6.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: The best of supplication is on the Day of Arafah.

adhkar.title: Supplication at Muzdalifah
adhkar.arabicText: رَكِبَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم القَصْوَاءَ حتى أتى المَشْعَرَ الحرامَ فاستَقْبَلَ القبلةَ (فَدَعاهُ، وكَبَّرَهُ، وهَللَّهُ، ووَحَّدَهُ) فلم يَزَلْ واقِفاً حتى أَسْفَرَ جِدَّاً فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أن تَطْلُعَ الشَّمسُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Rakiba alnnabiyyu sla Allah 'lyh wslm alqaswaa'a hattaa ataa almash'ara alharaama faastaqbala alqiblaha (fada'aahu, wakabbarahu, wahalllahu, wawahhadahu) falam yazal waaqifaan hattaa asfara jiddaaan fadafa'a qabla an tatlu'a alshhamsu
adhkar.translation: The Prophet rode his camel, Al-Qaswa, until he reached the sacred area (Al-Mash aril Haraam). Then he faced the Qiblah and invoked Allah, and repeatedly said the words: Allaahu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great), Allaahu Ahad (Allah is One), and Laa ilaaha illallaah (There is none worthy of worship but Allah). He remained stationary until the sky became yellow with the dawn, and then pressed on before sunrise.
adhkar.fadl: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: رَكِبَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ فَجَمَعَ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ وَقَفَ بِالْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ فَدَعَاهُ وَكَبَّرَهُ وَهَلَّلَهُ وَوَحَّدَهُ. رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 2/891.
adhkar.fadlEn: Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet rode his camel until he came to Muzdalifah, where he prayed the two prayers together. Then he stood at Al-Mashar Al-Haram, faced the Qiblah, and made supplication to Allah, glorifying Him, proclaiming His Oneness, and saying Allahu Akbar. (Muslim)

adhkar.title: Magnifying Allah while stoning the pillars
adhkar.arabicText: يُكبِّرُ كلما رمى بحَصاةٍ عندَ الجِمارِ الثلاثِ، ثم يتقدَّمُ، ويقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ القبلةِ، رافِعاً يديهِ بعدَ الجَمْرَةِ الأولى والثانيةِ. أما جَمْرَةُ العَقَبَةِ فيَرْميها ويُكبِّرُ عندَ كل حَصاةٍ ويَنْصَرِفُ ولا يَقِفُ عندها.
adhkar.transliteration: yukabbiru kullamaa ramaa bihasaahin 'inda aljimaari althhalathi, thumma yataqaddamu, wyaqifu yad'uw mustaqbila alqiblahi, raafi'aan yadayhi ba'da aljamrahi alauwlaa waalthhaaniyahi. ammaa jamrahu al'aqabahi fayarmiyhaa wayukabbiru 'inda kulli hasaahin wayansarifu wala yaqifu 'indahaa
adhkar.translation: The Prophet PBUH said Allaahu 'Akbar (Allah is the Most Great. with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after (stoning. the first and second pillar As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allahu Akbar with every pebble he threw but when he was finished he left without standing at it (for supplications).
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ مِنَ الْجِمَارِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bukhari 3/534.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say Allahu Akbar with each pebble when stoning the pillars.

adhkar.title: Exclamation of wonder: SubhanAllah
adhkar.arabicText: سُبْحانَ اللهِ!
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanal-lah!
adhkar.translation: How perfect Allah is.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُسَبِّحُ عِنْدَ الْعَجَبِ
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say SubhanAllah when surprised.

adhkar.title: Exclamation of joy: Allahu Akbar
adhkar.arabicText: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ!
adhkar.transliteration: Allah akbaru
adhkar.translation: Allah is the greatest.
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ السُّرُورِ
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would say Allahu Akbar when joyful.

adhkar.title: Prostration of gratitude
adhkar.arabicText: كانَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا أَتاهُ أمرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أو يُسَرُّ بهِ خَرَّ ساجِداً شُكْراً لِلهِ تَبارَكَ وتَعالى.
adhkar.transliteration: kaana alnnabyyu sla Allah 'lyh wslm iidhaa ataahu amrun yasurruhu aw yusarru bihi kharra saajidaan shukraan lillahi tabaaraka wata'aalaa
adhkar.translation: The Prophet PBUH would prostrate in gratitude to Allah upon receiving news which pleased him or which caused pleasure.
adhkar.sourceReference: رواه أهل السنن إلا النسائي . انظر صحيح ابن ماجه 1/ 233 وإرواء الغليل 2/226
adhkar.fadl: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَسْجُدُ سُجُودَ الشُّكْرِ إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by the Sunan compilers except al-Nasa'i. See Sahih Ibn Majah 1/233 and Irwa' al-Ghalil 2/226.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would prostrate in gratitude when something pleased him.

adhkar.title: Supplication when feeling pain
adhkar.arabicText: ضَعْ يدكَ على الذي تَألمَ من جَسَدِكَ وقُلْ: بسمِ اللهِ، ثلاثاً، وقُلْ سبعَ مراتٍ: أعوذُ بِاللهِ وقُدْرتهِ من شر ما أجِدُ وأُحاذِرُ.
adhkar.transliteration: Place your hand at the site of the pain and say: (Bismil-lah) the supplicate
adhkar.translation: Place your hand at the site of the pain and say: In the name of Allah(three times). the supplicate seven times: I take refuge in Allah and within His omnipotence from the evil that I feel and am wary of.)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَأَلَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ سَبْعاً: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/1728
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Place your hand on the painful area and say seven times: I seek refuge with Allah from what I feel.

adhkar.title: If you see anything of your brother that...
adhkar.arabicText: إذا رَأى أحدُكُم من أخِيهِ، أو من نفسهِ، أو من مالِهِ ما يُعْجِبُهُ [فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ] فإن العيْنَ حَقٌّ.
adhkar.transliteration: iidhaa raaa ahadukum min akhiyhi, aw min nafsihi, aw min maalihi maa yu'jibuhu faiinna al'ayna haqqun
adhkar.translation: If you see anything of your brother that pleases you, or of his person or of his property [then ask Allah to bless him in it] for the envious eye is real.
adhkar.fadl: مسند أحمد 4/447 وابن ماجه ومالك ، وصححه الألباني في صحيح الجامع 1/212 و
adhkar.fadlEn: Musnad Ahmad 4/447, Ibn Majah, and Malik; al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih al-Jami' 1/212
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See the verification (Tahqiq) of Zad al-Ma'ad by al-Arna'ut, 4/170.

adhkar.title: Supplication when frightened
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ!
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah
adhkar.sourceReference: Abū Dāwud (#3116, 3/190). Also See Ṣaḥīḥ al-Jāmiʿ (#6479, 5/432)
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا فَزِعَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Abū Dāwud (#3116, 3/190). Also See Ṣaḥīḥ al-Jāmiʿ (#6479, 5/432)
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: When frightened, say: I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from His anger and punishment.

adhkar.title: Mentioning Allah's name when slaughtering
adhkar.arabicText: بسمِ اللهِ واللهُ أكبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ منكَ ولكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي.
adhkar.transliteration: Bismil-lah wallahu akbar, allahumma minka walak, allahumma taqabbal minnee
adhkar.translation: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, (it is. from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.
adhkar.sourceReference: مسلم 3/1557 والبيهقي 9/287 وما بين المعكوفين للبيهقي 9/287 وغيره والجملة الأخيرة سقتها بالمعنى من رواية مسلم
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا ذَبَحْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الذِّبْحَةَ وَلْيُحِدَّ أَحَدُكُمْ شَفْرَتَهُ وَلْيُرِحْ ذَبِيحَتَهُ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 3/1557 and al-Bayhaqi 9/287. What is between the brackets is for al-Bayhaqi 9/287 and others. The last sentence I summarized from Muslim's narration.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: When you slaughter, do it well, and let each of you sharpen his blade and comfort his animal.

adhkar.title: I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which...
adhkar.arabicText: أعوذُ بكلماتِ اللهِ التاماتِ التي لا يُجاوِزُهنَّ بَرٌّ ولا فاجِرٌ: من شر ما خَلَقَ، وبَرَأ وذَرَأ، ومن شر ما يَنزِلُ من السماءِ، ومن شر ما يَعْرُجُ فيها، ومن شر ما ذَرَأ في الأرضِ، ومن شر ما يَخْرُجُ منها، ومن شر فِتَنِ الليلِ والنهارِ، ومن شر كل طارِقٍ إلا طارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بخيرٍ يا رَحْمـٰنُ.
adhkar.transliteration: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat, allatee la yujawizuhunna barrun wala fajir min sharri ma khalaq, wabaraa watharaa, wamin sharri ma yanzilu minas-sama/, wamin sharri ma yaAAruju feeha, wamin sharri ma tharaa fil-ard, wamin sharri ma yakhruju minha, wamin sharri fitnanil-layli wannahar, wamin sharri kulli tariqin illa tariqan yatruqu bikhayrin ya Rahman
adhkar.translation: I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. (I take refuge. from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. (I take refuge. from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.
adhkar.fadl: أحمد 3/419 بإسناد صحيح وابن السني برقم 637 وصحح إسناده الأرناؤوط في تخريجه للطحاوية ص 133 و
adhkar.fadlEn: Ahmad 3/419 with an authentic chain; Ibn al-Sunni no. 637; al-Arna'ut authenticated its chain in his takhrij of al-Tahawiyyah p. 133
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Majma' al-Zawa'id 10/ 127

adhkar.title: The Messenger of Allah said: ‘By Allah, I...
adhkar.arabicText: قالَ رَسولُ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (وَاللهِ إني لأستَغفِرُ اللهَ وأتوبُ إليهِ في اليومِ أكثرَ من سَبعينَ مرةٍ).
adhkar.transliteration: Qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((waalllahi iinniy lastaghfiru alllaha waatuwbu iilayhi fi alyawmi akthara min sab'iyna marrahin
adhkar.translation: The Messenger of Allah said: ‘By Allah, I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day.
adhkar.fadl: والله إني لأستغفر الله وأتوب إليه في اليوم أكثر من سبعين مرة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 4/2075, no. 2702.
adhkar.fadlEn: By Allah, I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him more than seventy times a day.

adhkar.title: He also said: ‘O People, Repent! Verily I...
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (يا أيُّها الناسُ توبوا إلى اللهِ فإني أتوبُ في اليومِ إليهِ مائةَ مرةٍ).
adhkar.transliteration: Waqaala sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((yaa ayyuhaa alnnaasu tuwbuwa iilaa alllahi faiinniy atuwbu fi alyawmi iilayhi miaiaha marrahin
adhkar.translation: He also said: ‘O People, Repent! Verily I repent to Allah, a hundred times a day.
adhkar.fadl: يا أيها الناس توبوا إلى الله فإني أتوب إليه في اليوم مائة مرة
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 4/2075, no. 2702.
adhkar.fadlEn: O People, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him one hundred times a day.

adhkar.title: He also said: ‘Whoever says:(I seek Allah’s forgiveness...
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (من قالَ أستغفِرُ اللهَ العظيمَ الذي لا إلهَ إلا هو الحيُّ القَيّومُ وأتوبُ إليهِ، غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهُ وإن كانَ فَرَّ من الزَّحْفِ).
adhkar.transliteration: He also said:
adhkar.translation: He also said: ‘Whoever says: I seek Allah’s forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance. Allah would forgive him even if he was one who fled during the advance of an army.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود برقم 1518، والترمذي برقم 3576. وانظر: صحيح الترمذي 3/182.
adhkar.fadl: من قال: أستغفر الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم وأتوب إليه، غفر له وإن كان فر من الزحف
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says: 'I seek forgiveness from Allah...' will be forgiven even if he fled from the battlefield.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud, no. 1518, and At-Tirmidhi, no. 3576. See: Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.

adhkar.title: He said: ‘The nearest the Lord comes to...
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (أقربُ ما يكونُ الرَّبُّ مِن العبدِ في جوفِ الليلِ الآخرِ فإنِ استَطَعْتَ أن تكونَ ممنْ يذكُرُ اللهَ في تلكَ الساعةِ فكنْ).
adhkar.transliteration: Waqaala sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((aqrabu maa yakuwnu alrrabbu mina al'abdi fi jawfi alllayli alakhiri faiini astata'ta an takuwna mimman yadhkuru alllaha fi tilka alssaa'ahi fakun
adhkar.translation: He said: ‘The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so.
adhkar.fadl: أقرب ما يكون الرب من العبد في جوف الليل الآخر فإن استطعت أن تكون من يذكر الله في تلك الساعة فكن
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 1/350.
adhkar.fadlEn: The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the last part of the night, so if you can be among those who remember Allah at that hour, do so.

adhkar.title: Allah accepts repentance day and night
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (أقربُ ما يكونُ العبدُ من ربِّهِ وهوَ ساجِدٌ فَأكثِروا الدعاءَ).
adhkar.transliteration: Waqaala sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((aqrabu maa yakuwnu al'abdu min rabbihi wahuwa saajidun faakthiruwa alddu'aa'a
adhkar.translation: He also said: ‘The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ النَّهَارِ وَيَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِالنَّهَارِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ اللَّيْلِ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 1/350.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: Allah extends His hand at night for the daytime sinner to repent, and during the day for the nighttime sinner.

adhkar.title: The Prophet's daily repentance
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (إنهُ لَيُغانُ على قَلبي وإني لأستَغْفِرُ اللهَ في اليومِ مائةَ مرةٍ).
adhkar.transliteration: Waqaala sla Allah 'lyh wslm: ((iinnahu layughaanu 'alaa qalbiy waiinniy lastaghfiru alllaha fi alyawmi miaiaha marrahin
adhkar.translation: He also said: ‘verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah’s forgiveness a hundred times a day. (preoccupied: i.e. in a state of ‘forgetfulness’. The Prophet always used to increase in his remembrance of his Lord, in attaining a nearness to Allah and having consciousness of Allah to the extent that if this intensity lessened in anyway, he would regard it as a sin and would then race to seek forgiveness from Allah.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود برقم 1518، والنسائي 3/52. وانظر: صحيح النسائي 1/279.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud, no. 1518, and An-Nasa'i 3/52. See: Sahih An-Nasa'i 1/279.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: O people, repent to Allah, for I repent to Him a hundred times a day.

adhkar.title: Whoever says:(How perfect Allah is and I praise...
adhkar.arabicText: قالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم من قالَ: سُبحانَ اللهِ وبِحَمدِهِ في يومٍ مائةَ مرةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطاياهُ ولو كانتْ مثلَ زَبَدِ البحرِ.
adhkar.transliteration: Whoever says:(Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih.) a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea
adhkar.translation: Whoever says: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. a hundred times during the day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.
adhkar.fadl: حُطَّتْ خَطاياهُ ولو كانتْ مثلَ زَبَدِ البحرِ
adhkar.fadlEn: His sins will be wiped away even if they were like the foam of the sea
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari 7/168 and Muslim 4/2071

adhkar.title: The excellence of remembering Allah
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (من قالَ لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وَحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْكُ، ولهُ الحَمْدُ، وهوَ على كل شيءٍ قَديرٌ عَشْرَ مِرارٍ، كانَ كمن أعتَقَ أربعةَ أنفُسٍ من ولدِ إسماعيلَ).
adhkar.transliteration: Abu Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:
adhkar.translation: Abu Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Whoever says: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. a hundred times during the day, has the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are recorded for him and a hundred bad deeds are wiped away and he has gained refuge from the devil that day until evening and none shall come with anything better except someone who has done more.
adhkar.fadl: كانَ كمن أعتَقَ أربعةَ أنفُسٍ من ولدِ إسماعيلَ
adhkar.fadlEn: He is like one who freed four slaves from the descendants of Ishmael
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari 7/67 and Muslim with his wording 4/2071

adhkar.title: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah...
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (كَلِمتانِ خَفيفتانِ على اللسانِ، ثَقيلَتانِ في الميزانِ، حَبيبتانِ إلى الرحمنِ: سُبحانَ اللهِ وبِحَمدِهِ، سُبحانَ اللهِ العظيمِ).
adhkar.transliteration: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:’(There are) Two words, (which are) light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious: (Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, wasubhanal-lahil-AAatheem
adhkar.translation: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:’(There are. Two words, (which are. light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale and beloved to The Most Gracious: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.)
adhkar.fadl: ثَقيلَتانِ في الميزانِ، حَبيبتانِ إلى الرحمنِ
adhkar.fadlEn: Two words heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari 7/167 and Muslim 4/2072

adhkar.title: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah...
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (لأن أقولَ سُبحانَ اللهِ، والحَمْدُ لِلهِ، ولا إلهَ إلا اللهُ، واللهُ أكبَرُ، أحبُّ إليَّ مما طَلَعَتْ عليهِ الشمسُ).
adhkar.transliteration: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said:
adhkar.translation: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: ‘Saying: How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest. is more beloved to me than everything the sun has risen over.
adhkar.fadl: أحبُّ إليَّ مما طَلَعَتْ عليهِ الشمسُ
adhkar.fadlEn: More beloved to me than all that the sun shines upon
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/2072

adhkar.title: Sa’d said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger...
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (أيعجِزُ أحدكم أن يَكسِبَ كل يومٍ ألفَ حسنةٍ) فسألهُ سائلٌ من جُلَسائهِ كيفَ يَكسِبُ أحدُنا ألفَ حسنةٍ؟ قالَ: (يُسَبِّحُ مائةَ تَسْبيحَةٍ، فَيُكتَبُ لهُ ألفُ حسنةٍ أو يُحَطُّ عنهُ ألفُ خطيئةٍ).
adhkar.transliteration: Sa’d said:
adhkar.translation: Sa’d said: ‘We were sitting with the Messenger of Allah , and he said: ‘Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?’ Somebody then asked him : How does one achieve a thousand good deeds? He replied: ‘He should say: How perfect Allah is. one hundred times, for a thousand good deeds are recorded for him or a thousand bad deeds are wiped away.
adhkar.fadl: فَيُكتَبُ لهُ ألفُ حسنةٍ أو يُحَطُّ عنهُ ألفُ خطيئةٍ
adhkar.fadlEn: A thousand good deeds will be recorded for him or a thousand sins will be erased
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/2073

adhkar.title: Jabbir related that the Prophet said: ‘Whoever says...
adhkar.arabicText: (من قالَ: سُبحانَ اللهِ العظيمِ وبِحَمدِهِ غُرِسَتْ لهُ نخلةٌ في الجنةِ).
adhkar.transliteration: Jabbir related that the Prophet said:
adhkar.translation: Jabbir related that the Prophet said: ‘Whoever says: How perfect Allah is. The Supreme, and I praise Him. a palm tree is planted for him in paradise.
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه الترمذي 5/511 والحاكم 1/501 وصححه ووافقه الذهبي ، وانظر صحيح الجامع 5/531 وصحيح الترمذي 3/160
adhkar.fadl: غُرِسَتْ لهُ نخلةٌ في الجنةِ
adhkar.fadlEn: A date palm will be planted for him in Paradise
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Tirmidhi 5/511 and al-Hakim 1/501 who authenticated it and al-Dhahabi agreed. See Sahih al-Jami' 5/531 and Sahih al-Tirmidhi 3/160.

adhkar.title: AAabdullah Ibn Qays related that the Prophet said...
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (يا عبدَ اللهِ بنَ قيسٍ ألا أدُلكَ على كنزٍ من كُنوزِ الجنةِ)؟ فقلتُ: بلى يا رسولَ اللهِ، قالَ: (قلْ لا حولَ ولا قوةَ إلا بِاللهِ).
adhkar.transliteration: AAabdullah Ibn Qays related that the Prophet said to him:
adhkar.translation: AAabdullah Ibn Qays related that the Prophet said to him: ‘ O ‘AAabdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?’ He then said: ‘Say: There is no might nor power except with Allah.)
adhkar.fadl: كنزٍ من كُنوزِ الجنةِ
adhkar.fadlEn: A treasure from the treasures of Paradise
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari with al-Fath 11/213 and Muslim 4/2076

adhkar.title: the most beloved words to Allah are four...
adhkar.arabicText: وقالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (أحَبُّ الكلامِ إلى اللهِ أربَعٌ: سُبحانَ اللهِ، والحَمْدُ لِلهِ، ولا إلهَ إلا اللهُ، واللهُ أكبَرُ، لا يَضُرُّكَ بأيِّهِنَّ بدأتَ).
adhkar.transliteration: the most beloved words to Allah are four: (Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar.)(it does not matter which of them you start with
adhkar.translation: the most beloved words to Allah are four: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.) (it does not matter which of them you start with.)
adhkar.fadl: أحَبُّ الكلامِ إلى اللهِ
adhkar.fadlEn: The most beloved words to Allah
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 3/1685

adhkar.title: Comprehensive words of remembrance
adhkar.arabicText: جاءَ أعرابِيٌّ إلى رسولِ اللهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالَ: علِّمْني كلاماً أقولهُ: قالَ: (قل: لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ وحدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، اللهُ أكبَرُ كَبِيراً، والحَمدُ لِلهِ كَثيراً، سُبحانَ اللهِ رَبِّ العالمينَ، لا حولَ ولا قوةَ إلا بِاللهِ العَزيزِ الحَكيمِ) قالَ: فهؤلاءِ لرَبِّي، فما لي؟ قالَ: (قل: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي، وارحَمْني، واهْدِني، وارْزُقْني).
adhkar.transliteration: SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah and said to him:
adhkar.translation: SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah and said to him: ‘Teach me something which I should say?’ He said: ‘Say: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partener. Allah is most great and much praise is for Allah. How perfect Allah is, Lord of the worlds. There is no might nor power except with Allah, The Exalted in might, The Wise. the man then said: ‘These are for my Lord, and what is for me?’ He replied: ‘Say: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me and grant me sustenance.)
adhkar.sourceReference: مسلم 4/ 2072 وزاد أبو داود : فلما ولى الأعرابي قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : لقد ملأ يديه من الخير 1/ 220
adhkar.fadl: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: عَلِّمْنِي كَلاَماً أَقُولُهُ. قَالَ: قُلْ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً...
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/2072 with the addition of Abu Dawud: "When the Bedouin turned away, the Prophet, may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'He has filled his hands with good.'" 1/220.
adhkar.fadlEn: A Bedouin came to the Prophet asking for words to say, and the Prophet taught him this comprehensive dhikr.

adhkar.title: Tariq Al-AshjaAAee said: ‘When someone would embrace Islam...
adhkar.arabicText: كانَ الرجلُ إذا أَسلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصلاةَ ثم أمرهُ أن يدعوَ بهؤلاءِ الكلماتِ: (اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لي، وارْحَمْني، واهْدِني، وعافِني وارْزُقْني).
adhkar.transliteration: Tariq Al-AshjaAAee said:
adhkar.translation: Tariq Al-AshjaAAee said: ‘When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.)
adhkar.sourceReference: مسلم 4/2073 وفي رواية لمسلم  فإن هؤلاء تجمع لك ديناك وآخرتك
adhkar.fadl: فإن هؤلاء تجمع لك ديناك وآخرتك
adhkar.fadlEn: These words will gather for you your worldly and religious affairs
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/2073. In another narration of Muslim: "For these will gather for you your worldly and religious affairs."

adhkar.title: The best supplication and remembrance
adhkar.arabicText: (إن أفضلَ الدعاءِ الحَمْدُ لِلهِ، وأفضلَ الذكرِ لا إلهَ إلا اللهُ).
adhkar.transliteration: Jabir Ibn
adhkar.translation: Jabir Ibn 'AAabdullah related that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Verily, the best supplication is: All praise is for Allah, and indeed, the best form of remembrance is: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.'
adhkar.sourceReference: Al-Tirmidhī (#3383, 5/462), Ibn Mājah (#3800, 2/1249), and al-Hākim (1/503) and he authenticated it and al-Dhahabī agreed with him. Also see Ṣaḥīḥ al-Jāmiʿ (#1104, 1/362)
adhkar.fadl: أفضلَ الدعاءِ وأفضلَ الذكرِ
adhkar.fadlEn: The best of supplication and the best of remembrance
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Tirmidhī (#3383, 5/462), Ibn Mājah (#3800, 2/1249), and al-Hākim (1/503) and he authenticated it and al-Dhahabī agreed with him. Also see Ṣaḥīḥ al-Jāmiʿ (#1104, 1/362)

adhkar.title: The good deeds which endure are 'Glorified is...
adhkar.arabicText: الباقِياتُ الصالِحاتُ: سُبحانَ اللهِ، والحَمْدُ للهِ، ولا إله إلا اللهُ، واللهُ أكبرُ، ولا حولَ ولا قوةَ إلا بِاللهِ.
adhkar.transliteration: The good deeds which endure are 'Subhaanallaah.', and 'Walhamdulillaah.', and 'Wa laa ilaaha illallaah'., and 'Wallaahu Akbar',and 'Wa laa hawla wa laa guwawala illaa billaah'
adhkar.translation: The good deeds which endure are 'Glorified is Allah', and 'The praise is for Allah', and 'but There is none worthy of worship Allah', and 'Allah is the Most Great', and 'There is no power and no might except by Allah'
adhkar.sourceReference: انظر مجمع الزوائد 1/297، وعزاه ابن حجر في بلوغ المرام من رواية أبي سعيد إلىالنسائي وقال :صححه ابن حبان والحاكم
adhkar.fadl: الباقِياتُ الصالِحاتُ
adhkar.fadlEn: The everlasting good deeds
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: See Majma' al-Zawa'id 1/297. Ibn Hajar in Bulugh al-Maram attributed it from Abu Sa'id to al-Nasa'i and said: "Ibn Hibban and al-Hakim authenticated it."

adhkar.title: Tasbeeh, it means here, to say: (Subhanal-lah, alhamdu...
adhkar.arabicText: عن عبدِ اللهِ بنِ عمرو رضي الله عنه قالَ: (رَأَيْتُ النبيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ) وفي زيادةٍ: (بِيَمينِهِ).
adhkar.transliteration: 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw rdy Allah 'nh qaala: ((raaytu alnnabyya sla Allah 'lyh wslm ya'qidu alttasbiyha)) wfy zyadhin: ((biyamiynihi
adhkar.translation: Tasbeeh, it means here, to say: Subhanal-lah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar.) (AAabdullah Ibn AAamr said: ’I saw the prophet make tasbeeh with his right hand.)
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه أبو داود برقم 1502. وانظر: صحيح أبي داود 1/278.
adhkar.fadl: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يسبح الله على أصابعه
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Abu Dawud, no. 1502. See: Sahih Abi Dawud 1/278.
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet would glorify Allah by counting on his fingers.

adhkar.title: Keeping children indoors at night
adhkar.arabicText: قالَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم (إذا كانَ جُنْحُ الليلِ – أو أمسَيتُم – فَـكُفوا صِبيانـكُم، فإن الشياطينَ تنتشِرُ حينئذٍ، فإذا ذهبَ ساعةٌ من الليلِ فَخَلُّوهمْ، وأغلِقوا الأبوابَ واذكُروا اسمَ اللهِ؛ فإن الشيطانَ لا يفتحُ باباً مغلقاً، وأَوْكوا قِرَبَكُمْ، واذكُروا اسمَ اللهِ، وخَمِّرُوا آنيَتَكُم، واذكُروا اسمَ اللهِ، ولو أن تَعْرُضوا عليها شَيْئاً، وأطْفِئُوا مَصابيحَكُمْ).
adhkar.transliteration: Qaala alnnabiyyu sla Allah 'lyh wslm ((iidhaa kaana junhu alllayli – aw amsaytum – faـkuffuwa sibyanaـkum, faiinna alshhayaatiyna tantashiru hiynaiidhin, faiidhaa dhahaba saa'ahun mina alllayli fakhalluwhum, waaghliquwa alabwaaba waadhkuruwa asma alllahi; faiinna alshhaytaana la yaftahu baabaan mughlaqaan, waawkuwa qirabakum, waadhkuruwa asma alllahi, wakhammiruwa aniyatakum, waadhkuruwa asma alllahi, walaw an ta'ruduwa 'alayhaa shayiaan, waatfiiuwa masaabiyhakum
adhkar.translation: When evening descends, bring your children indoors for the devils scatter out at this hour. Then after the passing of an hour (i.e. the first hour. of the night, (you may. let them (the children. go. Close your doors while mentioning the Name of Allah, for the devil may not open a closed door. Fasten your waterskins mentioning the Name of Allah. Cover your eating vessels mentioning the Name of Allah even if you just put something over it, and extinguish your lamps. Peace and blessing be upon our Prophet, Muhammad, and upon his family and his Companions, all of them.
adhkar.fadl: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ فَكُفُّوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: al-Bukhari with al-Fath 10/ 88 and Muslim 3/1595
adhkar.fadlEn: The Prophet said: When night falls, keep your children indoors, for the devils spread out at that time.

adhkar.title: The everlasting good deeds
adhkar.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wala ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar
adhkar.translation: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest
adhkar.fadl: الباقيات الصالحات: سبحان الله والحمد لله ولا إله إلا الله والله أكبر
adhkar.fadlEn: The everlasting good deeds: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Muslim 4/2072, no. 2695

adhkar.title: There is no god but Allah, alone...
adhkar.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illallah, wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
adhkar.translation: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the sovereignty and His is the praise, and He has power over all things
adhkar.fadl: من قالها عشر مرات دبر صلاة المغرب والصبح كتب الله له بكل واحدة عشر حسنات ومحا عنه عشر سيئات ورفع له عشر درجات وكانت له كعتق عشر رقاب
adhkar.titleAr: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says it ten times after Maghrib and Fajr prayers, Allah will record ten good deeds for each, erase ten sins, raise him ten degrees, and it will be like freeing ten slaves
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 7/67, Muslim 4/2071, no. 2693

adhkar.title: I seek forgiveness from Allah
adhkar.arabicText: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ
adhkar.transliteration: Astaghfirullah
adhkar.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah
adhkar.sourceReference: أخرجه مسلم 4/2075 برقم 2702، وأبو داود برقم 1518.
adhkar.fadl: أستغفر الله: من قالها أخرج الله من قلبه كل هم وغم
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says 'Astaghfirullah,' Allah will remove every worry and grief from his heart.
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by Muslim 4/2075, no. 2702, and Abu Dawud, no. 1518.

adhkar.title: Glory and praise be to Allah
adhkar.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi
adhkar.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah
adhkar.fadl: من قال سبحان الله وبحمده في يوم مائة مرة حطت خطاياه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever says: Glory and praise be to Allah, one hundred times in a day, his sins will be wiped away even if they are like the foam of the sea
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 7/168, Muslim 4/2071, no. 2691

adhkar.title: Glory be to Allah and His praise, Glory be to Allah the Almighty
adhkar.arabicText: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ العَظِيمِ
adhkar.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, subhanallahil-azeem
adhkar.translation: Glory be to Allah and His praise, Glory be to Allah the Almighty
adhkar.fadl: كلمتان خفيفتان على اللسان ثقيلتان في الميزان حبيبتان إلى الرحمن: سبحان الله وبحمده، سبحان الله العظيم
adhkar.titleAr: سبحان الله وبحمده سبحان الله العظيم
adhkar.fadlEn: Two words light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful: Glory and praise be to Allah, Glory be to Allah the Almighty
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 7/168, no. 7563, Muslim 4/2072, no. 2694

adhkar.title: There is no power nor strength except with Allah
adhkar.arabicText: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
adhkar.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
adhkar.translation: There is no power nor strength except with Allah
adhkar.fadl: كنز من كنوز الجنة: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
adhkar.titleAr: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
adhkar.fadlEn: A treasure from the treasures of Paradise: 'There is no might nor power except by Allah.'
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Narrated by al-Bukhari 11/200 and Muslim 4/2092.

adhkar.title: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad
adhkar.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala aali Ibrahima innaka hameedun majeed, Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala aali Ibrahima innaka hameedun majeed
adhkar.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; You are indeed Worthy of Praise, Full of Glory. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; You are indeed Worthy of Praise, Full of Glory
adhkar.fadl: من صلى علي واحدة صلى الله عليه بها عشرا
adhkar.fadlEn: Whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah will send ten blessings upon him
adhkar.sourceReferenceEn: Al-Bukhari 6/233, no. 4797
